metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: It was just this fascinating thing to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I was about seven years old and couldn't resist

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: just playing around with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: in different colors and getting it to loop and repeat that.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And there was something magical about that,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: which just led to more and more.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: How did you think about computers back then?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Like the magical aspect of it,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that you can write a program and there's this thing

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that you just gave birth to that's able to create

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: sort of visual elements and live on its own.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Or did you not think of it in those romantic notions?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Was it more like, oh, that's cool.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I can solve some puzzles.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: It was always more than solving puzzles.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: It was something where there was this

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: limitless possibilities.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Once you have a computer in front of you,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: you can do anything with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I used to play with Lego with the same feeling.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: You can make anything you want out of Lego,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: but even more so with a computer.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: You're not constrained by the amount of kit you've got.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so I was fascinated by it and started pulling out

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: the user guide and the advanced user guide.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And then learning, so I started in basic

body.input: and then later 6502, my father also became interested

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and study for a master's degree in artificial intelligence.

body.input: Funnily enough, at Essex University when I was seven.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So I was exposed to those things at an early age.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: He showed me how to program in Prolog

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and do things like querying your family tree.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And those are some of my earliest memories

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: of trying to figure things out on a computer.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Those are the early steps in computer science programming,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: but when did you first fall in love

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: with artificial intelligence or with the ideas,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: the dreams of AI?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I think it was really when I went to study at university.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So I was an undergrad at Cambridge

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and studying computer science.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And I really started to question,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: you know, what really are the goals?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: What's the goal?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Where do we want to go with computer science?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And it seemed to me that the only step

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: of major significance to take was to try

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and recreate something akin to human intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: If we could do that, that would be a major leap forward.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And that idea, I certainly wasn't the first to have it,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: but it nestled within me somewhere and became like a bug.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: You know, I really wanted to crack that problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So you thought it was like, you had a notion

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that this is something that human beings can do,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that it is possible to create an intelligent machine.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Well, I mean, unless you believe in something metaphysical,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: then what are our brains doing?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Well, at some level, they're information processing systems,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: which are able to take whatever information is in there,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: transform it through some form of program,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and produce some kind of output,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: which enables that human being to do all the amazing things

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that they can do in this incredible world.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So then do you remember the first time

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: you've written a program that,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: because you also had an interest in games,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: do you remember the first time you were in a program

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that beat you in a game?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: That more beat you at anything?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Sort of achieved super David Silver level performance?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So I used to work in the games industry.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So for five years, I programmed games for my first job.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So it was an amazing opportunity to get involved

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: in a startup company.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so I was involved in building AI at that time.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so for sure, there was a sense of building

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: handcrafted what people used to call AI

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: in the games industry,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: which I think is not really what we might think of as AI

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: in its fullest sense,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: but something which is able to take actions

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and in a way which makes things interesting and challenging

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: for the human player.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And at that time I was able to build

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: these handcrafted agents,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: which in certain limited cases could do things

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: which were able to do better than me,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: but mostly in these kind of Twitch-like scenarios

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: where they were able to do things faster

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: or because they had some pattern

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: which was able to exploit repeatedly.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I think if we're talking about real AI,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: the first experience for me came after that

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: when I realized that this path I was on

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: wasn't taking me towards,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: it wasn't dealing with that bug,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: which I still had inside me to really understand intelligence

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and try and solve it.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: That everything people were doing in games was,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: short-term fixes rather than long-term vision.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so I went back to study for my PhD,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: which was funnily enough trying to apply reinforcement

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: learning to the game of Go.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And I built my first Go program using reinforcement learning,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: a system which would by trial and error play against itself

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and was able to learn which patterns were actually helpful

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: to predict whether it was gonna win or lose the game

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and then choose the moves that led to the combination

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: of patterns that would mean that you're more likely to win.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And that system beat me.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And how did that make you feel?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Made me feel good.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I mean, was there sort of the, yeah, it's a mix

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: of a sort of excitement and was there a tinge of sort of,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: like almost like a fearful awe?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: You know, it's like in space, 2001 Space Odyssey,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: kind of realizing that you've created something that,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that is, you know, that's achieved human level intelligence

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: in this one particular little task.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And in that case, I suppose,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: neural networks weren't involved.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: There were no neural networks in those days.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: This was pre deep learning revolution,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: but it was a principled self-learning system

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: based on a lot of the principles which people still use

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: in deep reinforcement learning.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: How did I feel?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I think I found it immensely satisfying

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that a system which was able to learn

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: from first principles for itself was able to reach the point

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that it was understanding this domain better than I could

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and able to outwit me.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I don't think it was a sense of awe.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: It was a sense that satisfaction,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that something I felt should work had worked.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So to me, AlphaGo, and I don't know how else to put it,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: but to me, AlphaGo and AlphaGo Zero,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: mastering the game of Go is again, to me,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: the most profound and inspiring moment

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: in the history of artificial intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So you're one of the key people behind this achievement.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And I'm Russian, so I really felt the first sort

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: of seminal achievement when Deep Blue

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: beat Garry Kasparov in 1987.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: largely saw the game of Go as unbeatable in AI,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: using the sort of the state of the art

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: to brute force methods, search methods.

body.input: Even if you consider, at least the way I saw it,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: even if you consider arbitrary

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: of building the system that plays Go.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: When was the dream for you

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that you could actually build a computer program

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: not necessarily beats the world champion,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: First of all, thank you.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: That was very kind words.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And funnily enough, I just came from a panel

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: where I was actually in a conversation

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: with Garry Kasparov and Murray Campbell,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: who was the author of Deep Blue.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And it was their first meeting together since the match.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So that just occurred yesterday.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So I'm literally fresh from that experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So these are amazing moments when they happen,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: but where did it all start?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Well, for me, it started

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: when I became fascinated in the game of Go.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So Go for me, I've grown up playing games.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I've always had a fascination in board games.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I played chess as a kid.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I played Scrabble as a kid.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: When I was at university, I discovered the game of Go.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And to me, it just blew all of those other games

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: out of the water.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: It was just so deep and profound in its complexity

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: with endless levels to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: What I discovered was that I could devote

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: endless hours to this game.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And I knew in my heart of hearts

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that no matter how many hours I would devote to it,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I would never become a grand master.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Or there was another path.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And the other path was to try and understand

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: how you could get some other intelligence

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: to play this game better than I would be able to.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so even in those days, I had this idea that,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: what if it was possible to build a program

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that could crack this?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And as I started to explore the domain,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I discovered that this was really the domain

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: where people felt deeply

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that if progress could be made in Go,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: it would really mean a giant leap forward for AI.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: It was the challenge where all other approaches had failed.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: This is coming out of the era you mentioned,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: which was in some sense the golden era

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: for the classical methods of AI like heuristic search.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: In the 90s, they all fell one after another,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: not just chess with Deep Blue, but checkers,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: backgammon, Othello.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: There were numerous cases where systems built

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: on top of heuristic search methods

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: with these high-performance systems

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: had been able to defeat the human world champion

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: in each of those domains.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And yet in that same time period,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: there was a million dollar prize available

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: for the game of Go,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: for the first system to be a human professional player.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And at the end of that time period,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: at year 2000 when the prize expired,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: the strongest Go program in the world

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: was defeated by a nine-year-old child

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: when that nine-year-old child was giving nine free moves

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: to the computer at the start of the game

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: to try and even things up.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And the Computer Go expert beat that same strongest program

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: with 29 handicapped stones, 29 free moves.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So that's what the state of affairs was

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: when I became interested in this problem

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: in around 2003 when I started working on Computer Go.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: There was nothing.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: There was very, very little in the way of progress

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: towards meaningful performance,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: again, at anything approaching human level.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so people, it wasn't through lack of effort.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: People have tried many, many things.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so there was a strong sense

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that something different would be required for Go

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: than had been needed for all of these other domains

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: where AI had been successful.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And maybe the single clearest example is that

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Go, unlike those other domains,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: had this kind of intuitive property

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that a Go player would look at a position and say,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: hey, here's this mess of black and white stones.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: But from this mess, oh, I can predict

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that this part of the board has become my territory,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: this part of the board has become your territory,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and I've got this overall sense that I'm gonna win

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and that this is about the right move to play.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And that intuitive sense of judgment

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: of being able to evaluate what's going on in a position,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: it was pivotal to humans being able to play this game

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and something that people had no idea

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: how to put into computers.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So this question of how to evaluate in a position,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: how to come up with these intuitive judgments

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: was the key reason why Go was so hard

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: in addition to its enormous search space,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and the reason why methods which had succeeded so well

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: elsewhere failed in Go.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so people really felt deep down that,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: in order to crack Go,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: we would need to get something akin to human intuition.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And if we got something akin to human intuition,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: we'd be able to solve many, many more problems in AI.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So for me, that was the moment where it's like,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: okay, this is not just about playing the game of Go,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: this is about something profound.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And it was back to that bug,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: which had been itching me all those years,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: this is the opportunity to do something meaningful

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and transformative, and I guess a dream was born.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: That's a really interesting way to put it.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So almost this realization that you need to find,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: formulate Go as a kind of a prediction problem

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: versus a search problem was the intuition.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I mean, maybe that's the wrong crude term,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: but to give it us the ability to kind of

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: intuit things about positional structure of the board.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Now, okay, but what about the learning part of it?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Did you have a sense that you have to,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that learning has to be part of the system?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Again, something that hasn't really, as far as I think,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: except with TDGammon and in the 90s with RL a little bit,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: hasn't been part of those day to the art game playing systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So I strongly felt that learning would be necessary.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And that's why my PhD topic back then

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: was trying to apply reinforcement learning

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: to the game of Go.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And not just learning of any type,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: but I felt that the only way to really have a system

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: to progress beyond human levels of performance

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: wouldn't just be to mimic how humans do it,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: but to understand for themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And how else can a machine hope to understand

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: what's going on except through learning?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: If you're not learning, what else are you doing?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Well, you're putting all the knowledge into the system.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And that just feels like something which decades of AI

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: have told us is maybe not a dead end,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: but certainly has a ceiling to the capabilities.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: It's known as the knowledge acquisition bottleneck

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that the more you try to put into something,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: the more brittle the system becomes.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so you just have to have learning.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: You have to have learning.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: That's the only way you're going to be able to get

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: a system which has sufficient knowledge in it,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: millions and millions of pieces of knowledge,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: billions, trillions of a form

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that it can actually apply for itself

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and understand how those billions and trillions

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: of pieces of knowledge can be leveraged in a way

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: which will actually lead it towards its goal

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: without conflict or other issues.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Yeah, I mean, if I put myself back in that time,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I just wouldn't think like that

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: without a good demonstration of RL.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I would think more in the symbolic AI,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: like not learning, but sort of a simulation

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: of a knowledge base, like a growing knowledge base,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: but it would still be sort of pattern-based,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: like basically have little rules

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that you kind of assemble together

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: into a large knowledge base.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Well, in a sense, that was the state of the art back then.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So if you look at the Go programs,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: which had been competing for this prize I mentioned,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: they were an assembly of different specialized systems,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: some of which used huge amounts of human knowledge

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: to describe how you should play the opening,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: how you should, all the different patterns

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that were required to play well in the game of Go,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: end game theory, combinatorial game theory,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and combined with more principled search-based methods,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: which were trying to solve

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Let me say it this way that I think it's helpful

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: to separate out the problem from the solution.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So I see the problem of intelligence,

body.input: I would say it can be formalized

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: as the reinforcement learning problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And that that formalization is enough to capture

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that they can all be brought within this framework

body.input: and us as computer scientists to build them.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so in that sense, I feel that it gives us a path,

body.input: but maybe we're missing some things.

body.input: Maybe there's gonna be better ideas.

body.input: I think we should keep, let's remain modest

body.input: and we're at the early days of this field

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and there are many amazing discoveries ahead of us.

body.input: For sure, the specifics, especially of the different kinds

body.input: that fall under the very large umbrella of RL.

body.input: So reinforcement learning is the study and the science

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and the problem of intelligence in the form of an agent

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So the problem you're trying to solve

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: like the world in which that agent is situated.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And the goal of RL is clear

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that the agent gets to take actions.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Those actions have some effect on the environment

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and the environment gives back an observation to the agent

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: saying, this is what you see or sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And one special thing which it gives back

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: is called the reward signal,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: how well it's doing in the environment.

body.input: And the reinforcement learning problem

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: is to simply take actions over time

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: so as to maximize that reward signal.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So a couple of basic questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: What types of RL approaches are there?

body.input: So I don't know if there's a nice brief inwards way

body.input: to paint a picture of sort of value-based,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Yeah, so now if we think about, okay,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: so there's this ambitious problem definition of RL.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and ask, well, what form does that decomposition take?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And some of the most common pieces that people use

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: when they're kind of putting the solution method together,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: some of the most common pieces that people use

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: are whether or not that solution has a value function.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: That means something which is deciding

body.input: how to pick actions.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Is that decision-making process explicitly represented?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so those three pieces are, to me,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: some of the most common building blocks.

body.input: And I understand the different choices in RL

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: as choices of whether or not to use those building blocks

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: when you're trying to decompose the solution.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Should I have a value function represented?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Should I have a policy represented?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Should I have a model represented?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: into the picture as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: But those three fundamental choices give rise

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: to some of the branches of RL

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: with which we are very familiar.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so those, as you mentioned there,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: it's a choice of what's specified or modeled explicitly.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And the idea is that all of these

body.input: are somehow implicitly learned within the system.

body.input: So it's almost a choice of how you approach a problem.

body.input: Do you see those as fundamental differences

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: or are these almost like small specifics,

body.input: like the details of how you solve the problem,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: but they're not fundamentally different from each other?

body.input: I think the fundamental idea is maybe at the higher level,

body.input: from that node onwards.

body.input: Where a project was born.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: where myself and Ajay Huang and an intern, Chris Madison,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: That systems like ImageNet had suddenly

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so when we had our first paper that

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: showed that it was possible to predict

body.input: the winner of the game, that it was possible to suggest

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so the reason that we did it that way was, at that time,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: we were exploring separately the deep learning aspect

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: from the reinforcement learning aspect.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: That was the part which was new and unknown to me at that time,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: was how far could that be stretched?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Once we had that, it then became natural to try and use

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that same representation and see if we

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: could learn for ourselves using that same representation.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so right from the beginning, actually, our goal

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: had been to build a system using self-play.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And to us, the human data, right from the beginning,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: was an expedient step to help us, for pragmatic reasons,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: to go faster towards the goals of the project

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: than we might be able to starting solely from self-play.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so in those days, we were very aware

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that we were choosing to use human data.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And that might not be the long-term holy grail of AI,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: but that it was something which was extremely useful to us.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: It helped us to understand the system.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: It helped us to build deep learning representations, which

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: were clear and simple and easy to use.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so really, I would say it served a purpose not just

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: as part of the algorithm, but something

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: which I continue to use in our research today, which

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: is trying to break down a very hard challenge into pieces

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: which are easier to understand for us as researchers

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and develop.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So if you use a component based on human data,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: it can help you to understand the system,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: such that then you can build the more principled version later

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that does it for itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So as I said, the AlphaGo victory,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and I don't think I'm being sort of romanticizing this notion.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I think it's one of the greatest moments in the history of AI.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So were you cognizant of this magnitude

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: of the accomplishment at the time?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Because to me, I feel like it's something that would,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: we mentioned what the AGI systems of the future

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: will look back.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: holy crap, they figured it out.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: This is where it started.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Well, thank you again.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I mean, it's funny because I guess

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I've been working on computer go for a long time.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And throughout that decade, I'd had this dream

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And I imagined that that would be an interesting moment,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that maybe some people might care about that,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and that this might be a nice achievement.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: But I think when I arrived in Seoul

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and discovered the legions of journalists
