metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that were watching the match online, live,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I realized that I'd been off in my estimation

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: of how significant this moment was

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: by several orders of magnitude.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so there was definitely an adjustment process

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: to realize that this was something

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: which the world really cared about

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and which was a watershed moment.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And I think there was that moment of realization.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: It was also a little bit scary because, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: if you go into something thinking it's gonna be maybe

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: of interest and then discover that 100 million people

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: are watching, it suddenly makes you worry about

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: whether some of the decisions you'd made

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: were really the best ones or the wisest,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: or were going to lead to the best outcome.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And we knew for sure that there were still imperfections

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: in AlphaGo, which were gonna be exposed

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: to the whole world watching.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so, yeah, it was, I think, a great experience

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and I feel privileged to have been part of it,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: privileged to have led that amazing team.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I feel privileged to have been in a moment of history,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: like you say, but also lucky that, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: in a sense I was insulated from the knowledge of,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: had been known to me and the team.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I think it was, you know, we were in our bubble

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and we were working on research

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and we were trying to answer the scientific questions

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and then bam, you know, the public sees it.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And I think it was better that way in retrospect.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Were you confident that, I guess,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: what were the chances that you could get the win?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So, just like you said, I'm a little bit more familiar

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: with another accomplishment that we may not even

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: but here, you know, with AlphaStar

body.input: and beating the StarCraft,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so this really was a clear instance

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: where we could say computers exhibited creativity,

body.input: that this was really a move that was something humans

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I'm not sure what it is about learning

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that feels like intelligence, but it does.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So I think we should not demean the achievements of what

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: was done in previous eras of AI.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I think that Deep Blue was an amazing achievement in itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And that heuristic search of the kind that was used by Deep Blue

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: had some powerful ideas that were in there,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: but it also missed some things.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So the fact that the evaluation function, the way

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that the chess position was understood,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: was created by humans and not by the machine

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: is a limitation, which means that there's

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: a ceiling on how well it can do.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: But maybe more importantly, it means

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that the same idea cannot be applied in other domains

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: where we don't have access to the kind of human grandmasters

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and that ability to kind of encode exactly their knowledge

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: into an evaluation function.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And the reality is that the story of AI

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: is that most domains turn out to be of the second type, where

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: knowledge is messy, it's hard to extract from experts,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: or it isn't even available.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so we need to solve problems in a different way.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And I think AlphaGo is a step towards solving things

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: in a way which puts learning as a first class citizen

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and says, systems need to understand for themselves

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: how to understand the world, how to judge the value of any action

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that they might take within that world,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: in any state they might find themselves in.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And in order to do that, we make progress towards AI.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Yeah, so one of the nice things about taking a learning

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: approach to the game of Go or game playing

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: is that the things you learn, the things you figure out,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: are actually going to be applicable to other problems

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that are real world problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: That's ultimately, I mean, there's

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: two really interesting things about AlphaGo.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: One is the science of it, just the science of learning,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: the science of intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And then the other is, well, you're actually

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: learning to figuring out how to build systems that

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: would be potentially applicable in other applications.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Medical, autonomous vehicles, robotics, all that.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I mean, it's just open the door to all kinds of applications.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So the next incredible step, really the profound step,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: is probably AlphaGo Zero.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I mean, it's arguable.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I kind of see them all as the same place.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: But really, and perhaps you were already

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: thinking that AlphaGo Zero is the natural.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: It was always going to be the next step.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: But it's removing the reliance on human expert

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: games for pre-training, as you mentioned.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So how big of an intellectual leap

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: was this, that self-play could achieve superhuman level

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: performance on its own?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And maybe could you also say, what is self-play?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Kind of mentioned a few times.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So let me start with self-play.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So the idea of self-play is something

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: which is really about systems learning for themselves,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: but in the situation where there's more than one agent.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so if you're in a game, and a game

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: is played between two players, then self-play

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: is really about understanding that game just

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: by playing games against yourself,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: rather than against any actual real opponent.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so it's a way to kind of discover strategies

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: without having to actually need to go out and play

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: against any particular human player, for example.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: The main idea of AlphaZero was really

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: to try and step back from any of the knowledge

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that we put into the system and ask the question,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: is it possible to come up with a single elegant principle

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: by which a system can learn for itself all of the knowledge

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: which it requires to play a game such as Go?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Importantly, by taking knowledge out,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: you not only make the system less brittle in the sense

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that perhaps the knowledge you were putting in

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: was just getting in the way and maybe stopping the system

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: learning for itself, but also you make it more general.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: The more knowledge you put in, the harder

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: it is for a system to actually be placed,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: taken out of the system in which it's kind of been designed,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and placed in some other system that maybe would need

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: a completely different knowledge base to understand

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and perform well.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so the real goal here is to strip out all of the knowledge

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that we put in to the point that we can just plug it

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: into something totally different.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And that, to me, is really the promise of AI,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: is that we can have systems such as that, which no matter what

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: the goal is, no matter what goal we set to the system,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: we can come up with, we have an algorithm which

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: can be placed into that world, into that environment,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and can succeed in achieving that goal.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And then that, to me, is almost the essence of intelligence,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: if we can achieve that.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so AlphaZero is a step towards that.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And it's a step that was taken in the context of two player

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: perfect information games, like Go and chess.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: We also applied it to Japanese chess.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So just to clarify, the first step was AlphaGo Zero.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: The first step was to try and take all of the knowledge

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: out of AlphaGo in such a way that it

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: could play in a fully self-discovered way,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: purely from self-play.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And to me, the motivation for that

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: was always that we could then plug it into other domains.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: But we saved that until later.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Well, and in fact, I mean, just for fun,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I could tell you exactly the moment

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: where the idea for AlphaZero occurred to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Because I think there's maybe a lesson there

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: for researchers who are kind of too deeply embedded

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: in their research and working 24-7 to try and come up

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: with the next idea, which is it actually

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: occurred to me on honeymoon.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And I was in my most fully relaxed state,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: really enjoying myself.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And just being this, the algorithm for AlphaZero

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: just appeared in its full form.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And this was actually before we played against Lisa Doll.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: But we just didn't, I think we were

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: so busy trying to make sure we could beat the world champion

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that it was only later that we had the opportunity

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: to step back and start examining that deeper scientific question

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: of whether this could really work.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So nevertheless, so self-play is probably

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: one of the most profound ideas that represents, to me

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: at least, artificial intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: But the fact that you could use that kind of mechanism

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: to, again, beat world class players,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that's very surprising.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So to me, it feels like you have to train

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: in a large number of expert games.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So was it surprising to you?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: What was the intuition?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Can you sort of think, not necessarily at that time,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: even now, what's your intuition, why this thing works so well?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Why it's able to learn from scratch?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Well, let me first say why we tried it.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So we tried it both because I feel

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that it was the deeper scientific question

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: to be asking to make progress towards AI.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And also because, in general, in my research,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I don't like to do research on questions for which we already

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: know the likely outcome.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I don't see much value in running an experiment where

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: you're 95% confident that you will succeed.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so we could have tried maybe to take AlphaGo

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and do something which we knew for sure it would succeed on.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: But much more interesting to me was

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: to try it on the things which we weren't sure about.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And one of the big questions on our minds back then

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: was, could you really do this with self-play alone?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: How far could that go?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Would it be as strong?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And honestly, we weren't sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: It was 50-50, I think.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: If you'd asked me, I wasn't confident

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that it could reach the same level as these systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: But it felt like the right question to ask.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And even if it had not achieved the same level,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I felt that that was an important direction

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: to be studying.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so then, lo and behold, it actually

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: ended up outperforming the previous version of AlphaGo

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and indeed was able to beat it by 100 games to 0.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So what's the intuition as to why?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I think the intuition to me is clear,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that whenever you have errors in a system, as we did in AlphaGo,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: AlphaGo suffered from these delusions.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Occasionally, it would misunderstand what

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: was going on in a position and mis-evaluate it.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: How can you remove all of these errors?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Errors arise from many sources.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: For us, they were arising both from starting

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: from the human data, but also from the nature of the search

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and the nature of the algorithm itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: But the only way to address them in any complex system

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: is to give the system the ability

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: to correct its own errors.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: It must be able to correct them.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: It must be able to learn for itself

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: when it's doing something wrong and correct for it.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so it seemed to me that the way to correct delusions

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: was indeed to have more iterations of reinforcement

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: learning.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: No matter where you start, you should be able to correct

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: those errors until it gets to play that out and understand,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: oh, well, I thought that I was going to win in this situation,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: but then I ended up losing.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: That suggests that I was mis-evaluating something

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and there's a hole in my knowledge,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and now the system can correct for itself

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and understand how to do better.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Now, if you take that same idea and trace it back

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: all the way to the beginning, it should

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: be able to take you from no knowledge,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: from completely random starting point,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: all the way to the highest levels of knowledge

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that you can achieve in a domain.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And the principle is the same, that if you bestow a system

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: with the ability to correct its own errors,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: then it can take you from random to something slightly better

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: than random because it sees the stupid things

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that the random is doing and it can correct them.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And then it can take you from that slightly better system

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and understand, well, what's that doing wrong?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And it takes you on to the next level and the next level.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And this progress can go on indefinitely.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And indeed, what would have happened

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: if we'd carried on training AlphaGo Zero for longer,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: we saw no sign of it slowing down its improvements,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: or at least it was certainly carrying on to improve.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And presumably, if you had the computational resources,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: this could lead to better and better systems

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that discover more and more.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So your intuition is fundamentally there's not

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: a ceiling to this process.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: One of the surprising things, just like you said,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: is the process of patching errors.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: It intuitively makes sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Reinforcement learning should be part of that process.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: But what is surprising is in the process

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: of patching your own lack of knowledge,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: you don't open up other patches.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: You keep sort of, like there's a monotonic decrease

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: of your weaknesses.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Well, let me back this up.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I think science always should make falsifiable hypotheses.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So let me back up this claim with a falsifiable hypothesis,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: which is that if someone was to, in the future,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: take AlphaZero as an algorithm and run it

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: with greater computational resources

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that we had available today,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: then I would predict that they would be able

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: to beat the previous system 100 games to zero.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And that if they were then to do the same thing

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: a couple of years later,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that that would beat that previous system 100 games to zero,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and that that process would continue indefinitely

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: throughout at least my human lifetime.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Presumably the game of Go would set the ceiling.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I mean-

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: The game of Go would set the ceiling,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: but the game of Go has 10 to the 170 states in it.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So the ceiling is unreachable by any computational device

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that can be built out of the 10 to the 80 atoms

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: in the universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: You asked a really good question, which is,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: do you not open up other errors

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: when you correct your previous ones?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And the answer is yes, you do.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so it's a remarkable fact about this class

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: of two-player game, and also true of single agent games,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that essentially progress will always lead you to,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: if you have sufficient representational resource,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: like imagine you had, could represent every state

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: in a big table of the game,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: then we know for sure that a progress of self-improvement

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: will lead all the way in the single agent case

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: to the optimal possible behavior,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and in the two-player case to the minimax optimal behavior.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: That is the best way that I can play,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: knowing that you're playing perfectly against me.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so for those cases, we know that even if you do

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: open up some new error,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that in some sense you've made progress.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: You're progressing towards the best that can be done.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So AlphaGo was initially trained on expert games

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: with some self-play.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: AlphaGo Zero removed the need to be trained on expert games.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And then another incredible step for me,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: because I just love chess,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: is to generalize that further to be in AlphaZero

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: to be able to play the game of Go,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: beating AlphaGo Zero in AlphaGo,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and then also being able to play the game of chess and others.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So what was that step like?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: What's the interesting aspects there

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that required to make that happen?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: I think the remarkable observation,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: which we saw with AlphaZero,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: was that actually without modifying the algorithm at all,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: it was able to play and crack

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: some of AI's greatest previous challenges.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: In particular, we dropped it into the game of chess.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And unlike the previous systems like Deep Blue,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: which had been worked on for years and years,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and we were able to beat

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: the world's strongest computer chess program convincingly,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: using a system that was fully discovered by its own,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: from scratch with its own principles.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And in fact, one of the nice things that we found was that,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: in fact, we also achieved the same result in Japanese chess,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: a variant of chess where you get to capture pieces

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and then place them back down on your own side

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: as an extra piece.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: So a much more complicated variant of chess.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And we also beat the world's strongest programs

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and reached superhuman performance in that game too.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And it was the very first time that we'd ever run the system

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: on that particular game,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: was the version that we published in the paper on AlphaZero.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: It just worked out of the box, literally, no touching it.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: We didn't have to do anything.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And there it was, superhuman performance,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: no tweaking, no twiddling.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so I think there's something beautiful about that principle

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that you can take an algorithm and without twiddling anything,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: it just works.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Now, to go beyond AlphaZero, what's required?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: AlphaZero is just a step.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And there's a long way to go beyond that

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: to really crack the deep problems of AI.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: But one of the important steps is to acknowledge

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: that the world is a really messy place.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: It's this rich, complex, beautiful,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: but messy environment that we live in.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And no one gives us the rules.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Like no one knows the rules of the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: At least maybe we understand that it operates

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: according to Newtonian or quantum mechanics at the micro level

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: or according to relativity at the macro level.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: But that's not a model that's useful for us as people

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: to operate in it.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: Somehow the agent needs to understand the world for itself

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: in a way where no one tells it the rules of the game.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And yet it can still figure out what to do in that world,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: deal with this stream of observations coming in,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: rich sensory input coming in,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: actions going out in a way that allows it to reason

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: in the way that AlphaGo or AlphaZero can reason,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: in the way that these Go and chess playing programs can reason,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: but in a way that allows it to take actions

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: in that messy world to achieve its goals.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And so this led us to the most recent step in the story of AlphaGo,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: which was a system called MuZero.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: And MuZero is a system which learns for itself

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: even when the rules are not given to it.

body.input: that are unknown and complex,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #86

body.input: and the agent needs to learn for itself how to deal with that.
