metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: between the communist Soviet Union

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: and the free United States, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: So the US had on its side

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: the UN Declaration of Human Rights,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: a bunch of liberties, essentially,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: things like free speech, freedom of association,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: freedom of assembly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: The Soviets wanted entitlements like the right to work,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: the right to have housing, the right to water,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: the right to a vacation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: So you actually read the UN Declaration for Human Rights,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: it's a negotiation between the Soviets and the Americans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: Later, there was another document in the 70s

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: released called the International Covenant

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: on Civil and Political Rights.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: And this is what HREF uses as its sort of like lodestar,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: its founding document.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: And this is like essentially an international agreement

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: on the negative rights.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: Those are the things we choose to focus on

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: because essentially authoritarian regimes can commit fraud

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: and claim they're giving the positive rights,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: the entitlements,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: without having any of the negative liberties.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: And they can do that because they don't have

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: any like free speech or press freedom.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: When you take people's basic fundamental freedoms away,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: it's quite easy to make like a Potemkin village

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: and pretend that there's the entitlements

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: and that we have good healthcare.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: And it's the same sort of thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: that authoritarians have done for decades,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: Cuba and Venezuela and the Soviet Union.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: Do you think it's possible for authoritarian regimes

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: to manipulate, to kind of lie about the negative rights

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: as well by saying that the people have free speech,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: the people have the freedom for assembly

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: and all those kinds of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: Can't you still manipulate the idea

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: that the citizenry still has those rights?

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: The opposition leader of Malaysia, Anwar Ibrahim,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: he once told me the funny joke that in my country,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: we have freedom of speech,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: we don't have freedom after speech.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: So yeah, they can absolutely manipulate whatever they want.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: But I've done research into socioeconomic data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: And I guess what I'm telling you is that authoritarian regimes,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: which make up 53% of the world's population

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: across 95 countries, about 4.3 billion people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: those who live under those regimes are subject to

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: massive fraud when it comes to things like literacy rates,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: life expectancy, any sort of socioeconomic data,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: economic growth, they can do this

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: because there's no free press.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: So for us at the Human Rights Foundation

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: and for people like me,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: we believe that the negative rights, the liberties,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: the things that are in, for example,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: the Bill of Rights and the US Constitution,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: these things are the table.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: And then we can build on top of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: We can build the rest of our societies on top of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: The freest countries in the world have both

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: the negative liberties and the entitlements,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: like Norway, for example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: But there's a big difference between Norway and North Korea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: In North Korea, they only claim to have the entitlements

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: and they definitely don't have the liberties.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: Do you think there's one right

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: that's more important than others?

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: You kind of suggested the freedom of the press,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: maybe freedom of speech, that if you take that away,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: all the other ones kind of collapse along with,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: like from a ripple effect.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: Is there something fundamental that you like to focus

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: your attention on to defend, to protect,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: to make sure it's there?

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: Yeah, I think free speech is probably the most fundamental.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: It's probably why the founders chose to make it

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: into the First Amendment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: A lot of things are downstream from there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: Property rights are also very, very important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: Obviously, we've seen the toll of violent redistributionism

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: over the last 100 years, whether it was Lenin or Stalin

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: or Mao or other regimes and everywhere from Ethiopia

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: to colonialists everywhere to North Korea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: It's not a pretty legacy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: Is free speech clear to you as a concept?

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: There's been quite a few debates,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: especially in the digital age.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: What it means to violate freedom of speech.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: There's been a lot of new, novel mechanisms

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: for people to communicate with each other,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: especially on social networks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: And it seems that unclear, because a lot of times,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: those are managed by private companies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: It's unclear how much protection do the citizens

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: have to have when they're communicating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: A lot of people are being censored

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: on these social platforms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: Some people, even presidents, get removed

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: from those social platforms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: Have you thought about the freedom of speech

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: in the United States, but in the world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: as it's implemented in the 21st century,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: given the internet and all those kinds of things?

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: There is a Soviet dissident named Natan Sharansky

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: who survived the regime.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: And he wrote a book in which his thesis was essentially

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: the way that you can define a free society

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: is through something called the town square test.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: Can you go to a public space where you live

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: and criticize your ruler loudly without fear of retribution?

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: If you can do that, you have free speech.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: I think that's a pretty good litmus test.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: Most people in this world cannot do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: If you live in Havana, if you live in Moscow,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: if you live in Beijing, you cannot do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: And that's not a free society.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: In Austin, Texas, in Boston, Massachusetts,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: in London, in Santiago, Chile, in Tokyo, Japan,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: in many democracies, you can do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: And I think that that's a really helpful

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: basic sort of litmus test.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: Does the content of the criticism matter?

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: Can it be complete lies, meaning conspiracy theories

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: that involve claiming that the leader is, let's say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: a lizard slash pedophile slash, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: I'm not saying that those are lies, look into it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: but they're very unlikely phenomena.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: So like, does that matter?

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: I think it ends poorly when the state

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: tries to restrict speech.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: I think that's kind of how I would define censorship.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: I think censorship and deplatforming

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: are two different things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: Private companies, you know, they get to make up

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: their own rules about what's allowed on their platforms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: And I think that's very different from a government

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: with guns and an army restricting the speech

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: of its citizens with threats of violence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: These things are different for me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: That violence is a fundamental difference.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: I don't know, I've gotten the chance to have dinner

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: with Alex Jones, and I've talked to him a few times offline.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: And it does, I understand why people are so off-put by him,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: but it does bother me that he's universally removed

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: from every platform.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: It feels like there's many more evil people, bad people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: compared to Alex Jones, who still are given a voice

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: on these platforms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: And so I'm uncomfortable with the universality

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: of the application of this censorship

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: by these platforms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: But on the flip side, you're right, there's not a violence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: there's not tanks, there's not guns behind that censorship.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: Yeah, it's a bit of a generalization,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: but Alex Jones would be in prison or dead

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: if he were in North Korea or in Cuba or in Russia

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: or in China, that the authorities would not tolerate him

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: to do what he did.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: And here he can kind of do what he wants.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: He's encountering some resistance

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: in the marketplace of ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: Large organizations, corporations,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: and a lot of public sentiment in different parts

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: of our country don't like him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: They're doing their best to drown out his voice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: But that's very different from a violent threat

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: of censorship from the state.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: And that's what we study.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: That's what I study, are these, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: what is the state doing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: That's kind of paramount for me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: Yeah, and that's true, because in the marketplace of ideas,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: there could be a company that springs up,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alex Gladstein: Bitcoin, Authoritarianism, and Human Rights | Lex Fridman Podcast #231

body.input: that gives Alex Jones a platform.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: but how do we respect in your view people's privacy?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Yeah, I mean in the case of how worried are people

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: about using their data, I mean there's a lot

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: of public debate and criticism about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: When we look at people's revealed preferences,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: you know people's continuing massive use

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: of these sorts of services, it's not clear to me

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: how much people really do care.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Perhaps they care a bit, but they're happy to in effect

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: kind of sell their data in order to be able

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: to kind of use a certain service.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: That's a great term, revealed preferences.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So these aren't preferences you self report in a survey,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: this is like your actions speak.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Yeah, exactly, so you might say, oh yeah I hate the idea

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: of Facebook having my data, but then when it comes to it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: you actually are willing to give that data in exchange

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: for being able to use the service.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And if that's the case, then I think unless we have

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: some explanation about why there's some negative externality

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: from that or why there's some coordination failure,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: or if there's something that consumers are just really

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: misled about where they don't realize why giving away data

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: like this is a really bad thing to do,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: then ultimately I kind of want to respect people's

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: preferences, they can give away their data if they want.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: I think there's a big difference between companies' use

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: of data and governments having data where looking at the

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: record of history, governments knowing a lot about

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: their people can be very bad if the government chooses

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: to do bad things with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And that's more worrying I think.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So let's jump into it a little bit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Most people know, but actually I two years ago had no idea

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: what Effective Altruism was until I saw there was a cool

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: looking event in an MIT group here, I think it's called

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: the Effective Altruism Club or a group.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: I was like, what the heck is that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And one of my friends said, he said that they're just

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: a bunch of eccentric characters.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So I was like, hell yes, I'm in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So I went to one of their events and looked up what's it

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: about, it's quite a fascinating philosophical and just

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: a movement of ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So can you tell me what is Effective Altruism?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Great, so the core of Effective Altruism is about trying

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: to answer this question, which is how can I do as much

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: good as possible with my scarce resources, my time

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: and with my money?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And then once we have our best guess answers to that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: trying to take those ideas and put that into practice

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: and to do those things that we believe will do the most

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: good and we're now a community of people, many thousands

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: of us around the world who really are trying to answer

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: that question as best we can and then use our time

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: and money to make the world better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So what's the difference between sort of classical,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: general idea of altruism and Effective Altruism?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So normally when people try to do good, they often just

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: aren't so reflective about those attempts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So someone might approach you on the street asking you

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: to give to charity and if you're feeling altruistic,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: you'll give to the person on the street.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Or if you think, oh, I wanna do some good in my life,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: you might volunteer at a local place or perhaps you'll

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: decide, you know, pursue a career where you're working

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: in a field that's kind of more obviously beneficial

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: like being a doctor or a nurse or a healthcare professional.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: But it's very rare that people apply the same level

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: of rigor and analytical thinking to lots of other areas

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: we think about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So take the case of someone approaching you on the street.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Imagine if that person instead was saying,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: hey, I've got this amazing company, do you want

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: to invest in it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: It would be insane.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: No one would ever think, oh, of course, I'm just

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: a company like you'd think it was a scam.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: But somehow we don't have that same level of rigor

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: when it comes to doing good, even though the stakes

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: are more important when it comes to trying to help others

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: than trying to make money for ourselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: First of all, so there is a psychology at the individual

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: level of doing good just feels good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And so in some sense, on that pure psychological part,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: it doesn't matter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: In fact, you don't want to know if it does good or not

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: because most of the time it won't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So like in a certain sense, it's understandable why

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: altruism without the effective part is so appealing

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: to a certain population.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: By the way, let's zoom out for a second.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Do you think most people, two questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Do you think most people are good?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And question number two is, do you think most people

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: want to do good?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So are most people good?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: I think it's just super dependent on the circumstances

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: that someone is in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: I think that the actions people take and their moral

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: worth is just much more dependent on circumstance

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: than it is on someone's intrinsic character.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So is it evil within all of us?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: It seems like the better angels of our nature,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: there's a tendency of us as a society to tend towards good,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: less war, I mean with all these metrics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: What is that us becoming who we want to be?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Or is that some kind of societal force?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: What's the nature versus nurture thing here?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Yeah, so in that case, I just think, yeah, so violence

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: has massively declined over time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: I think that's a slow process of cultural evolution,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: institutional evolution, such that now the incentives for you

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: and I to be violent are very, very small indeed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: In contrast, when we were hunter-gatherers,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: the incentives were quite large.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: If there was someone who was potentially

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: disturbing the social order and hunter-gatherer setting,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: there was a very strong incentive to kill that person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And people did.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And it was just the guarded 10% of deaths among hunter-gatherers

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: were murders.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: After hunter-gatherers, when you have actual societies,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: is when violence can probably go up,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: because there's more incentive to do mass violence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: to take over or conquer other people's lands

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: and murder everybody in place and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Yeah, I mean, I think total death rate from human causes

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: does go down.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: But you're right that if you're in a hunter-gatherer

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: situation, you're kind of a group that you're part of

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: is very small, then you can't have massive wars,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: that just massive communities don't exist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: But anyway, the second question, do you think

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: most people want to do good?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Yeah, and then I think that is true for most people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: I think you see that with the fact that most people donate,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: a large proportion of people volunteer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: If you give people opportunities to easily help other people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: they will take it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: But at the same time, we're a product of our circumstances.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And if it were more socially rewarded

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: to be doing more good, if it were more socially rewarded

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: to do good effectively rather than not effectively,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: then we would see that behavior a lot more.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So why should we do good?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Yeah, my answer to this is there's

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: no kind of deeper level of explanation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So my answer to kind of why should you do good is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: well, there is someone whose life is on the line,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: for example, whose life you can save via donating just actually

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: a few thousand dollars to an effective nonprofit,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: like the Against Malaria Foundation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: That is a sufficient reason to do good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And then if you ask, well, why ought I to do that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: I'm like, I just show you the same facts again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: It's that fact that is the reason to do good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: There's nothing more fundamental than that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: I'd like to sort of make more concrete the thing we're

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: trying to make better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So you just mentioned malaria.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So there's a huge amount of suffering in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Are we trying to remove?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So is ultimately the goal, not ultimately,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: but the first step is to remove the worst of the suffering?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So there's some kind of threshold of suffering

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: that we want to make sure does not exist in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Or do we really naturally want to take a much further step

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: and look at things like income inequality?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So not just getting everybody above a certain threshold,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: but making sure that there is some, that broadly speaking,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: there's less injustice in the world, unfairness,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: in some definition, of course, very difficult

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: to define, and fairness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So the metric I use is how many people do we affect

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: and by how much do we affect them?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And so that can, often that means eliminating suffering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: But it doesn't have to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Could be helping promote a flourishing life instead.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And so if I was comparing reducing income inequality

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: or getting people from the very pits of suffering

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: to a higher level, the question I would ask

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: is just a quantitative one of just,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: if I do this first thing or the second thing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: how many people am I going to benefit?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And by how much am I going to benefit?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Am I going to move that one person from kind of 10%

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: or 0% well-being to 10% well-being?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Perhaps that's just not as good as moving 100 people

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: from 10% well-being to 50% well-being.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And the idea is the diminishing returns

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: is the idea of when you're in terrible poverty,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: then the $1 that you give goes much further

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: than if you were in the middle class in the United States,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: for example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And this fact is really striking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So if you take even just quite a conservative estimate

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: of how we are able to turn money into well-being,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: the economists put it as like a log curve, or steeper.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: But that means that any proportional increase

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: in your income has the same impact on your well-being.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And so someone moving from $1,000 a year to $2,000 a year

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: has the same impact as someone moving from $100,000 a year

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: to $200,000 a year.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And then when you combine that with the fact that we,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: in middle class members of rich countries,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: are 100 times richer in financial terms

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: than the global poor, that means we

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: can do 100 times to benefit the poorest people in the world

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: as we can to benefit people of our income level.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And that's this astonishing fact.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Yeah, it's quite incredible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: A lot of these facts and ideas are just

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: difficult to think about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Because there's an overwhelming amount of suffering

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And even acknowledging it is difficult.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: I'm not exactly sure why that is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: I mean, it's difficult because you have to bring to mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: It's an unpleasant experience thinking

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: about other people's suffering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: It's unpleasant to be empathizing with it, firstly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And then secondly, thinking about it

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: means that maybe we'd have to change our lifestyles.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And if you're very attached to the income that you've got,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: perhaps you don't want to be confronting ideas or arguments

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: that might cause you to use some of that money to help others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So it's quite understandable in the psychological terms,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: even if it's not the right thing that we ought to be doing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So how can we do better?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: How can we be more effective?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: How does data help?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: In general, how can we do better?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: It's definitely hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And we have spent the last 10 years

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: engaged in some deep research projects to try and answer

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: two questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: One is, of all the many problems the world is facing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: what are the problems we ought to be focused on?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And then within those problems that we

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: judge to be the most pressing, where

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: we use this idea of focusing on problems that

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: are the biggest in scale, that are the most tractable,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: where we can make the most progress on that problem,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: and that are the most neglected.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Within them, what are the things that have the best evidence

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: or we have the best guess that will do the most good?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And so we have a bunch of organizations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So GiveWell, for example, is focused

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: on global health and development and has

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: a list of seven top recommended charities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So the idea in general, and sorry to interrupt,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: is we'll talk about poverty and animal welfare

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: and existential risk.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Those are all fascinating topics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: But in general, the idea is there should be a group.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Sorry.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: There's a lot of groups that seek to convert money into good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And then you also, on top of that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: want to have an accounting of how good they actually

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: perform that conversion, how well they did in converting

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: money to good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So ranking of these different groups,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: ranking these charities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So does that apply across basically all aspects

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: of effective altruism?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So there should be a group of people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: and they should report on certain metrics

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: of how well they've done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And you should only give your money

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: to groups that do a good job.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: That's the core idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: I'd make two comments.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: One is just it's not just about money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So we're also trying to encourage people

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: to work in areas where they'll have the biggest impact.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And in some areas, they're really people heavy,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: but money poor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Other areas are kind of money rich and people poor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And so whether it's better to focus time or money

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: depends on the cause area.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And then the second is that you mentioned metrics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And while that's the ideal, and in some areas,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: we are able to get somewhat quantitative information

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: about how much impact an area is having.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: That's not always true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: For some of the issues, like you mentioned, existential risks,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: well, we're not able to measure in any sort of precise way

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: how much progress we're making.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And so you have to instead fall back on just rigorous argument

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: and evaluation, even in the absence of data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So let's first sort of linger on your own story for a second.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: How do you yourself practice effective altruism

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: in your own life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Because I think that's a really interesting place to start.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So I've tried to build effective altruism into at least

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: many components of my life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So on the donation side, my plan is

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: to give away most of my income over the course of my life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: I've set a bar I feel happy with,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: and I just donate above that bar.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So at the moment, I donate about 20% of my income.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Then on the career side, I've also

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: shifted kind of what I do, where I was initially

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: planning to work on very esoteric topics

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: in the philosophy of logic, philosophy of language,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: things that are intellectually extremely interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: But the path by which they really

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: make a difference to the world is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: let's just say it's very unclear at best.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And so I switched instead to researching ethics

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: to actually just working on this question of how we

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: can do as much good as possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And then I've also spent a very large chunk of my life

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]
