body.input: over the last 10 years creating a number of nonprofits who,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: again, in different ways are tackling this question of how

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: we can do the most good and helping

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: them to grow over time too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Yeah, we'll mention a few of them with the career

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: selection, 80,000.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: 80,000 hours.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: 80,000 hours is a really interesting group.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So maybe also just a quick pause on the origins

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: of effective altruism, because you paint a picture who

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: the key figures are, including yourself

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: in the effective altruism movement today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Yeah, there are two main strands that

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: came together to form the effective altruism movement.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So one was two philosophers, myself and Toby Ord at Oxford.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And we had been very influenced by the work of Peter Singer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: an Australian moral philosopher, who

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: had argued for many decades that because one can do so much

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: good at such little cost to oneself,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: we have an obligation to give away most of our income

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: to benefit those in extreme poverty,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: just in the same way that we have an obligation to run in

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: and save a child from drowning in a shallow pond

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: if it were just to ruin your suit that cost a few thousand

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: dollars.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And we set up Giving What We Can in 2009,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: which is encouraging people to give at least 10% of their income

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: to the most effective charities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And the second main strand was the formation

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: of Give Well, which was originally based in New York

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: and started in about 2007.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And that was set up by Holden Karnavisi and Eli Hassenfeld,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: who were two hedge fund dudes who were making good money

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: and thinking, well, where should I donate?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And in the same way as if they wanted

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: to buy a product for themselves, they

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: would look at Amazon reviews.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: They were like, well, what are the best charities?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Found they just weren't really good answers to that question,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: certainly not that they were satisfied with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And so they formed Give Well in order

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: to try and work out what are those charities where they

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: can have the biggest impact.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And then from there and some other influences,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: community grew and spread.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Can we explore the philosophical and political space

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: that effective altruism occupies a little bit?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So from the little and distant in my own lifetime

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: that I've read of Ayn Rand's work, Ayn Rand's philosophy

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: of objectivism, it espouses, and it's

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: interesting to put her philosophy in contrast

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: with effective altruism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So it espouses selfishness as the best thing you can do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: But it's not actually against altruism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: You have that choice, but you should be selfish in it, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Or not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Maybe you can disagree here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So it can be viewed as the complete opposite

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: of effective altruism, or it can be viewed as similar

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: because the word effective is really interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Because if you want to do good, then you

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: should be damn good at doing good, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: I think that would fit within the morality that's

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: defined by objectivism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So do you see a connection between these two philosophies

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: in other, perhaps, other, in this complicated space

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: of beliefs that effective altruism is positioned

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: as opposing or aligned with?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: I would definitely say that objectivism,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Ayn Rand's philosophy, is a philosophy that's

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: quite fundamentally opposed to effective altruism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: In which way?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Insofar as Ayn Rand's philosophy is about championing egoism

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: and saying that I'm never quite sure

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: whether the philosophy is meant to say that just you ought

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: to do whatever will best benefit yourself,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: that's ethical egoism, no matter what the consequences are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Or second, if there's this alternative view, which is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: well, you ought to try and benefit yourself

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: because that's actually the best way of benefiting society.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Certainly in Atlas Shluguchi is presenting her philosophy

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: as a way that's actually going to bring

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: about a flourishing society.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And if it's the former, then well, effective altruism

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: is all about promoting the idea of altruism

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: and saying, in fact, we ought to really be trying to help others

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: as much as possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So it's opposed there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And then on the second side, I would just

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: dispute the empirical premise.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Given the major problems in the world today,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: it would seem like this remarkable coincidence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Quite suspicious, one might say, if benefiting myself

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: was actually the best way to bring about a better world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So on that point, and I think that connects also

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: with career selection that we'll talk about,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: but let's consider not object to this, but capitalism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And the idea that you focusing on the thing that you are damn

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: good at, whatever that is, may be the best thing for the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Part of it is also mindset.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: The thing I love is robots.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So maybe I should focus on building robots

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: and never even think about the idea of effective altruism, which

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: is kind of the capitalist notion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Is there any value in that idea in just finding

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: the thing you're good at and maximizing

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: your productivity in this world, and thereby sort of lifting

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: all boats and benefiting society as a result?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Yeah, I think there's two things I'd want to say on that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So one is what your comparative advantages, what

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: your strengths are when it comes to career,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: is obviously super important because there's

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: lots of career paths I would be terrible at.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: If I thought being an artist was the best thing one could do,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: well, I'd be doomed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Just really quite astonishingly bad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And so I do think, at least within the realm of things

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: that could plausibly be very high impact,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: choose the thing that you think you're

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: going to be able to really be passionate at and excel at

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: over the long term.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Then on this question of should one just

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: do that in an unrestricted way and not even think about what

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: the most important problems are, I

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: do think that in a perfectly designed society,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: that might well be the case.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: That would be a society where we've corrected all market

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: failures, we've internalized all externalities,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: and then we've managed to set up incentives such that people

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: just pursuing their own strengths

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: is the best way of doing good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: But we're very far from that society.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So if one did that, then it would be very unlikely

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: that you would focus on improving

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: the lives of non-human animals that aren't participating

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: in markets or ensuring the long run future goes well

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: where future people certainly aren't participating

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: in markets or benefiting the global poor who do participate

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: but have so much less power from a starting perspective

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: that their views aren't accurately represented

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: by market forces too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Got it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So yeah, pure definition capitalism just

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: may very well ignore the people that are suffering the most,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: the white swath of them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So if you could allow me this line of thinking here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So I've listened to a lot of your conversations online.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: I find, if I can compliment you, they're

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: very interesting conversations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Your conversation on Rogan, on Joe Rogan

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: was really interesting with Sam Harris and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: There's a lot of stuff that's really good out there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And yet, when I look at the internet,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: and I look at YouTube, which has certain mobs,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: certain swaths of right leaning folks whom I dearly love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: I love all people, especially people with ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: They seem to not like you very much.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So I don't understand why exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So my own hypothesis is there is a right-left divide

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: that, absurdly so, caricatured in politics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: at least in the United States.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And maybe you're somehow pigeonholed

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: into one of those sides.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And maybe that's what it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Maybe your message is somehow politicized.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: How do you make sense of that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Because you're extremely interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Like, you got the comments I see on Joe Rogan.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: There's a bunch of negative stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And yet, if you listen to it, the conversation is fascinating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: I'm not speaking, I'm not some kind of lefty extremist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: But just this fascinating conversation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So why are you getting some small amount of hate?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So I'm actually pretty glad that effective altruism has

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: managed to stay relatively unpoliticized.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Because I think the core message, just use some of your time

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: and money to do as much good as possible to fight

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: some of the problems in the world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: can be appealing across the political spectrum.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And we do have a diversity of political viewpoints

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: among people who have engaged in effective altruism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: We do, however, do get some criticism

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: from the left and the right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Oh, interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Both would be interesting to hear.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So criticism from the left is that we're not

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: focused enough on dismantling the capitalist system

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: that they see as the root of most of the problems

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: that we're talking about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And there, I kind of disagree on partly the premise

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: where I don't think relevant alternative systems would say

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: to the animals or to the global poor

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: or to the future generations much better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And then also the tactics where I

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: think there are particular ways we can change society that

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: would be massively beneficial on those things that

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: don't go via dismantling the entire system, which

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: is perhaps a million times harder to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Then criticism on the right, there's definitely

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: in response to the Joe Rogan podcast,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: there definitely were a number of A and Land fans

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: who weren't keen on the idea of promoting altruism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So there's a colleague of mine calling the term abolitionism

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: for the idea that we should just be trying

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And in the long run, I mean, I don't expect it anytime soon,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: but I think we can.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: I think that would require quite fantastic changes

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: in fact, even changes to human nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: But I do think that suffering,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So there's a line, there's a gray area between suffering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Now I'm Russian, so I romanticize some aspects of suffering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: There's a gray line between struggle, gray area

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: between struggle and suffering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So one, do we want to eradicate all struggle in the world?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: from major health conditions or depression and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: If you were saying like in Russia,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: you know, no one else felt poor

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: because everyone around you was poor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Whereas now you've got this,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: these other people who are, you know, super rich

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: and maybe that makes you feel, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: less good about yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: There are some other things however,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: which are just intrinsically good or bad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So commuting, for example, it's just people hate it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: It doesn't really change.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Knowing that other people are commuting too,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: doesn't make it any kind of less bad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: But sort of to push back on that for a second, I mean, yes,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: but also if some people were, you know, on horseback,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: your commute on the train might feel a lot better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: You know, there is a relative,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: I mean, everybody's complaining about society today

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: forgetting it's forgetting how much better it is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: the better it is in the ages of our nature,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: how the technology is improved,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: fundamentally improving most of the world's lives.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Yeah, and actually there's some psychological research

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: on the wellbeing benefits of volunteering,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: where people who volunteer

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: tend to just feel happier about their lives.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And one of the suggested explanations is it because

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: it extends your reference class.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So no longer are you comparing yourself to the Joneses

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: who have their slightly better car,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: but you realize that, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: people in much worse conditions than you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And so now, you know, your life doesn't seem so bad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: That's actually on a psychological level,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: one of the fundamental benefits of effective altruism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Is, I mean, I guess it's the altruism part

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: of effective altruism is exposing yourself

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: to the suffering in the world allows you to be more,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: yeah, happier, and actually allows you

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: in a sort of meditative introspective way

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: realize that you don't need most of the wealth you have

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: to be happy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Absolutely, I mean, I think effective altruism

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: has been this huge benefit for me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And I really don't think that if I had more money

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: that I was living on, that that would change

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: my level of wellbeing at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Whereas engaging in something that I think is meaningful,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: that I think is steering humanity in a positive direction,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: that's extremely rewarding.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And so, yeah, I mean, despite my best attempts at sacrifice,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: I don't, you know, I think I've actually ended up happier

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: as a result of engaging in effective altruism

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: than I would have done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: That's such an interesting idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So let's talk about animal welfare.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Easy question, what is consciousness?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Especially as it has to do with the capacity to suffer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: I think there seems to be a connection

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: between how conscious something is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: the amount of consciousness and its ability to suffer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And that all comes into play about us thinking

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: how much suffering there is in the world

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: with regard to animals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So how do you think about animal welfare and consciousness?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Okay, well, consciousness, easy question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Yeah, I mean, I think we don't have a good understanding

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: My best guess is it's got, and by consciousness,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: I'm meaning what it feels like to be you,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: the subjective experience that seems to be different

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: from everything else we know about in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Yeah, I think it's clear it's very poorly understood

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: at the moment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: I think it has something to do with information processing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So the fact that the brain is a computer

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: or something like a computer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So that would mean that very advanced AI could be conscious,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: information processors in general could be conscious

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: with some suitable complexity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: But that also, some suitable complexity,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: it's a question whether greater complexity

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: creates some kind of greater consciousness,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: which relates to animals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Right, is there, if it's an information processing system

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: and it's smaller and smaller, is an ant less conscious

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: than a cow, less conscious than a monkey?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Yeah, and again, this super hard question,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: but I think my best guess is yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Like if I think, well, consciousness,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: it's not some magical thing that appears out of nowhere.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: It's not, Descartes thought it was just,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: comes in from this other realm

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: and then enters through the pineal gland in your brain

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: and that's kind of soul in its conscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So it's got something to do

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: with what's going on in your brain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: A chicken has one 300th of the size of the brain

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: that you have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Ants, I don't know how small it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Maybe it's a millionth the size.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: My best guess, which I may well be wrong about

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: because this is so hard, is that in some relevant sense,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: the chicken is experiencing consciousness

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: to a less degree than the human

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: and the ant significantly less again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: I don't think it's as little as 300th as much, I think.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: There's evolutionary reasons for thinking

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: that the ability to feel pain comes on the scene

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: relatively early on and we have lots of our brain

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: that's dedicated to stuff that doesn't seem to have to do

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: anything to do with consciousness,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: language processing and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So it seems like the easy,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: so there's a lot of complicated questions there

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: that we can't ask the animals about,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: but it seems that there's easy questions

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: in terms of suffering, which is things like factory farming

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: that could be addressed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Is that the lowest hanging fruit,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: if I may use crude terms here, of animal welfare?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Absolutely, I think that's the lowest hanging fruit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So at the moment we kill, we raise and kill

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: about 50 billion animals every year.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So how many?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: 50 billion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Yeah, so for every human on the planet,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: several times that number are being killed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And the vast majority of them are raised in factory farms

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: where basically whatever your view on animals,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: I think you should agree, even if you think,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: well, maybe it's not bad to kill an animal,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: maybe if the animal was raised in good conditions,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: that's just not the empirical reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: The empirical reality is that they are kept

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: in incredible cage confinement,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: they are de-beaked or detailed without anesthetic,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: chickens often peck each other to death,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: like otherwise, because of such stress.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: It's really, I think when a chicken gets killed,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: that's the best thing that happened to the chicken

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: in the course of its life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And it's also completely unnecessary.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: This is in order to save a few pence

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: for the price of meat or price of eggs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And we have indeed found,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: it's also just inconsistent with consumer preference

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: People who buy the products, if they could,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: they, when you do surveys,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: are extremely against suffering in factory farms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: It's just that they don't appreciate how bad it is

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: and just tend to go with the easy options.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And so then the best, the most effective programs

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: I know of at the moment are nonprofits that go to companies

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: and work with companies to get them to take a pledge

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: to cut certain sorts of animal products

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: like eggs from cage confinement out of their supply chain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And it's now the case that the top 50 food retailers

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: and fast food companies have all made these

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: kind of cage-free pledges.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And when you do the numbers, you get the conclusion

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: that every dollar you're giving to these nonprofits

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: result in hundreds of chickens being spared

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: from cage confinement.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And then they're working to other types of animals,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: other products too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So is that the most effective way to do,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: have a ripple effect essentially?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: As opposed to directly having regulation

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: from on top that says you can't do this?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So I would be more open to the regulation approach,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: but at least in the US,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: there's quite intense regulatory capture

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So let's talk about a topic I've talked a lot about

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Great, so the reason I started getting concerned

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: There are vast numbers of future people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: If we don't cause our own extinction,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So the future could be very big indeed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And it seems like we're potentially very early on

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: in civilization.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Then the second idea is just,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: well, maybe there are things

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Well, causing our own extinction,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: when it's serious people, even if they're a little bit,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: you know, dictatorial and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Do you think this mutually assured destruction idea

body.input: will carry, how far will it carry us

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Oh yeah, I think it's your point that nuclear weapons

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Well then perhaps that's just totally democratized,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: And then, yeah, I no longer trust mutually assured

body.input: destruction because for some people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: When they were finally apprehended,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: they hadn't stocks of saline gas

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: that were sufficient to kill four million people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: engaged in multiple terrorist acts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: If they had had the ability to print a virus at home,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So it's not impossible to imagine groups of people

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: and killing all humans?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: How hard is it to kill everybody?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Have you thought about this?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: I think it is very hard to kill everybody.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So in the case of, let's say, an all-out nuclear exchange,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: and let's say that leads to nuclear winter,

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: we don't really know, but it might well happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: That would, I think, result in billions of deaths.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: Would it kill everybody?

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: It's quite hard to see how it would kill everybody

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: for a few reasons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: One is just there's just so many people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: 7.5 billion people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Lex Fridman Podcast #84 – William MacAskill: Effective Altruism [Reupload]

body.input: So this bad event has to kill almost all of them.

body.input: They are rare.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: They stand out, and they give me hope.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: Also, this whole mess inspires me

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: on my small individual level to do the right thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: in the face of conformity, despite the long odds.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: I talked to Francis Collins.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: I talked to Albert Burla, Pfizer CEO.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: I also talked and will continue to talk with people like Jay

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: and other dissenting voices

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: that challenge the mainstream narratives

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: and those in the seats of power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: I hope to highlight both the strengths and weaknesses

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: in their ideas with respect and empathy,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: but also with guts and skill.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: The skill part, I hope to improve on over time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: And I do believe that conversation

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: and an open mind is the way out of this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: And finally, as I've said in the past,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: I value love and integrity

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: far, far above money, fame, and power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: Those latter three are all ephemeral.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: They slip through the fingers

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: of anyone who tries to hold on

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: and leave behind an empty shell of a human being.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: I prefer to die a man who lived by principles

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: that nobody could shake

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: and a man who added a bit of love to the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: To support it, please check out our sponsors

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: in the description.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: And now here's my conversation with Jay about a caria.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: To our best understanding today, how deadly is COVID?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: Do we have a good measure for this very question?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: So the best evidence for COVID,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: the deadliness of COVID comes from a whole series

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: of seroprevalence studies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: Seroprevalence studies are these studies

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: of antibody prevalence in the population at large.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: I was part of the very first set of seroprevalence studies,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: one in Santa Clara County, one in LA County,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: and one with Major League Baseball around the US.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: If I may just pause you for a second,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: if people don't know what serology is in seroprevalence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: it does sound like you say zero prevalence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: It's not, it's sero and serology is antibodies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: So it's a survey that counts the number of antibodies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: Specific to COVID, yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: People that have antibodies specific to COVID,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: which perhaps shows an indication

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: that they likely have had COVID,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: and therefore this is a way to study

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: how many people in the population have been exposed to,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: or have had COVID. Exactly, yeah, exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: So the idea is that we don't know exactly

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: the number of people with COVID just by counting

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: the people that present themselves with symptoms of COVID.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: COVID has, it turns out, a very wide range of symptoms,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254
