body.input: My daughter, who's 20, I guess she was 19 at the time, and my wife also volunteered to help with various aspects of the study.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: So at the eve of the study, they were going to go out in public.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: I didn't know what the death rate was because we hadn't done the study.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: I suspected it was lower than people were saying, but I didn't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: I knew about the age gradient because I'd seen the Chinese data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: My daughter is young, but my wife is my age.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: I didn't know the death rate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: I couldn't sleep the night before.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: What if I'm putting my family, my daughter and my wife at risk because of some activity that I'm doing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: It was kind of, I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: So it's worried about the well-being of others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: When you look in the mirror.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: If I die, I die.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: I mean, it's not, again, I'm Christian, so death is not the end for me, I believe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: And so I don't particularly worry about my own death, but I do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: I mean, I just, I think we can't help it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: We worry about the well-being of our loved ones.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: So from the perspective of God, then let me ask you, what do you think is the meaning of this whole journey we're on?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: What do you think is the meaning of life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: You know, it's very simple. Love one another.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: Treat your neighbor as yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: It's love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: Simple as that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: Well, I'd love to see a little bit more of that in this pandemic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: It's an opportunity for the best of our nature to shine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: It's, I've seen some of the worst, but I think some of that is just good therapy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: And I'm hoping in the end, what we have here is love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: At the very least, make your dad proud with some incredible rockets that we're launching out there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: I think you'd get along well with my dad, Lex.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: I definitely would.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: Thank you so much.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: This is an incredible honor to talk to you, Jay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: You've been an inspiration to so many people and keep fighting the good fight.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: Thank you so much for spending your valuable time with me today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: Thank you for having me here. Appreciate it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: Thanks for listening to this conversation with Jay Barakaria.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: To support this podcast, please check out our sponsors in the description.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: And now let me leave you with some words from Alice Walker.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: The most common way people give up their power is by thinking they don't have any.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jay Bhattacharya: The Case Against Lockdowns | Lex Fridman Podcast #254

body.input: Thank you for listening and hope to see you next time.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And now here's my conversation with David Chalmers.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Do you think we're living in a simulation?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I don't rule it out.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: There's probably gonna be a lot of simulations

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: in the history of the cosmos.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: If the simulation is designed well enough,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: it'll be indistinguishable from a non-simulated reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And although we could keep searching for evidence

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: that we're not in a simulation,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: any of that evidence in principle could be simulated.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So I think it's a possibility.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: But do you think the thought experiment is interesting

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: or useful to calibrate how we think

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: about the nature of reality?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Yeah, I definitely think it's interesting and useful.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: In fact, I'm actually writing a book about this right now,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: all about the simulation idea,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: using it to shed light

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: on a whole bunch of philosophical questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So the big one is how do we know anything

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: about the external world?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Descartes said, maybe you're being fooled by an evil demon

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: who's stimulating your brain into thinking all this stuff

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: is real when in fact it's all made up.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Well, the modern version of that is how do you know

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: you're not in a simulation?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And the thought is, if you're in a simulation,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: none of this is real.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So that's teaching us something about knowledge.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: How do you know about the external world?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I think there's also really interesting questions

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: about the nature of reality right here.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: If we are in a simulation, is all this real?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Is there really a table here?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Is it really a microphone? Do I really have a body?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: The standard view would be, no, we don't.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: None of this would be real.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: My view is actually that's wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And even if we are in a simulation, all of this is real.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: That's why I call this reality 2.0,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: new version of reality, different version of reality,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: still reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So what's the difference between quote unquote real world

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: and the world that we perceive?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So we interact with the world by perceiving it.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: It only really exists through the window

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: of our perception system and in our mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So what's the difference between something that's

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: quote unquote real that exists perhaps without us being there

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: and the world as you perceive it?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Well, the world as we perceive it is a very simplified

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: and distorted version of what's going on

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: underneath.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: We already know that from just thinking about science.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: You don't see too many obviously quantum mechanical effects

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: in what we perceive.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: But we still know quantum mechanics

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: is going on under all things.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I like to think the world we perceive

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: is this very simplified picture of colors and shapes

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: existing in space and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And we know that's what the philosopher Wilfred Sellers

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: called the manifest image, the world as it seems to us.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: We already know underneath all that

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: is a very different scientific image with atoms or quantum

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: wave functions or super strings or whatever the latest thing is.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And that's the ultimate scientific reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So I think of the simulation idea

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: as basically another hypothesis about what the ultimate, say,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: quasi-scientific or metaphysical reality is going on underneath

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: the world of the manifest image.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: The world of the manifest image is this very simple thing

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: that we interact with that's neutral on the underlying

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: stuff of reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Science can help tell us about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Maybe philosophy can help tell us about that too.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And if we eventually take the red pill

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: and find out we're in a simulation,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: my view is that's just another view about what reality

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: is made of.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: The philosopher Immanuel Kant said,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: what is the nature of the thing in itself?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: He said, what is the nature of the thing in itself?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Well, I think of the simulation idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: It's a hypothesis about the nature of the thing in itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: It turns out if we're in a simulation, the thing in itself,

body.input: nature of this glass, it's OK.

body.input: It's actually a bunch of data structures

body.input: running on a computer in the next universe up.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Yeah, that's what people tend to do

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: when they think about simulation.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: They think about our modern computers

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: and somehow trivially, crudely just scaled up in some sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: But do you think the simulation, in order

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: at which that baby is not conscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: The baby starts from maybe, I don't know,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: from a few cells, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: There's a certain point at which it becomes,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: consciousness arrives, it's conscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Of course we can't know exactly that line,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: but that's a useful idea that we do create consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Again, a really dumb thing for me to say,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: but not until now that I realized

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: we do engineer consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: We get to watch the process happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: We don't know which point it happens or where it is,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: but we do see the birth of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Yeah, I mean, there's a question of course,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: is whether babies are conscious when they're born.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And it used to be, it seems at least some people

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: when they circumcised them.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And so now people think, oh, that would be incredibly cruel.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Of course babies feel pain, and now the dominant view

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: is that the babies can feel pain.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Actually my partner, Claudia, works on this whole issue

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: of whether there's consciousness in babies

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: and of what kind.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And she certainly thinks that newborn babies

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: come into the world with some degree of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Of course then you can just extend the question backwards

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: to fetuses, and suddenly you're into

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: politically controversial territory.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: But the question also arises in the animal kingdom.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Where does consciousness start or stop?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Is there a line in the animal kingdom

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: where the first conscious organisms are?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: It's interesting, over time people are becoming

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: more and more liberal about describing consciousness

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: to animals.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: People used to think maybe only mammals could be conscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Now most people seem to think sure, fish are conscious,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: they can feel pain, and now we're arguing over insects.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: You'll find people out there who say plants

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: have some degree of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So who knows where it's gonna end?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: The far end of this chain is the view that every

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: physical system has some degree of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Philosophers call that panpsychism.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I take that view.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I mean that's a fascinating way to view reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So if you could talk about, if you can linger on panpsychism

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: for a little bit, what does it mean?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So it's not just plants are conscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I mean it's that consciousness is a fundamental fabric

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: of reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: What does that mean to you?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: How are we supposed to think about that?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Well we're used to the idea that some things in the world

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: are fundamental, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: In physics, we take things like space or time or space time,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: mass, charge as fundamental properties of the universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: You don't reduce them to something simpler.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: You take those for granted.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: You've got some laws that connect them.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Here is how mass and space and time evolve.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Theories like relativity or quantum mechanics

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: or some future theory that will unify them both.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: But everyone says you gotta take some things

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: as fundamental.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And if you can't explain one thing in terms

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: of the previous fundamental things, you have to expand.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Maybe something like this happened with Maxwell.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: You ended up with fundamental principles

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: of electromagnetism and took charge as fundamental

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: because it turned out that was the best way to explain it.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So I at least take seriously the possibility

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: something like that could happen with consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Take it as a fundamental property like space, time and mass.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And instead of trying to explain consciousness wholly

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: in terms of the evolution of space, time and mass

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: and so on, take it as a primitive

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: and then connect it to everything else

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: by some fundamental laws.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: There's this basic problem that the physics we have now

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: looks great for solving the easy problems of consciousness

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: They give us a complicated structure and dynamics

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: which is great for the problems of explaining how we walk

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: and how we talk and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Those are the easy problems of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: But the hard problem was this problem

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: about subjective experience just doesn't look

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: like that kind of problem about structure, dynamics,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: how things behave.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: yes, there has to be a connecting point

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: and it could be at the very axiomatic,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: at the very beginning level.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: At that point, the word consciousness

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: is already beyond the reach of our current understanding.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: that means that basically another way to put that,

body.input: if that's true, then we understand almost nothing

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: about that fundamental aspect of the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I can understand ant, I can't understand an atom,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So I'm comfortable with living things on earth,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And that is understandable intuitively.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Of course, you anthropomorphize,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: but I can understand that kind of belief, that kind of idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And I mean, I personally love robots

body.input: and I have a deep connection with robots.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So I also probably anthropomorphize them.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So, but to say that panpsychism,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: why can't local consciousness give the world meaning too?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So I think my consciousness gives my world meaning.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Is the origin of meaning for your world.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Yeah, I experience things as good or bad,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: happy, sad, interesting, important.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So my consciousness invests this world with meaning.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Without any consciousness, maybe it would be a bleak,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: meaningless universe, but I don't see why I need

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: someone else's consciousness or even God's consciousness

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: to give this universe meaning.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Here we are, local creatures with our own

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: subjective experiences.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I think we can give the universe meaning ourselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I mean, maybe to some people that feels inadequate.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Yeah, our own local consciousness is somehow too puny

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: and insignificant to invest any of this

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: with cosmic significance, and maybe God gives you

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: a sense of cosmic significance,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: but I'm just speculating here.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So it's a really interesting idea that consciousness

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: is the thing that makes life meaningful.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: If you could maybe just briefly explore that for a second.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So I suspect just from listening to you now,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: you mean in an almost trivial sense,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: just the day-to-day experiences of life have,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: because you attach identity to it, they become,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I guess I wanna ask something I would always want to ask,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: a legit world-renowned philosopher,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: what is the meaning of life?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So I suspect you don't mean consciousness gives

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: any kind of greater meaning to it all,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: and more to day-to-day, but is there greater meaning

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: to it all?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I think life has meaning for us because we are conscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So without consciousness, no meaning,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: consciousness invests our life with meaning.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So consciousness is the source of the meaning of life,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: but I wouldn't say consciousness itself

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: is the meaning of life.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I'd say what's meaningful in life is basically

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: what we find meaningful, what we experience as meaningful.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So if you find meaning and fulfillment and value

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: in say, intellectual work, like understanding,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: then that's a very significant part

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: of the meaning of life for you.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: If you find it in social connections,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: or in raising a family, then that's the meaning

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: of life for you.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: The meaning kind of comes from what you value

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: as a conscious creature.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So I think on this view, there's no universal solution,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: no universal answer to the question,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: what is the meaning of life?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: The meaning of life is where you find it

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: as a conscious creature, but it's consciousness

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: that somehow makes value possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Experiencing some things as good or as bad

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: or as meaningful, somehow comes from within consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So you think consciousness is a crucial component,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: ingredient of assigning value to things?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I mean, it's kind of a fairly strong intuition

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: that without consciousness, there wouldn't really be

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: a universe of unconscious creatures,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: would anything be better or worse than anything else?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Certainly when it comes to ethical dilemmas,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: you know about the old trolley problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Well, I've got a variant on this,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: who are not conscious on the other track.

body.input: being or the five unconscious robots?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Most people have a fairly clear intuition here.

body.input: Kill the unconscious beings,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: because they basically, they don't have a meaningful life.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: an unconscious being.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So in philosophical terms, you refer to as a zombie,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: it's a useful thought experiment,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: but we don't yet have them.

body.input: So that's kind of what we may be able to create with robots.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Yeah, they're merely hypothetical for now.

body.input: I mean, the extreme case of a zombie is a being

body.input: which is physically, functionally,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: in this universe.

body.input: The question is just,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: But there are less extreme versions of this,
