metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: it's gonna behave roughly like me.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Of course, at the beginning,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: there'll be a question about

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: whether a perfect clone is possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So I may wanna ask it lots of questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: To see if it's consciousness

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: and the way it talks about its consciousness

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: and the way it reacts to things in general is like me

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: and that will occupy us for a while.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: For a while.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So basic unit testing on the early models.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So if it's a perfect clone,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: you say that it's gonna behave exactly like you.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So that takes us to free will.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Mm-hmm.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So is there a free will?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Are we able to make decisions

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: that are not predetermined

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: from the initial conditions of the universe?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: You know, philosophers do this annoying thing

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: of saying it depends what you mean.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So in this case, yeah,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: it really depends on what you mean by free will.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: If you mean something which was not determined in advance,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: could never have been determined,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: then I don't know if we have free will.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I mean, there's quantum mechanics

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: and who's to say if that opens up some room,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: but I'm not sure we have free will in that sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I'm also not sure that's the kind of free will

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: that really matters.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Mm-hmm.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: You know, what matters to us

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: is being able to do what we want

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: and to create our own futures.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: We've got this distinction between having our lives

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: be under our control and under someone else's control.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: We've got the sense of actions that we are responsible for

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: versus ones that we're not.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I think you can make those distinctions

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: even in a deterministic universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And this is what people call the compatibilist view

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: of free will where it's compatible with determinism.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So I think for many purposes,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: the kind of free will that matters

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: is something we can have in a deterministic universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And I can't see any reason in principle

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: why an AI system couldn't have free will of that kind.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: If you mean super duper free will,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: the ability to violate the laws of physics

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: and doing things that in principle could not be predicted,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I don't know, maybe no one has that kind of free will.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: What's the connection between the reality of free will

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: and the experience of it,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: the subjective experience in your view?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So how does consciousness connect to this,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: to the experience of,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: to the reality and the experience of free will?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: It's certainly true that when we make decisions

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: and when we choose and so on,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: we feel like we have an open future.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Feel like I could do this,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I could go into philosophy or I could go into math.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I could go to a movie tonight,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I could go to a restaurant.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So we experience these things as if the future is open.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And maybe we experience ourselves

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: as exerting a kind of effect on the future

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: that somehow picking out one path from many paths

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: were previously open.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And you might think that actually,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: if we're in a deterministic universe,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: there's a sense of which objectively,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: those paths weren't really open all along.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Subjectively, they were open.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And that's, I think that's what really matters

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: in making decisions,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: where our experience of making a decision

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: is choosing a path for ourselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I mean, in general, our introspective models of the mind,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I think are generally very distorted representations

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: of the mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So it may well be that our experience of ourselves

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: in making a decision,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: our experience of what's going on,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: doesn't terribly well mirror what's going on.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I mean, maybe there are antecedents in the brain

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: way before anything came into consciousness

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Those aren't represented in our introspective model.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So in general, our experience of perception,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: so I experience a perceptual image of the external world.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: It's not a terribly good model of what's actually going on

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: in my visual cortex and so on,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: which has all these layers and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: It's just one little snapshot of one bit of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So in general, introspective models are very oversimplified

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: and it wouldn't be surprising

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: if that was true of free will as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: This also incidentally,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: can be applied to consciousness itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: There is this very interesting view

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: that consciousness itself is an introspective illusion.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: In fact, we're not conscious,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: the brain just has these introspective models of itself

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: where it oversimplifies everything

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: and represents itself as having these special properties

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: It's a really simple way to kind of keep track of itself

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And then on the illusionist view,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: yeah, that's just an illusion.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I find this view, when I find it implausible,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I do find it very attractive in some ways,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: because it's easy to tell some story

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: about how the brain would create introspective models

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: of its own consciousness, of its own free will

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: as a way of simplifying itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I mean, it's a similar way when we perceive

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: the external world,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: we perceive it as having these colors

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: that maybe it doesn't really have,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: because that's a really useful way of keeping tracks,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: of keeping track.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Did you say that you find it not very plausible?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Because I find it both plausible and attractive

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: in some sense, because I mean,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: that kind of view is one

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: that has the minimum amount of mystery around it.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: You can kind of understand that kind of view.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Everything else says we don't understand

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: so much of this picture.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: No, it is very attractive.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I recently wrote an article all about

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: this kind of issue called the meta problem of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: The hard problem is,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: how does the brain give you consciousness?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: The meta problem is, why are we puzzled

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: by the hard problem of consciousness?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And because, you know, our being puzzled by it,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: that's ultimately a bit of behavior.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: We might be able to explain that bit of behavior

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: as one of the easy problems, consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So maybe there'll be some computational model

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: that explains why we're puzzled by consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: The meta problem has come up with that model.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And I've been thinking about that a lot lately.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: There's some interesting stories you can tell

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: about why the right kind of computational system

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: might develop these introspective models of itself

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: that attributed itself these special properties.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So that meta problem is a research program for everyone.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And then if you've got attraction to sort of simple views,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: desert landscapes, and so on,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: then you can go all the way with what people call illusionism

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: and say, in fact, consciousness itself is not real.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: What is real is just these introspective models we have

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: that tell us that we're conscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So the view is very simple, very attractive,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: very powerful.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: The trouble is, of course, it has to say that

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: deep down, consciousness is not real.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: We're not actually experiencing right now.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And it looks like it's just contradicting

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: a fundamental datum of our existence.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And this is why most people find this view crazy,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: just as they find panpsychism crazy in one way.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: People find illusionism crazy in another way.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: But I mean, but so yes,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: it has to deny this fundamental datum of our existence now.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And that makes the view sort of frankly unbelievable

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: for most people.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: On the other hand, the view developed right

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: might be able to explain why we find it unbelievable.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Because these models are so deeply hardwired into our head.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And they're all integrated.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: You can't escape the illusion.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And as a crazy possibility,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: is it possible that the entirety of the universe,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: our planet, all the people in New York,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: all the organisms on our planet,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: including me here today are not real in that sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: They're all part of an illusion

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: inside of Dave Chalmers' head.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I think all this could be a simulation.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: No, but not just a simulation.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Because the simulation kind of is outside of you.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: A dream?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: What if it's all an illusion,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: yes, a dream that you're experiencing,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: that's it's all in your mind?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Can you take illusionism that far?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Well, there's illusionism about the external world

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: and illusionism about consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And these might go in different.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Illusionism about the external world

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: kind of takes you back to Descartes.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And yeah, could all this be produced by an evil demon?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Descartes himself also had the dream argument.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: He said, how do you know you're not dreaming right now?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: How do you know this is not an amazing dream?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I think it's at least a possibility that, yeah,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: this could be some super duper complex dream

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: in the next universe up.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I guess though, my attitude is that just as,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I mean, Descartes thought that

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: if the evil demon was doing it, it's not real.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: A lot of people these days say if a simulation is doing it,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: it's not real.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: As I was saying before, I think even if it's a simulation,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: that doesn't stop this from being real.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: It just tells us what the world is made of.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Likewise, if it's a dream,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: it could turn out that all this is like my dream

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: created by my brain in the next universe up.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: My own view is that wouldn't stop this physical world

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: from being real.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: It would turn out this cup at the most fundamental level

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: was made of a bit of, say, my consciousness

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: in the dreaming mind at the next level up.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Maybe that would give you a kind of weird kind

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: of panpsychism about reality,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: but it wouldn't show that the cup isn't real.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: It would just tell us it's ultimately made of processes

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: in my dreaming mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So I'd resist the idea that if the physical world

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: is a dream, then it's an illusion.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: That is right.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: By the way, perhaps you have an interesting thought

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Why is Descartes' demon or genius considered evil?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Why couldn't it have been a benevolent one

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: that had the same powers?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Yeah, I mean, Descartes called it the melangeanie,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: the evil genie or evil genius.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Maline, I guess, was the word.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: But yeah, it's an interesting question.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I mean, a later philosophy, Barclay,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: said, no, in fact, all this is done by God.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: God actually supplies you all of these perceptions

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: and ideas, and that's how physical reality is sustained.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And interestingly, Barclay's God is doing something

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: that doesn't look so different from what Descartes'

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: evil demon was doing.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: It's just that Descartes thought it was deception

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: and Barclay thought it was not.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And I'm actually more sympathetic to Barclay here.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Yeah, this evil demon may be trying to deceive you,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: but I think, okay, well, the evil demon may just be

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: under the, working under a false philosophical theory.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: It thinks it's deceiving you, it's wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: It's like those machines in the matrix.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: They thought they were deceiving you

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: that all this stuff is real.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I think, no, if we're in a matrix, it's all still real.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Yeah, the philosopher, O.K. Buschmeier,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: had a nice story about this about 50 years ago

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: about Descartes' evil demon, where he said,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: this demon spends all its time trying to fool people,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: but fails because somehow all the demon ends up doing

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: is constructing realities for people.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So yeah, I think that maybe it's very natural

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: to take this view that if we're in a simulation

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: or evil demon scenario or something,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: then none of this is real,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: but I think it may be ultimately a philosophical mistake,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: especially if you take on board sort of the view of reality

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: or what matters to reality is really its structure,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: something like its mathematical structure and so on,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: which seems to be the view that a lot of people take

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: from contemporary physics, and it looks like you can find

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: all that mathematical structure in a simulation,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: maybe even in a dream and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So as long as that structure is real,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: I would say that's enough for the physical world to be real.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Yeah, the physical world may turn out

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: and have a surprising nature,

body.input: but we're already gotten very used to that

body.input: or at least highly beneficial for creating an AGI system?

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: Yeah, no one knows what consciousness is for functionally,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: so right now there's no specific thing we can point to

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: and say you need consciousness for that.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: So my inclination is to believe that in principle,

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: AGI is possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: The very least, I don't see why someone couldn't simulate

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

body.input: And if that's possible, I'm sure vastly many other

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69

metadata.title: Podcast: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #69
