metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: because what you need is you need the research universities,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: you need the companies that are driving AI and quantum work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: You need governments who will ultimately be regulating

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: certain elements of this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And you also need the media to be knowledgeable and trained

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: so we don't get sort of overreactions to one situation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: which then goes viral and it ends up shutting down avenues

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: that are perfectly fine to be walking down

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: or running down that avenue.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: But if enough discordant information,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: not even correct necessarily,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: sort of gets pushed around society,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: then you can end up with a really hostile regulatory

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: environment and other things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: So you have four drivers that have to be integrated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And so if the new school of computing can be really helpful

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: in that regard, then that's a real service to science

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: and it's a service to MIT.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: So that's why I wanted to get involved for both areas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And the hope is for me, for others, for everyone,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: for the world is for this new school of computing

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: to be a beacon and a connector for these ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Yeah, that's right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: I mean, I think MIT is perfectly positioned to do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: So you've mentioned the media, social media, the internet,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: as this complex network of communication with laws, perhaps.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Perhaps you can speak to them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: But I personally think that science and technology

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: has its flaws, but ultimately is, one, sexy, exciting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: It's the way for us to explore and understand

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: the mysteries of our world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And two, perhaps more importantly for some people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: it's a huge way to, a really powerful way to,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: I think, to be able to connect with people

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: and to be able to do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: So I think that's a huge way to, a really powerful way

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: to grow the economy, to improve the quality of life for everyone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: So how do we get, how do you see the media, social media,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: the internet, as a society, having a healthy discourse

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: about science, first of all, one that's factual,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: one that pushes it forward, especially in this science fiction,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: fear-filled field of artificial intelligence?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Well, I think that's a little above my pay grade,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: because trying to control social media to make it do what you want to do

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: appears to be beyond almost anybody's control.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And the technology is being used to create what I call

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: the tyranny of the minorities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: A minority is defined as two or three people on a street corner.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Doesn't matter what they look like, doesn't matter where they came from.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: They're united by that one issue that they care about,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: and their job is to enforce their views on the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And in the political world, people just are manufacturing truth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And they throw it all over, and it affects all of us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And sometimes people are just hired to do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: I mean, it's amazing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And you think it's one person, it's really just sort of a front

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: for a particular point of view.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And this has become exceptionally disruptive for society,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: and it's dangerous, and it's undercutting the ability of liberal democracies to function.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And I don't know how to get a grip on this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And I was really surprised when we was up here for the announcement

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: last spring of the College of Computing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: and they had all these famous scientists,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: some of whom were involved with the invention.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And almost every one of them got up and said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: I think I made a mistake.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And as a non-scientist, I never thought I'd hear anyone say that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And what they said is, more or less, to make it simple,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: we thought this would be really cool, inventing the internet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: We could connect everyone in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: We can move knowledge around.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: It was instantaneous.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: It's a really amazing thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: He said, I don't know that there was anyone who ever thought about social media

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: coming out of that and the actual consequences for people's lives.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: There's always some younger person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: I just saw one of these yesterday.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: It was reported on the national news.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: It killed himself when people used social media

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: to basically sort of ridicule him or something of that type.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: This is dead.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: This is dangerous.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And so I don't have a solution for that other than going forward.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: You can't end up with this type of outcome using AI.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And if you make this kind of mistake twice is unforgivable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: So interestingly, at least in the West and parts of China,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: people are quite sympathetic to sort of the whole concept of AI ethics

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: and what gets introduced when and cooperation within your own country,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: within your own industry, as well as globally

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: to make sure that the technology is a force for good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And that really interesting topic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Since 2007, you've had a relationship with senior leadership with a lot of people in China

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: and an interest in understanding modern China, their culture, their world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Much like with Russia, I'm from Russia originally.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Americans are told a very narrow one-sided story about China

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: that I'm sure misses a lot of fascinating complexity, both positive and negative.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: What lessons about Chinese culture, its ideas as a nation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: its future do you think Americans should know about, deliberate on, think about?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Well, it's sort of a wide question that you're asking about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: You know, China is a pretty unusual place.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: First, it's huge. You know, it's physically huge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: It's got a billion three people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And the character of the people isn't as well understood in the United States.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Chinese people are amazingly energetic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: If you're one of a billion three people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: one of the things you've got to be focused on is how do you make your way, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: through a crowd of a billion 2.999999 other people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Another word for that is competitive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Yes, they are individually highly energetic, highly focused,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: always looking for some opportunity for themselves because they need to,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: because there's an enormous amount of just literally people around.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And so, you know, what I've found is they'll try and find a way to win for themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And their country is complicated

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: because it basically doesn't have the same kind of functional laws

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: that we do in the United States, in the West.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And the country is controlled really through a web of relationships you have with other people

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: and the relationships that those other people have with other people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: So it's an incredibly dynamic culture where if somebody knocks somebody up on the top

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: who's three levels above you and is in effect protecting you,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: then you're like a sort of a floating molecule there without tethering,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: except the one or two layers above you, but that's going to get affected.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: So it's a very dynamic system and getting people to change is not that easy

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: because if there aren't really functioning laws, it's only the relationships that everybody has.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And so when you decide to make a major change and you sign up for it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: something is changing in your life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: There won't necessarily be all the same people on your team.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And that's a very high-risk enterprise.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: So when you're dealing with China, it's important to know almost what everybody's relationship is with somebody.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: So when you suggest doing something differently, you line up these forces.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: In the West, it's usually you talk to a person and they figure out what's good for them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: It's a lot easier.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And in that sense, in a funny way, it's easier to make change in the West, just the opposite of what people think.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: But once the Chinese system adjusts to something that's new, everybody's on the team.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: It's hard to change them, but once they're changed,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: they are incredibly focused in a way that it's hard for the West to do in a more individualistic culture.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: So there are all kinds of fascinating things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: One thing that might interest the people who are listening,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: who are more technologically based than some other group,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: I was with one of the top people in the government a few weeks ago,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: and he was telling me that every school child in China is going to be taught computer science.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Now imagine 100% of these children.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: This is such a large number of human beings.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Now, that doesn't mean that every one of them will be good at computer science,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: but if it's sort of like in the West, if it's like math or English, everybody's going to take it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Not everybody's great at English. They don't write books. They don't write poetry.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And not everybody's good at math.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Somebody like myself, I sort of evolved to the third grade, and I'm still doing flashcards.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: I didn't make it further in math.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: But imagine everybody in their society is going to be involved with computer science.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: I just even pause on that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: I think computer science involves at the basic beginner level programming,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: and the idea that everybody in the society would have some ability to program a computer is incredible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: For me, it's incredibly exciting, and I think that should give the United States pause

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: and consider what talking about philanthropy and launching things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: there's nothing like launching, sort of investing in young youth, the education system,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: because that's where everything launches.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Yes. Well, we've got a complicated system because we have over 3,000 school districts around the country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: China doesn't worry about that as a concept.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: They make a decision at the very top of the government that that's what they want to have happen,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: and that is what will happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And we're really handicapped by this distributed power in the education area,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: although some people involved with that area will think it's great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: But you would know better than I do what percent of American children have computer science exposure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: My guess, no knowledge, would be 5% or less.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And if we're going to be going into a world where the other major economic power,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: sort of like ourselves, has got like 100%, and we got 5%,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: and the whole computer science area is the future,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: then we're purposely or accidentally actually handicapping ourselves,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: and our system doesn't allow us to adjust quickly to that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: So, you know, issues like this, I find fascinating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And, you know, if you're lucky enough to go to other countries, which I do,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: and you learn what they're thinking,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: then it informs what we ought to be doing in the United States.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: So the current administration, Donald Trump, has released an executive order on artificial intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: I'm not sure if you're familiar with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: In 2019, looking several years ahead, how does America, sort of, we've mentioned in terms of the big impact,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: we hope your investment at MIT will have a ripple effect,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: but from a federal perspective, from a government perspective,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: how does America establish, with respect to China, leadership in the world at the top for research and development in AI?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: I think that you have to get the federal government in the game in a big way,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: and that this leap forward technologically, which is going to happen with or without us,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: you know, really should be with us,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: and it's an opportunity, in effect, for another moonshot kind of mobilization by the United States.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: I think the appetite actually is there to do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: At the moment, what's getting in the way is the kind of poisonous politics we have,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: but if you go below the lack of cooperation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: which is almost the defining element of American democracy right now in the Congress,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: if you talk to individual members, they get it, and they would like to do something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Another part of the issue is we're running huge deficits.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: We're running trillion-dollar-plus deficits.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: So how much money do you need for this initiative?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Where does it come from?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Who's prepared to stand up for it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Because if it involves taking away resources from another area,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: our political system is not real flexible to do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: If you're creating this kind of initiative, which we need, where does the money come from?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And trying to get money when you've got trillion-dollar deficits, in a way, could be easy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: What's the difference of a trillion and a trillion a little more?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: But, you know, it's hard with the mechanisms of Congress.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: But what's really important is this is not an issue that is unknown,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: and it's viewed as a very important issue.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And there's almost no one in the Congress, when you sit down and explain what's going on,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: who doesn't say, we've got to do something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Let me ask the impossible question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: You didn't endorse Donald Trump, but after he was elected, you have given him advice,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: which seems to me a great thing to do, no matter who the president is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: to contribute, positively contribute to this nation by giving advice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And yet you've received a lot of criticism for this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: So on the previous topic of science and technology and government,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: how do we have healthy discourse, give advice, get excited conversation with the government

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: about science and technology without it becoming politicized?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Well, it's very interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: So when I was young, before there was a moonshot, we had a president named John F. Kennedy

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: from Massachusetts here, and in his inaugural address as president,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: he asked not what your country can do for you, but what you can do for your country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: We had a generation of people my age, basically people who grew up with that credo.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And sometimes you don't need to innovate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: You can go back to basic principles, and that's a good basic principle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: What can we do?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Americans have GDP per capita of around $60,000.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: It's not equally distributed, but it's big.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And people have, I think, an obligation to help their country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And I do that, and apparently I take some grief from some people

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: who project on me things I don't even vaguely believe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: But I'm quite simple.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: I tried to help the previous president, President Obama.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: He was a good guy, and he was a different party.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And I tried to help President Bush, and he's a different party.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And I sort of don't care that much about what the parties are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: I care about, even though I'm a big donor for the Republicans,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: but what motivates me is what are the problems we're facing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Can I help people get to sort of a good outcome that'll stand any test?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: But we live in a world now where the filters and the hostility is so unbelievable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: In the 1960s, when I went to school in the university, I went to Yale,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: and we had so much stuff going on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: We had a war called the Vietnam War.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: We had sort of black power starting,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: and we had a sexual revolution with the birth control pill.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And there was one other major thing going on, and the drug revolution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: There hasn't been a generation that had more stuff going on in a four-year period than my era.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Yet, there wasn't this kind of instant hostility if you believed something different.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Everybody lived together and respected the other person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And I think that this type of change needs to happen,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: and it's got to happen from the leadership of our major institutions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And I don't think that leaders can be bullied by people who are against

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: sort of the classical version of free speech and letting open expression and inquiry.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: That's what universities are for, among other things, Socratic methods.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: So I have, in the midst of this onslaught of oddness,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: I believe in still the basic principles, and we're going to have to find a way to get back to that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And that doesn't start with the people sort of in the middle to the bottom

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: who are using these kinds of screens to shout people down and create an uncooperative environment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: It's got to be done at the top with core principles that are articulated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And ironically, if people don't sign on to these kind of core principles where people are equal

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: and speech can be heard and you don't have these enormous shout down biases subtly or out loud,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: then they don't belong at those institutions. They're violating the core principles.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And that's how you end up making change.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: But you have to have courageous people who are willing to lay that out for the benefit of not just their institutions,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: but for society as a whole. So I believe that will happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: But it needs the commitment of senior people to make it happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Courage. And I think for such great leaders, great universities, there's a huge hunger for it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: So I am too very optimistic that it will come.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: I'm now personally taking a step into building a startup, first time, hoping to change the world, of course.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: There are thousands, maybe more, maybe millions of other first time entrepreneurs like me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: What advice you've gone through this process?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: You've talked about the suffering, the emotional turmoil it all might entail.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: What advice do you have for those people taking that step?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: I'd say it's a rough ride. And you have to be psychologically prepared for things going wrong with frequency.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: You have to be prepared to be put in situations where you're being asked to solve problems you didn't even know those problems existed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: For example, renting space. It's not really a problem unless you've never done it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: You have no idea what a lease looks like. You don't even know the relevant rent in a market.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: So everything is new. Everything has to be learned.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: What you realize is that it's good to have other people with you who've had some experience in areas where you don't know what you're doing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Unfortunately, an entrepreneur starting doesn't know much of anything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: So everything is something new. I think it's important not to be alone because it's sort of overwhelming.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: You need somebody to talk to other than a spouse or a loved one because even they get bored with your problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: If you look at Alibaba, Jack Ma was telling me they basically were like a financial death store at least twice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And the fact that it wasn't just Jack. I mean, people think it is because he became the sort of public face and the driver.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: But a group of people who can give advice, share situations to talk about, that's really important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And that's not just referring to the small details like renting space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: No.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: It's also the psychological burden.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Because most entrepreneurs at some point question what they're doing because it's not going so well or they're screwing it up and they don't know how to unscrew it up because we're all learning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And it's hard to be learning when there are like 25 variables going on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: If you're missing four big ones, you can really make a mess.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And so the ability to in effect have either an outsider who's really smart that you can rely on for certain type of things or other people who are working with you on a daily basis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Most people who haven't had experience believe in the myth of the one person, one great person, makes outcomes, creates outcomes that are positive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Most of us, it's not like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: If you look back over a lot of the big successful tech companies, it's not typically one person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And you will know these stories better than I do because it's your world, not mine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: But even I know that almost everyone of them had two people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: I mean, if you look at Google, that's what they had.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And that was the same at Microsoft at the beginning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And it was the same at Apple.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: People have different skills and they need to play off of other people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: So the advice that I would give you is make sure you understand that so you don't head off in some direction as a lone wolf and find that either you can't invent all the solutions or you make bad decisions on certain types of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: This is a team sport.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Entrepreneur means you're alone in effect.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And that's the myth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: But it's mostly a myth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Yeah, I think you talk about this in your book and I could talk to you about it forever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: The harshly self-critical aspect to your personality and to mine as well in the face of failure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: It's a powerful tool, but it's also a burden.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: That's very interesting to walk that line.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: But let me ask in terms of people around you, in terms of friends, in the bigger picture of your own life, where do you put the value of love, family, friendship in the big picture journey of your life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Well, ultimately all journeys are alone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: It's great to have support.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And when you go forward and say your job is to make something work and that's your number one priority and you're going to work at it to make it work, it's like superhuman effort.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: People don't become successful as part-time workers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: It doesn't work that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And if you're prepared to make that 100 to 120% effort, you're going to need support.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And you're going to have to have people involved with your life who understand that that's really part of your life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Sometimes you're involved with somebody and they don't really understand that and that's a source of conflict and difficulty.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: But if you're involved with the right people, whether it's a dating relationship or spousal relationship, you have to involve them in your life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: But not burden them with every minor triumph or mistake.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: They actually get bored with it after a while.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And so you have to set up different types of ecosystems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: You have your home life, you have your love life, you have children, and that's like the enduring part of what you do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And then on the other side, you've got the sort of unpredictable nature of this type of work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: What I say to people at my firm who were younger, usually, well, everybody's younger, but people who are of an age where they're just having their first child,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: or maybe they have two children, that it's important to make sure they go away with their spouse at least once every two months.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: It's just some lovely place where there are no children, no issues.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Sometimes once a month, if they're sort of energetic and clever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Escape the craziness of it all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: Yeah, and reaffirm your values as a couple.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And you have to have fun.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: If you don't have fun with the person you're with and all you're doing is dealing with issues, then that gets pretty old.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And so you have to protect the fun element of your life together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: And the way to do that isn't by hanging around the house and dealing with sort of more problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

body.input: You have to get away and reinforce and reinvigorate your relationship.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Schwarzman: Going Big in Business, Investing, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #96

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: and every part of my skin must have a reference frame

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: So the big idea is that throughout the neocortex,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: everything is being stored and referenced

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: in reference frames.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: You can think of them like XYZ reference frames,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: but they're not like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: We know a lot about the neural mechanisms for this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: But the brain thinks in reference frames.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: And as an engineer, if you're an engineer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: and say this features at this locations and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: But the fact that this, the idea that this is occurring

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: throughout the neocortex everywhere, it was a novel idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: And then a zillion things fell into place after that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: A zillion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: So now we think about the neocortex

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: as processing information quite differently

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: than we used to do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: We used to think about the neocortex

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: as processing sensory data

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: The brain works by assigning everything, every input,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: And there are thousands, hundreds of thousands of them

body.input: active at once in your neocortex.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: It's a surprising thing to think about,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: but once you sort of internalize this,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: So one of the consequences of that

body.input: And each square millimeter can learn complete models

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: But if they don't, they have a poor guess.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: It's a probabilistic guess of what they might be touching.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: at the top of a little piece of spaghetti.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: and it's not really a probability distribution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: If you activate or you get 10 to 20 of them active at the same time, meaning they're all

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: receiving an input at the same time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: And those 10 to 20 synapses or 40 synapses are within a very short distance on the dendrite,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: like 40 microns, a very small area.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: So if you activate a bunch of these right next to each other at some distant place,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: what happens is it creates what's called the dendritic spike.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: And the dendritic spike travels through the dendrites and can reach the soma or the cell

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: body.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: Now, when it gets there, it changes the voltage, which is sort of like going to make the cell

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: fire but never enough to make the cell fire.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: It's sort of what we call it says we depolarize the cell, you raise the voltage a little bit,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: but not enough to do anything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: It's like, well, good as that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: And then it goes back down again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: So we proposed a theory, which I'm very confident basics are, is that what's happening there

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: is those 95% of those synapses are recognizing dozens to hundreds of unique patterns.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: They can write about 10, 20 synapses at a time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: And they're acting like predictions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: So the neuron actually is a predictive engine on its own.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: It can fire when it gets enough, what they call proximal input from those ones near the

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: cell fire, but it can get ready to fire from dozens to hundreds of patterns that are recognized

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: from the other guys.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: And the advantage of this to the neuron is that when it actually does produce a spike,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: an action potential, it does so slightly sooner than it would have otherwise.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: Well, the slightly sooner part is it, there's all the neurons in the, the excitatory neurons

body.input: in the brain are surrounded by these inhibitory neurons and they're very fast, the inhibitory

body.input: neurons, these baskets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: And if I get my spike out a little bit sooner than someone else, I inhibit all my neighbors

body.input: around me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: And what you end up with is a different representation.

body.input: You end up with a representation that matches your prediction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: specific.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25

body.input: And so we showed how networks of these neurons can do very sophisticated temporal prediction

body.input: basically.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeff Hawkins: Thousand Brains Theory of Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #25
