metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Check them out in the description to support this podcast.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: As a side note, let me say that exploring the places the human mind can go can help

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: us understand where it comes from, how it works, and how to engineer mental journeys,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: whether that's through life experiences, chemical substances, brain-computer interfaces,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: or interactions with artificial intelligence systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: On a personal level, I think the dissolution of the ego for stretches of time is a powerful

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: tool for understanding yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: A lot of things can do this, including jiu-jitsu, literature, meditation, but psychedelics is

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: definitely or at least arguably one of the most powerful, from psilocybin to DMT.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I'm excited that people like Rick are leading the scientific research that reveals the efficacy

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: and the safety of these substances, so that their proper dosage and usage protocols can

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: be understood and people like me can safely and effectively use them not just for recreation

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: but for rigorous exploration of my own mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: This is the Lex Friedman Podcast and here is my conversation with Rick Doblin.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Could you give an introduction to psychedelics, like a big, bold, whirlwind overview?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What are psychedelics?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What are the kinds of psychedelics out there?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: In whatever way you think is meaningful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: All right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Well, when I started MAPS, the Multidisciplinary Association for Psychedelic Studies, it was

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: very important for me that psychedelic be in the name.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The way in which the original meaning of psychedelic, it's mind manifesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It was created by Humphrey Osmond in a dialogue with Aldous Huxley.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Psychedelic means mind manifesting and so we interpret that very broadly to mean dreams

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: are psychedelic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Anything that kind of brings things to the surface, holotropic breathwork, hyperventilation

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: is psychedelic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Most people think psychedelic is only about certain kind of chemical substances, either

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: natural or synthetic, but we've got a much broader view of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Meditation can be psychedelic in some ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But our primary focus is on the drugs, is on the medicines or the, you might call them,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: some people might call them spiritual tools or sacraments.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: There's sort of two general categories of those.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: One are what are called the classic psychedelics and those are the ego dissolving, sort of

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: merged into a unit of states.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Those are like LSD, psilocybin, mescaline, ayahuasca, ibogaine, DMT, things like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And then there's MDMA, which some people even argue is not a psychedelic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: They'll say it's an empathogen or an intactogen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's about touching within or empathy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It doesn't do the same kind of ego dissolution that the classic psychedelics do, but it brings

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: material to the surface and it changes the way we process information.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And so I think you can quibble about whether it's a, it's certainly not a classic psychedelic,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: but I think MDMA is also a psychedelic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Marijuana I would say is a psychedelic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Marijuana is closer to the classic psychedelics than it is to MDMA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: One point I like to make is dreams because then everybody can relate to that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Dreams are psychedelic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Bring emotions, feelings, ideas, concepts in symbolic form a lot of times, or just in

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: raw emotions to the surface.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So when people hear the word psychedelic, often they are frightened by it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's about loss of control.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And it is to an extent loss of conscious control, particularly with the classic psychedelics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And we know with dreams that we can have frightening dreams, nightmares, but I think that anchoring

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: the concept of psychedelic in dreams is really helpful for people to know that it's kind

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: of a natural state and that there are other ways that you can catalyze it than by going

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: to sleep and that for thousands of years, substances have been used in that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So you mentioned this idea of bringing something to the surface, which is really interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So can you maybe elaborate the surface and what is there in the depths of things and

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: how does ego dissolution fits into that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Well Aldous Huxley talked about the brain as a reducing valve, that we have an enormous

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: amount of information.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So right now there's an air conditioning sound in the background, but that's not crucial

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: to what you and I are doing talking to each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So we kind of tune that out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: There's all sorts of sites and sounds.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: There's incoming information in all the different sense modalities and we have to figure out

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: what's important to us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And so the mind in a way focuses a lot on what are our core needs and we filter all

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: the incoming information that we get towards focusing on what our core needs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And we can even get to Abraham Maslow and the hierarchy of needs about survival needs,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: belonging needs, esteem needs, you go on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So I think what I mean by bringing things to the surface is that we tend to not focus

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: on a lot of things that are coming, but we also push away things that are difficult emotionally,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: difficult cognitively.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We all know that we're on this very short trajectory from birth to death, but we're

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: not constantly thinking about dying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Although that can actually be helpful to focus us on what's really important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Traumas are often suppressed, conflicts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We see in America and around the world, a kind of rise of irrationality where people

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: push away their logic in order for their emotional tribal needs to be met.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: A lot of people are suffering from early childhood traumas of a different kinds or abandonment

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: issues or anything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So we tend to focus on just what we need to survive and what we need for work and esteem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And so psychedelics, by dissolving this ego control or by with MDMA kind of strengthening

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: our sense of self and our sense of self acceptance, we can bring in other information that have

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: previously been too complicated or too painful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: You don't think of psychedelics as conjuring up something new.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It is more revealing something that is already there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I think that's a very crucial thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So yes, Sasha Shulgin, who sort of the godfather of MDMA, he sort of rediscovered it and brought

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: it back into use.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: He talked about his first experience was with mescaline.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: His first psychedelic experience was with mescaline and he had a tremendous experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But what he said about it was he was having a human experience that the mescaline was

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: helping him access rather than that he was having a mescaline experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So that it's not like you pop a pill and you always have the same kind of experience as

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: everybody else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The experience is not contained in the pill.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The pill opens you up and you have an experience of yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Sometimes these are experiences that we've never consciously had.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But we can say right now that we know that our body below the level of our conscious

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: awareness has all these self-healing mechanisms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And we don't modulate them to a large extent by conscious control.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I mean eventually we are learning more about the mind-body and we learn about the placebo

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: effect and what we think is the case.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But I think that there's experiences that are below our level of conscious awareness,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: particularly once we're adults, that are more these unit of mystical experiences, sense

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: of connection.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I think kids are like this a lot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We kind of come from the void, you could say, and you're born and you have a different way

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: of processing information.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: One interesting point about that has to do with ketamine, which has been approved as

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: ketamine for depression, but it's used for anesthesia.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And roughly one-tenth the anesthetic dose is a psychedelic dose.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And when it's used in anesthesia, there's what's called the emergent phenomena.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So this is you get enough ketamine for you can be operated on, you're not in pain, you're

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: not really there, your ego's knocked out, but you can still breathe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But as the operations get over and then people metabolize the ketamine, there's a process

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: that they call the emergent phenomena.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's like as you're emerging from this tranquilized state and that's where you pass through the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: psychedelic phase and they don't prepare people for that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And what we see is that a lot of adults have difficult times with that, but children don't

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: seem to have those problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Children are a little bit more already in this kind of state.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And so ketamine is used quite frequently in children now for anesthesia.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So all of that is to say to your question that I think these psychedelics reveal things

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: that are within us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Some things that are how we process information back when we were children.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Other things that we've never thought of before that are sort of baked into our consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: There's one drug, 5-MeO-DMT.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's this toxin from a Sonoran toad that many people consider it to be the most powerful

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: of all the psychedelics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And it kind of knocks the ego structures completely out of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And we experience something different, but it's something I think that's always within

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's a deeper layer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So we knock out some of the higher cognitive functions and then we experience things in

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: a different way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So my sense is that these are human experiences that the psychedelics bring us to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah, it's really profound.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And DMT is a really interesting example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So Terence McKenna has talked about these machine elves, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And there's this, I think from the people I've heard speak about the experience, there's

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: a sense that you are traveling elsewhere to meet entities, whether they're elves or not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So in your sense, you're not traveling elsewhere.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: You're just revealing something that's within.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And maybe it's a particular mechanism of revealing what's already within.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And I knew Terence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I spent a lot of time talking with Terence and I do not ascribe to a lot of things that

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: he was saying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: He was a tremendous entertainer and I think he did a lot of really good things and focused

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: us on the power of psychedelics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But I think I've never seen these quote machine elves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I think culture is more determinative of what people experience under psychedelics, your

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: preconceptions than we give it credit for.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And so I think there's a lot of priming that you could say that people receive by stories

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: from their culture.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: With ayahuasca, it's about jaguars and Amazonian animals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So I think these machine elves are this construct of Terence that other people do see.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: There's actually some people that are very interested in doing a study and that they're

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: well funded and moving toward it to keep people on an IV infusion of DMT for them specifically

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: to see do they contact machine elves or aliens and what kind of information do they bring

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: back from these other selves, other places or other entities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: One question is, who are we?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Are we connected to everything in the universe?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We certainly know in many cases you talk about waves or particles, the quantum approach.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So I don't interpret experiences that we have of some entity that's somehow or other deep

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: in our consciousness that's not us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's a part of who we are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So I tend to interpret it in that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The question is, how big are we?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: How many ideas are within us that can be revealed by changing the perspective?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: You mentioned physics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What physicists, especially mathematical physicists or mathematicians do is they reveal truths

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: by taking a slightly different perspective on a problem that reveals the simplicity of

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: how it actually works in totally new ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That's what Einstein did.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Every progress in physics and certainly every progress in mathematics requires you to take

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: a different perspective.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And then perhaps that's exactly what psychedelics are doing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's not that they're contacting aliens that are elsewhere.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It may be revealing the connection between us and other living life forms or actually

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: might be revealing a totally new perspective on what life is or what consciousness is and

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: giving us a glimpse at that even though our cognitive capabilities are limited to fully

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: grasp and understand it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So it's just giving us an inkling of that somehow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And it seems perhaps a little ridiculous, not from a scientific perspective in the sense

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: that we don't have a good physics of life or physics of intelligence or physics of consciousness,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: but getting a glimpse of that is giving us a little bit of maybe an intuition of which

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: way to head to build such a physics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah, yeah, I think so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I think that there's this other concept I guess I would like to talk about briefly,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: this Jungian collective unconscious, this idea that somehow or other everything that

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: has ever happened is still accessible, maybe not with as much data or as much resolution,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: but that there's wave resonances so that I do believe that we can have experiences as

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: part of this human collective unconscious that we're not from our own life and that

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: we can, like the holographic realities, that there is a way to gather information that

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: can be accurate about other times and places through depth investigations of our own consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But I think what I tend to believe is that it's because there's emotional resonances

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: between where we're at now in this life and other kind of experiences that people have

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: had before.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And we always hear about everybody who talks about past lives, they're always kings and

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: queens.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So I think that's again, you filter things, what you want to be true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But I do think that there is a way to access information beyond what we've taken in in

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: our own temporal existence through our own five senses.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: In some ways, I really find that compelling, the notion that that information is already

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: there, and you're simply just moving the attention of your mind to different parts of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I mean, we have that with the radio.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I mean, you know, you've got a frequency, you turn all this information.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: You could actually say right now, in the space between us, we have the whole world's knowledge

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: that's up on the internet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's right here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But we don't see it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We just have to tune in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What are the interesting differences, would you say, between the very psychedelics that

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: you mentioned?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Ayahuasca, DMT, acid LSD, marijuana, mescaline, PCP, psilocybin, MDMA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: You mentioned a few of them that are really interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We'll talk about scientifically some of the different studies that have been conducted

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: on each, but sort of at the high level.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What are some interesting differences?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Well, one of the big ones that people make a big deal of that I think is completely misplaced

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: is some are from nature, some are from the lab.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So there's this kind of like romantic thought that if it's from nature, it's good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: If it's from the lab, it's somehow tainted by humanity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And therefore, some people are like all for plant psychedelics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We see the policy changes that have been happening in a couple of cities, Cambridge, Somerville,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: but far from where we're at now where they decriminalize plant medicines.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So they call it decriminalizing nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So I think that there is, from my perspective, certain things from nature are poison, certain

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: things from the lab are spiritual, even if they don't show up in nature like LSD.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Now there is something LSD is lysergic acid diethylamide.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: There is lysergic acid amide, LSA, which comes from morning glory seeds.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So it's very similar.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But at the same time, I'd say I don't buy into that distinction that there's some fundamental

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: preference.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: One of the things that Terence McKenna, since we talked about him, he talked about how if

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: it's from nature, it's good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And if it's not, we should be suspect.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Of course, he had a lot of great LSD experiences.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But actually, Terence, in 1984, we were at Esalen with a bunch of other people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: This was before the crackdown on MDMA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And this was some of the underground therapists and the above ground researchers were trying

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: to talk about how to protect MDMA from this eventual crackdown.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And Terence was like, forget about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's from the lab.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's dangerous.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We have thousands of years of history, all these other things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And what do we know about MDMA?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And blah, blah, blah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And I was like, Terence, you're so unscientific.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Full of shit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Another way to say it is, and I just said, we need a study of the safety of MDMA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And so then Dick Price, who started Esalen, I said, I'll put a thousand.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Dick Price, he put a thousand.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So Terence was actually the catalyst for the first study with MDMA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Just because he was so frustrating about how plants are okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And if it's from the lab, it's bad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So that's one distinction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The other distinction is this sense of classic psychedelics versus things like MDMA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So to what extent do they dissolve the ego?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And you could say, to what extent do they cause visions?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The 5-HT2A serotonin receptor subtype, which is responsible for a lot of that, where these

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: drugs are activating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Now mescaline of all the psychedelics, chemically, it's the most similar to MDMA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's a phenethylamine, which is MDMA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So in the 50s, there was the, 53, I think it was, the Army Chemical Warfare Service

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: wanted to look at drugs for interrogations, mind control, nonlethal incapacitance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: They did a study in eight substances.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: These were now toxicity studies in animals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And on the one side was methamphetamine, on the other was mescaline, and MDMA was in the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: middle chemically.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So mescaline of these psychedelics tends to have a warmth that MDMA has.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's not as ego-dissolving quite as some of the others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I mean, it's the main active ingredient in peyote.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It is very psychedelic, very visual.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Another distinction with these different drugs is how long they last.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And a lot of that has to do with the route of administration.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So for example, if you smoke DMT, it takes 10, 15 minutes, and you're within seconds,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: you're off in another world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Similarly, 5-MeO DMT, very rapid.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: When you take DMT in the form of ayahuasca, where it's mixed with another substance that

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: makes it so that it's orally active, then it's a couple hours.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So LSD is 8, 10, 12 hours sometimes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Psilocybin is more like 5 or 6 hours, or 4 to 6 hours.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: MDMA is similar.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's one reason why in our research, we give an initial dose of MDMA, and then two hours

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: later we give half the initial amount to extend the plateau, because we want it to last longer

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: for people to be in this therapeutic state.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So that's another distinction is how long these drugs last.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Another distinction is which of them come from a religious context, have a religion

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: built around them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That's all modern.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's made up, and it's kind of a new approach.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: However, there was thousands of years of use of psilocybin mushrooms in religious contexts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So I think that there are a lot of ways to look at these different substances.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Another distinction is which one of them are being researched right now in scientific context

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And what he talked about is how technology was making things ever smaller, that we are

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And so you get this ego dissolution, but underneath it you have this sense of ego, sort of sense

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: of self safety, of self acceptance, kind of grounds it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So Stan was like, that's the future of psychiatry that you can watch without the terror of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: ego dissolution, the sense that you're losing your mind or you're going crazy or you're

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: dying or that you have this grounded sense of safety while you're dissolving your normal

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: sense of how you see things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And being able to engineer in a fine tuned way that that exact experience may be fine

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: tuned to the person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: As opposed to sort of this manual potion that's through experiment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Although I don't know about fine tuning things to the person in the sense that we believe

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: there's this inner healer, this kind of inner healing intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We talked about it, the body repairs itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So I think we more need to create safety for people and then what emerges will be customized

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: to what they need to be looking at from this inner healing intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: At the same time, we will move to, we hear so much about the new approaches to oncology

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: where you do genetic analysis of different kinds of tumors and then you have certain

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: kind of chemotherapy agents and you do like personalized chemotherapy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I think we will have more like personalized psychedelic therapy, but it'll be more like

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: a sequence of different drugs that people go through over an extended period of time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And then you kind of customize what's next.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And sometimes you'll combine different drugs together like this 5-MeO DMT and MDMA, or

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: a lot of times people do LSD MDMA combinations or psilocybin MDMA combinations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Chemistry is not my strength.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I'm more into clinical applications and policy, but I can say that from what I've learned

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: from reading from others and research done by others that different psychedelics have

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: an impact on different neurotransmitters, different other parts of energies in the brain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The default mode network is what's considered to be like our sense of self.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And it's part of the brain that sort of is what I described before, scanning the world

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: and filtering information for what's really important to us and both focusing us on things

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: and also helping us to ignore a lot of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And the classic psychedelics all weaken the energy in this default mode system and therefore

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: you get this flood of information that you're not normally paying attention to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And then you start seeing in the more creative waves or more connected, you actually move

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: to beyond the verbal kind of thinking into sort of symbolic thinking a lot of times.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And that's where you sometimes get these mystical sense of connection, how it's all one and

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: you get the sense also of how big the universe is and how small each one of us is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So there's a lot of work that Sasha Shulgin and Albert Hoffman who invented LSD and first

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: synthesized psilocybin on what they call structure activity relationships.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What is the structural of the molecule and then how do you predict what that new molecule

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: that never existed before is going to do once you actually take it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And you can get close but you never really know until you actually take the drug.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And the way that Sasha ran his experiments is that he would take the drugs himself first

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: in low doses and he would sort of step up the doses to have more experiences.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: If he thought it was valuable, he'd share it with his wife Anne.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But then what they would do is if they both thought it was valuable, they had a group

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: of 12 people that they were with for many, many years and they would distribute these

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: new drug to these 12 people and they would get the different perspectives.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And he felt that 12 is like a minimum number because we're so unique how each of us see

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But then you kind of get a little bit of a consensus on how a lot of people are going

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: to see it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And then if that 12 people were positive about it, then they would turn it over to Leo Zeff

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: who we called the secret chief, the leader of the underground psychedelic therapy movement

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: and then he would start exploring it in therapy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So there's still a lot of mysteries as far as structure activity relationships and it's

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: not going to be the case that people go into the lab and they tinker with molecules and

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: they know exactly what they're going to get.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And a lot of it has to do with the not so much chemistry as morphology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: You could say the shape of the molecule and how does that interact with receptor sites.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And so we're getting better at modeling all of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And how does that interaction relate to the morphing of the human experience and deeply

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: understanding that perhaps there's no equations yet for that kind of thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: You really have to build up intuition by experiencing it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And over time and sort of subjective self-report like trying to build an understanding of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: effects of the different chemistries.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: You can have approximate ideas, but to know exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So when I first tried MDMA, which was 1982, and this was after I had done lots of LSD

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: and mescaline and mushrooms, I was shocked at how different it was than these other substances

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: and yet how profound it was.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So are there whole new kind of categories of classes of drugs that we're not aware of

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: that would be not so much this like eco-dissolution or emotional.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Well, what MDMA does is reduces activity in the amygdala, the fear processing part of

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: the brain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So it's not just chemistry, but it routes energy throughout the brain in a different

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It increases activity in the prefrontal cortex.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So you think more logically, that I think has an enormous impact on the effect of MDMA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The other thing it does is it increases connectivity between the amygdala and the hippocampus.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So it helps facilitate processing of things into long-term memory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And with PTSD, trauma is like never in the past.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's always about to happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So will we one time develop drugs that would even be specific to certain kind of memories?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We're working with a woman, Rachel Yehuda, who is at the Bronx VA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And she's done some studies that are with the epigenetics of trauma.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So she's worked with Holocaust survivors and their children.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And she has identified epigenetic mechanisms by which trauma is passed from generation

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: to the generations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Sort of like set points for anxiety, fear, certain things like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But the question is, can you actually transmit memories from one generation to the next?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Now this is not DNA changes, which happen over a very long period of time and evolutionary

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: scale.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But within one lifetime, within some experiences, your epigenetics, what turns on the genes

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: or turns off certain genes, that can be impacted.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And that's what we know now can be transmitted from generation to generation, either by the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: father or the mother through the sperm or the egg.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So it's pretty remarkable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So what Rachel's going to try to do is MDMA research for PTSD and look at these epigenetic

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: markers before and after and see if they change as a consequence of therapy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So will we develop one day certain kind of chemicals that will be able to bring certain

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: kind of memories to the surface?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That's not inconceivable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The epigenetic angle is fascinating that there'll be these epigenetic perturbations that lead

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: to memories living from one generation to the other, and then bringing those memories

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: to the surface.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And using that as signal to understand what exactly the psychedelics bring to the surface

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: and not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Now the other portion of that though is culture.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I mean, culture is where we store all these memories and in the stories that we get passed

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Especially with a lot of shared, you talk about the Holocaust or World War II, where

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: it's deeply ingrained in the culture, the impact of those events and sort of an aggregate

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: the different perspectives on that particular event create a set of stories that you can

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: plug into.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And then they kind of resonate with some aspect of you that creates a memory that's connected

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: to like when I think about World War II and the Holocaust, I think about my own family,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: but in some sense it's also resonating with stories of many others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So it's like somehow the two echo each other and I'm just providing my own little flavor

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: on top.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The meat of the stories are probably those that are shared with others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's plugging into the collective unconscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That's really fascinating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Really plugging into like precisely plugging into particular memories as a way to deal

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: with trauma and PTSD, that kind of thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I'll just add that the most important dream of my life ever was of a Holocaust survivor

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: telling me that he was miraculously saved from death and he knew that he was saved for

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: a particular purpose, but he never knew what that purpose was.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So in the dream I'm seeing him on his deathbed and then he shows me whatever happened to

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: him during the Holocaust.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Then we're back in the room on his deathbed and he says, well, I know what my purpose

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: was now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I'm like, oh great, what was it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: He says, it's to tell you to be a psychedelic therapist and to study psychedelics and bring

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: back psychedelic research.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I thought to myself, I've already decided to do this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: You can lay this on me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I can say yes and then you can die in peace.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Then he died in front of my eyes in the dream.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So I think that that kind of cultural transmission that I got from when I was really young then

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: manifested in this dream and that was this story about how people can be incredibly vicious

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: and can be very motivated by irrational factors.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So I just feel that this kind of multi-generational transmission of this story of the irrational

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: being a murderous factor and something I needed to respond to was deeply ingrained.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I would say my guess is more culturally than this epigenetic mechanism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah, but your sense is that whatever stimulated a certain part of human nature in World War

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: II, especially Nazi Germany, but also in Stalinist Soviet Union still is within us, within all

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: of us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Just like what we're saying, we embody quite a lot of things and one of those is whatever

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: the capacity for evil seems to be one of those things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So I wrote from Carl Jung from just a few years before he died.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What he says, and I'll just paraphrase it, is that we need to understand psychology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We need to understand who man is, that the greatest danger to us is man.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: There are no other dangers really that impact our species.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And then he goes on to say that we are the source of all coming evil.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: This was 15 years or so after World War II.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And I'd say one of the most important psychedelic experiences of my life was a DMT experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Also Terrence was there, Ralph Metzner, Andy Weil, a few others, and we were sitting around

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: at Esalen smoking DMT.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And under the influence of DMT, which now this was the first time I've ever smoked DMT,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I had this super rapid fraction of a second dissolving of everything that I...

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Well, first off I saw a horizontal line, then I saw a vertical line, then it turned into

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: a color, red, then it was red, then it turned into cubes, then it turned into like an MC

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Escher kind of like, I don't know, didn't make logical sense, and then I was gone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And then it was just this period of five, 10 minutes of just feeling part of this enormous

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: wave of billions of years of evolution, how I had this sense that in my innermost sense

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: of who I am uniquely individually, this inner voice that's talking to me, that I didn't

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: develop English, that it's like a gift to me from millions of people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So that even in my most innermost sense, it's not just me, it's the product of everything

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: that came before me, I'm part of this bigger system.

body.input: the rigor of saying how to do it effectively, how to sort of understand sort of not just

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: almost to take the full journey of creative exploration and to do it for prolonged periods

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: of time, for years, lifelong kind of part of your life of how it empowers creativity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I think of course you start with helping people deal with trauma and then the next step is

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: people who have moved past their trauma and are trying to do something, create something

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: special in their life, how can then psychedelics empower that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah, now that also just to not shy away from anything controversial, that gets us to this

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: idea of psychedelics for vision quest, particularly for younger people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: When you're sort of moving into this adulting kind of phase and you have to figure out what

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: are you going to do with your life, there's so many options.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: A lot of people for us feel constrained that they have very few options, but I think this

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: idea of psychedelics as a way to help you find your calling or find your vision or find

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: your unique leverage point, I think we'll see that more and more as our culture evolves

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: and gets healthier around the use of psychedelics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So it's both the science, having the rigor of understanding how to do it safely and the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: culture catching up to the fact that this is both safe and very useful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah, although I would question this idea of safety.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So we can understand physiological risks and we can minimize them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And I think there's very minimal physiological risks from the classic psychedelics, virtually

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: none or for even MDMA under safe conditions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Psychological risks are harder to address, but we can do that through the sense of safety

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: and support.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But I think there's a level of risk there that we shouldn't overlook.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And so to make a drug into a medicine, what we have to do is prove to the satisfaction

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: of the FDA and other regulatory agencies that things are safe and efficacious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But even though they use those words, proving safety and safe and efficacious, it's in relationship

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: to the disease that you're trying to treat and you accept a certain amount of risk.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So it's the risk benefit ratio rather than pure safety.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah, absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Let me ask you about Ken Kesey a little bit longer because fascinating him being...

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: He was also part of Project MKUltra.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What was Project MKUltra and what lessons we should take away from it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202
