body.input: Well, MKUltra was a program by the CIA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What they were looking at was, can you take these psychedelic drugs and weaponize them

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: in different ways for interrogation, for true serums, for exposing somebody before they

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: give a big talk to something like LSD and then they can't talk or make a fool of themselves?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Or can you spray LSD over the battlefield and have everybody tripping and drop their

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: weapons and then you just walk up and nobody dies and you've won the battle?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So...

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's a fascinating concept.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah, they call it non-lethal incapacitance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: One way to win a war is to enforce peace, to get everybody not caring about the war, but

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Well, I think Gandhi said something even better, which is that the true way to win a war is

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: to turn your enemy into your friend.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yes, that's a beautiful way to put it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But MKUltra was really nefarious and it was part of our military and it was done in secret

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: and they would dose people against their will.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I mean, one of the most infamous things was that they had a house of prostitution in San

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Francisco and they would have one-way mirrors, all this stuff, and then they would just dose

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: people with LSD.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: They would have the prostitutes dose these guys with LSD and observe what they would

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: do and how they would act.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The CIA actually for a while was dosing each other secretly and there's a famous case of

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: this fellow Olsen that either jumped out of a window or was pushed, he might've been killed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: He was CIA guy and they gave him LSD and then they're trying to see can they break him down

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: and get him to tell secrets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I think he felt uncomfortable with what happened to him while he was under the influence of

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: LSD and whether he was pushed or not, I don't know if we'll ever know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But MKUltra was violating people's human rights, it was done in secret and the irony of it

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: is that Ken Kesey is one of the people, one of the main early people that got LSD in this

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: context and then he was one of the main people that helped inspire the hippies to use psychedelics

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: to oppose the Vietnam War.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So I think the CIA kind of in many cases, things get out of their control what they

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: think they can do and it turned into be a disaster for them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I think there was some thought that some of the people at the CIA had is that if you can

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: turn people inside, take drugs and they just focus on their internal experience, they're

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: not going to be involved politically.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's a way to sort of take people offline.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And what I don't think they counted on is that when you're offline and you have these

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: units of spiritual experiences and you realize how we're all connected, then why do you want

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: to go out and kill these Vietnamese and put one dictator over another dictator, dictators

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: on both sides in North Vietnam and South Vietnam?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Why are we doing that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So MKUltra has very disreputable, we're learning more and more about what they did and one

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: of the unintended consequences was Ken Kesey and not only that, but then the Grateful Dead

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: who began at the acid tests that Kesey was helping to organize and out of that emerged,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: you could say just this incredible psychedelic culture.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And you look at the bans that began in the 60s and which ones have really survived to

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: this day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And the Grateful Dead has survived longer than most any other band.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Some of them have died and all, but it was like the tightness, the sort of telepathy

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: we talked about before that they could just get so tuned in to each other and each other's

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: energies and they could do improvisations and they could do this incredible work that

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I think the sustainability of the Grateful Dead as a group was a testament to the power

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: of the LSD experiences and that might have never happened if not for MKUltra.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But can we talk about darkness a little bit?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So Ted Kaczynski, the Unabomber was allegedly part of the MKUltra studies while at Harvard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Do you think this is true?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Do you think it had an impact on him psychologically, intellectually and so on?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I do think it's true and I do think it had an impact.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So we talked before about are these drugs somehow or other producing a certain kind

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: of drug experience or do they bring out what's within?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So we have this experience, yeah, on the one hand, Kankisi and he sort of took positive

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: things out of this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: On the other hand, we can get this opposition to the modern world, to technology and to

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: the point of creating bombs to try to go after it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So that the experience is not in the drug, it's this interaction between the drug, the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: person, the context.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And so we can heal people with psychedelics or people can be driven crazy with psychedelics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It depends again on the context.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And so I think both these things can be true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And I think it was really good that you kind of highlighted this, that there is this polarities

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: and that it's not in the drug, it's in the other factors and it's who they were beforehand

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: and then how you use that experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So all that's to say is if we put LSD in the water and everybody were going to get it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: it doesn't mean that all of a sudden everybody's going to have a mystical experience and then

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: that's all we need to do and humanity is spiritualized and war and all of this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's not about the drug.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That actually is why for me, we've also talked about engineering new psychedelics and all

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: the people that are going to be trying for-profit companies to develop and patent new psychedelics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: For me, the most important challenge is new cultural contexts that can create legality,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: safety, support for the existing psychedelics that we already have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I mean, we have so much incredible tools in these existing psychedelics that it's more

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: about creating contexts for them to be used in safe medical or personal growth or recreational

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: even with harm reduction, all these different ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That's more important to me than finding some new molecule that's somewhat similar or somewhat

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: different, but it can be patented.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So it's the social context.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So I do believe that Ted Kaczynski was part of NK-Ultra and I think it affected him in

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: a negative way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And that's a cautionary tale that it's not in the drug, it's in the context.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The context of the person, still it feels like if viewed from a therapy perspective,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: perhaps there was a way to use psychedelics to help Ted Kaczynski find a path out of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: darkness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I think so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I think that this is where I think MDMA comes in, in a way that MDMA is...

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: He felt very isolated and very much out of society in some ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: MDMA stimulates oxytocin, which we haven't mentioned, which is the hormone of nursing

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: mothers of love and connection.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It provides a lot of this sense of self-acceptance and safety and wanting to be in a relationship.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Gould Dolan is a neuroscientist at Hopkins, she's given octopuses MDMA, they're solitary

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: creatures except mating season, which is not very often, but you give them MDMA and they

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: become more interested in hanging out with other octopuses.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So I think for people that have had difficult psychedelic experiences, MDMA helps them integrate

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We've worked with people that had a difficult LSD experience 40 years before and are still

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: able to get back to that under the influence of MDMA and work out some of the conflicts

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: that they weren't able to resolve all those decades before.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So I think that psychedelics could have been helpful in a different context for Ted Kaczynski.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But the other big part of it is that people have to be willing to cooperate with the experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We talked about resistance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So people can resist these things, it's the saying is you can bring a horse to water,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: but you can't make him drink.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: This is about how people have to be willing to go to these spaces.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So the essence of our therapeutic approach is that we help people to heal themselves,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: that we are not giving them the healing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's a flip on the power dynamics that existed, you would say in the 50s and 60s, my dad was

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: a doctor and the doctors were gods and whatever they said was right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We no longer of course believe that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But for a while psychoanalysis with Freud, that they gave the interpretation to the patient,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: the patient couldn't help themselves, but they would do the free associations and then

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: psychoanalysts would see these conflicts and would be the one that does the healing, would

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: give this interpretation and that would open things up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So I think it's this idea of empowering people to heal themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And so if Ted Kazinksi had been in a therapeutic setting with psychedelics and if they'd had

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: something like MDMA available or MDA, which was popular during the 60s, which is a more

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: like MDMA LSD combination, the outcomes might've been different.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Let's take a step into the world of studies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Timothy Leary, who was he and what were the most important ideas you've learned from him?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Well, I did have the opportunity to get to know him personally and to spend some time

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: with him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Timothy Leary, well, let's start with Nixon saying he's the most dangerous man in America.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That's a good place to start.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And why did Nixon say that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's because of this turn on, tune in, drop out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Timothy Leary was just an incredible advocate for think for yourself, question authority.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Those were things he said all the time, think for yourself, question authority.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: He was a rebel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: He was kicked out of West Point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: He was a psychologist who was at Harvard for three years from 60 to 63.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Before he got to Harvard, he had an experience with mushrooms in Mexico.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: He said he learned more in that experience than he'd had in his entire academic career

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: before then about how the human mind works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So he came to Harvard wanting to do research into psychedelics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: He did some very important studies, both of which, well, one was called the Good Friday

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: experiment, which was whether psychedelics in religiously inclined people taking psilocybin

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: in a religious setting, whether it could produce a mystical experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That took place at Marsh Chapel at the Boston University.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Because it's a little bit subjective, or you could say entirely subjective, what people

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: describe happens to them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: He wanted to do another study, which would be a more objective measure, and that was

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: called the Concord Prison Experiment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And that was the thought, if you can give people psilocybin, mystical sense of connection

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: type experiences while they're in prison, when they get out, they'll be more pro-social

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: and they'll have reduced recidivism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So Tim did that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: He also did the naturalistic studies of giving loads of people psilocybin and sort of writing

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: down what their experiences were, the range of experiences.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Later on in his time at Harvard, they started doing LSD.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And LSD is more cerebral, longer lasting, not as reassuring in a way, psilocybin.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Sometimes he used to say that if they never got into LSD, they'd still be at Harvard with

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: the psilocybin.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So he was a great American psychologist, but then he got tired of the psychology game,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: you could say, or he would say that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: He got more and more interested in cultural change and various musicians and artists and

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: all sorts of people started coming to him for the psychedelic experience that they are

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: in a way for creativity for other things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So he started hanging out with all sorts of famous people or creative people, and he stopped

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: going to classes a lot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And Ram Dass, Richard Alpert, had given LSD to a student that Ram Dass was courageous

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: enough to admit that he had a sexual interest in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: They weren't supposed to give it undergraduates.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That was about the only time that they ever did it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And psychedelics just getting more and more controversial even in the early 60s.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Eventually got kicked out of Harvard and then he became kind of a cultural icon for the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: counterculture and was hounded by the police and Nixon and spent a lot of time in jail.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: He's an incredible person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: One thing that Ram Dass said is that Richard Alpert Ram Dass said, I'm a rascal, but Leary's

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: a scoundrel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What's the distinction?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Rascals like in good fun.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: A scoundrel is like you can't quite trust them, I think.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah, it's a spectrum of sorts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I think that Leary was someone who a little bit got addicted to media attention.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But I think that overall he gets blamed a lot for the backlash against the 60s, the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: shutdown of psychedelic research.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I think that he is unfairly blamed for a lot of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I think when you look back at the 60s, the common narrative is that it was because psychedelics

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: going wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: People took psychedelics, they weren't prepared, they had emotional breakdowns, they weren't

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: psychotic, they killed themselves, they did this or that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Different problems of people taking psychedelics in contexts that they didn't feel fairly safe

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: in or just they weren't prepared or they didn't know how much they were taking or all this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So the backlash was because psychedelics gone wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But I think the real reason, while that did happen, I think the real reason is psychedelics

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: going right and people having this sense of connection.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And then the opposite of what the CIA was hoping that it would turn people inward and

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: take them away from political struggles, it actually motivated people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Once you actually have these psychedelic experiences, your attitude towards death changes also.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: This idea of death becoming an intrinsic part of life, it's a natural cycle, it's not so

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: much.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So I think people realize that while there's this billions of years of evolution, infinity,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: whatever that means in terms of time, that we're here for a very limited time and they

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: end up wanting to use their time well, they have a lessened fear of death and they want

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: to build this paradise on earth here now instead of later.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So a lot of people really did get motivated to challenge the Vietnam War, to work on the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: environmental movement, civil rights movement, women's rights movement, anti-militarism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And it was that challenge to the status quo that caused the backlash.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So Leary is someone who in 1990, we had a, now MAPS, they started in 86.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So in 1990, we had this conference to raise money out in California and Leary was there

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: and Ram Dass was there and Ralph Metzner was there and Andy Wow was there and Terrence

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: McKenna was there and Dennis McKenna was there and all these.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But there was one point where Tim was speaking and afterwards I was asking him some questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And I said, do you have any advice for us on how to work with the government and how

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: to bring these psychedelics forward?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That's what we're trying to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I've got this nonprofit for it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We're trying to do this research.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What is your advice on how to bring this forward and how to work with the government?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And he said, fuck the government.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: He said, I am so far past asking for permission for anything, but I'm glad that you're doing

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And then he held up my hand like passing the torch.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Wow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And that's one of my favorite photographs of me and Tim where he's sort of like, but

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: it was the after this, fuck the government.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I'm so far past asking for permission for anything, but I'm glad that you are now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I did follow ups to the Good Friday experiment and I did follow ups, 25 year follow up to

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: the Good Friday experiment, about a 34 year follow up to the Concord prison experiment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What I discovered in some ways I would say is the key to the sixties, what I just told

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But in the follow up to the Good Friday experiment that I did in the eighties for my undergraduate

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: thesis at new college in Sarasota, Florida, I eventually found 19 out of the 20 people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That was an enormous challenge because their names were all lost and it just took forever,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: years and years and years to find them all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But I discovered that those people that had the psilocybin experience in the midst of

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: 25 years later with Nancy Reagan and Ronald Reagan, and if ever were there a social pressure

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: to disavow the validity of the psychedelic experience, that was then.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And instead they affirmed it, that they thought with all of this years of hindsight now looking

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: back they thought it was a valid mystical experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But I discovered that one of the persons who had the psilocybin had this experience during

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: the Good Friday service that Reverend Howard Thurman was the minister.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: He was Martin Luther King's mentor and Reverend Howard Thurman was the minister at Boston

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: at Mars Chapel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Martin Luther King got his PhD at Boston University and Howard Thurman had spent time with Gandhi

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: and so he was really kind of this hidden person behind the civil rights movement about nonviolence

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: as their strategy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But he was interested in the political implications of the mystical experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So he permitted this experiment to take place and there were 20 divinity students from Andorra

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Newton in the basement and 10 experimenters, all the people on religion and psychology,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: like Houston Smith and Walter Rieson Clark and Leary and Ram Dassner and others were

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: there as a support part of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And the sermon was like three hours later, three hours long.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We actually have the original sermon from the Good Friday experiment from Howard Thurman

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: up on our website.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's incredible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But part of it was tell people there's a man on the cross.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And this one person sort of heard that and he thought, okay, I got to do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I got it to the, Howard Thurman was such a dynamic speaker.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: He said, I got to tell people there's a man on the cross.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And so he said, what am I doing here in this basement chapel listening to the service?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I got to go tell people there's a man on the cross.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So he went, they thought he was just going to the bathroom, but he ran out the door.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: He's running down Commonwealth Avenue and Houston Smith and Tim Leary go after him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And he had thought that since he should tell somebody, he should tell the president, like

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: why not?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But then he realized, well, the president's in Washington.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I'm here in Boston.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I'll just tell the president of the university.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So anyways, running down the street and Leary and Houston Smith go after him and he doesn't

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: want to go back inside.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: They finally get him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: He's not hit by a car, but they end up giving him a shot of Thorazine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What's Thorazine?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Thorazine is like a major anti-psychotic drug.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's a horrible drug, but it knocks people out, tranquilizes them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We would never do that today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We don't abort a difficult experience like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But in any case, they hid that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That was not part of the write-up of this experiment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So what they did is in a sense, a little bit exaggerated the benefits.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It later became out three years later after the experiment or four years in Time magazine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It said everybody that got psilocybin had a mystical experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: They said it wasn't true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Not everybody.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Eight out of the 10 did, but not all 10, not this guy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And they minimize the risks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So there was a bit of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I think Tim was reckless in that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: He underplayed the risks and over-promised the benefits.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And then the Concord Prison experiment, it turned out that Tim had fudged the data completely

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: and it wasn't really successful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So I fault him for that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The outside world was doing the opposite.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It was exaggerating the risks and blocking research.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: He felt justified to fudge the data because the outside world was fudging in a sense the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: response to the...

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah, exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So that presents a very nice context.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Fuck the government, but I'm glad that somebody is fighting the good fight from within and

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: doing it the right way, which is where you are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So the 80s, let me ask, what is MAPS, the Multidisciplinary Association for Psychedelic

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Studies and what is its mission throughout the years, throughout the decades?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So MAPS is a nonprofit organization.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I created it as a nonprofit pharmaceutical company.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I created it in 86 after DEA, the Drug Enforcement Administration, criminalized MDMA in 1985.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And that was after they started trying to do that in 1984.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And as I mentioned, Terrence McKenna's sponsor motivating us to do this safety study.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So we did that in preparation for this eventual crackdown because MDMA was called Atom, used

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: as a therapy drug, but it was also beginning to be sold as ecstasy as a party drug.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And that was taking place in public settings and bars.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And so it was inevitable that the crackdown would happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And so I had a nonprofit connected to Buckminster Fuller, Earth Metabolic Design Lab, that we

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: used to support this lawsuit against the DEA to block them from criminalizing MDMA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We were winning in the court of public opinion and winning in the court.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The DEA freaked out and the emergency scheduled MDMA in 85.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The handwriting was on the wall that they were not going to permit the therapeutic use

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: to continue because it gets in the way of the narrative of the drug war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And these are terrible drugs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So in 86 is when I started MAPS as a nonprofit pharma because the strategy that I realized

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: is that Americans are open to medicines, that tools to ease suffering, that was the opening

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: wedge, the opening door to changing attitudes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And it would be through science, I would say that my religion is more science than anything

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And culture and religion are metaphorical, but often too much they become literal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But I felt that through science, through medicine, there would be a way to bring these drugs

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: back to the surface.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And the mission was always this mass mental health, this idea that what we need is to

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: spiritualize humanity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Einstein said the splitting of the atom has changed everything except our mode of thinking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And hence we drift towards unparalleled catastrophe, which shall be required if mankind is to survive

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: is a whole new mode of thinking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So what is that new mode of thinking?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: My presumption is that it's more of this mystical sense of thinking that we're all connected.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And then if we realize that we're all connected, we're not going to blow up the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So a lot of people say that if we could just give LSD all to the world leaders, that would

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: be, then they'd have these spiritual experiences, the world would be better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But actually I had a ketamine experience the day after that DMT experience I described

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: with the inner Hitler.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: This ketamine experience was, I was above and behind Hitler as he was giving a speech,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: like the Nuremberg rallies kind of thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And I was trying to think, how do I get into his head?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: How do I undo what he wants to do?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: How can we deal with him?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And I realized this whole new thing about the Heil Hitler salute and he would push energy

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: out and then everybody would do the salute back to him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So it's like the one to the many and the many to the one, all these people giving away their

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: power and then how it would just sort of ratchet up in intensity, like these vibrations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And I realized there's no way to get into his head.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: This idea we've talked about before about you have to be willing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So what that sort of helped me understand is that the strategy has to be mass mental

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: health.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's not about changing a few leaders.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We need to change the mass of humanity to this new mode of thinking, this new spiritual

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So the MAPS was a nonprofit pharmaceutical company focused on psychedelics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Big Pharma wasn't doing this work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Government wasn't funding it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So the only source of funds I thought would be through nonprofit donations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And that's been true up until just a couple of years ago, now that we have the rise of

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: these for-profits, but that's because we've cleared out the regulatory obstacles.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We've got more scientific data about the benefits funded through philanthropy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We've changed public opinion and there's a lot less zeal for the drug war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So all of those things have changed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But at the time it was mass mental health was the goal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Two tracks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: One was drug development.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The other was drug policy reform.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So then it's not just available to people who have a clinical diagnosis, but people

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: who are personal growth or they should have access to it as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I did not know at the time that no drug had ever been made into a medicine by a nonprofit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That was really good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I didn't know that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I might've been a little bit more daunted.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And actually that didn't happen for 13 more years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It happened in 1999 and that was the abortion pill, RU46, that was approved in Europe, but

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: controversial.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: No pharmaceutical company would take it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And it was John D. Rockefeller III through the population council with the major donor

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: being Warren Buffett and the Rockefellers and the Buffetts and some of the Pritzker's

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: were involved in funding this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So that was the first nonprofit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But the MAPS was designed as, from the very beginning, not academic research into psychedelics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: but drug development.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And that's a fundamental distinction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And that's why I think we're years ahead now of everybody else in terms of making a psychedelic

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: assisted therapy into a medicine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Because our goal from the very beginning was not knowledge, not academic research.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It was practical.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It was drug development.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: How do we create new social structures?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: How do we create legal access to these things?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Now in December of 2014, we created the MAPS Public Benefit Corporation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So MAPS is a nonprofit, but in our 35 years, we've raised about $110 million in donations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What I didn't know when I started MAPS, and it took me quite a few years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I didn't even know this till about eight, nine years ago, was that in 1984, Ronald Reagan

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: had signed a bill to create incentives for developing drugs that were off patent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So MDMA was invented by Merck in 1912.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's in the public domain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: These incentives are called data exclusivity, which means that if you make a drug into a

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: medicine that does no patent protection, nobody can use your data for a period of time to

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: market a generic, and that will effectively be, well, it's five years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: You do pediatric studies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: You get six months extension, and we are being required if we succeed in adults to work with

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: adolescents with PTSD.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It blocks a generic competitor from applying until that five and a half years is over,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: takes FDA at least six months to review.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So more or less six years of data exclusivity, 10 years in Europe is data exclusivity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So the story then became to the donors that you're not going to have to give us money

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: forever, because we can make money selling MDMA, but we want to do two revolutionary

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: things you could say.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: One is psychedelic assisted psychotherapy, but the other is marketing drugs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: When you market it with the profit maximization motive, we end up in the extreme getting the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: distortions that we have in America, where we have the most expensive healthcare system

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: in the world per capita, but our outcomes are down like 40 or 50 among the countries,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: our average outcomes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We don't have, a third of the people or so don't have insurance, and it's just very

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: inequitable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So what we're trying to do is show a different way to market drugs, and it's a modification

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: of capitalism that's called the benefit corporation, where you maximize public benefit, not profit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: You still make a profit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So selling MDMA for a profit is not something we could keep inside the nonprofit, because

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: it's taxable, it's a business.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So we've created the MAPS Public Benefit Corporation, which is a hundred percent owned by the nonprofit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So we have a nonprofit that owns a pharma company.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And the mission of that pharma company is to maximize not profit, but maximize benefit

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: for society.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Although there still will be profits, and the profits that we're going to make are going

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: to be used towards the mission of MAPS, which is again, is this mass mental health and ending

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: the drug war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And in fact, we've hired the Boston Consulting Group to help us plot our commercialization

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: strategy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And so there is some suggestions based, there's so many different assumptions in this, the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: number of therapists that we train, the price that we set for the MDMA, whether insurance

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: companies will cover it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But there's the possibility of somewhere in the range of three quarters of a billion dollars

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: in profits during this period of data exclusivity, just from the US.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And we're talking about trying to do this research around the world as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So that's what the Benefit Corporation is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The Benefit Corporation is our pharmaceutical arm.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We're about 130 people now, somewhere in that, fluctuates, but one third of them are in the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: nonprofit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We do harm reduction, psychedelic harm reduction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We help create programs for people with difficult psychedelic experiences at Burning Man, at

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: festivals all over the world, even in cities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We're now negotiating with the police, the city of Denver, because Denver has made the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: mushrooms the lowest enforcement priority.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Oregon has passed the Oregon psilocybin initiative.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So in those areas where maybe more people are going to gravitate to do psychedelics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: we want there to be harm reduction so that we don't have bad stories coming out that

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: would change that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So MAPS does the psychedelic harm reduction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We do public education.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We do a lot of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That's what you and I are doing right now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We're doing that now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But also research towards...

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Well the research now is done in the Benefit Corp.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: In the Benefit Corp.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So what happens is people donate to MAPS, get a tax deduction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: MAPS transfers the money, or you could say invests in the Benefit Corp.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The Benefit Corp will do the research and then MAPS is the sponsor, but then we will

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: license the sale of MDMA to the Benefit Corp.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Got it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But the research is done with an eye towards creating something that has a big impact versus

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: just research for knowledge sake.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Because I'm interested in political change.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The other part of it, which is that the brain is the most complex thing we know in the universe,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: it's endless.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I mean, when are we going to really...

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Like this idea of will we figure out telepathy?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Will we figure out tapping into the cluck of unconscious?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What is the extents of our brain?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: How does the brain actually work?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Do you ask chemistry questions?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So if it's just the pursuit of knowledge, that is an endless thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And how does that end the drug war?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: How does that help people directly?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So that's why we're focused on drug development more than mechanism of action.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Before I ask you about one, but several really exciting studies, let me ask sort of a personal

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: question for me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So if I wanted to get psychedelics from the MAPS Public Benefit Corporation and explore

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: my own mind, how do I get to do that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And when?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: This would go through a doctor and a prescription.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Okay, let me ask another question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: To further answer that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But that's not medicine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So that's why we need to medicalize, to have things covered by insurance, to change people's

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: attitudes, the public attitudes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And then we get this subsequent drug policy reform.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And we're talking about it in terms of licensed legalization.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So my view is you should get a license to do psychedelics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So let me rephrase the question in more specific.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: will be able to prescribe to me something from MAPS Public Benefit Co.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And then when for my personal growth and creativity would I be able to get something?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So like just looking out, this isn't like guaranteed, but like your vision, your hope

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: for psychedelics in society.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Well the end of 2023, so two and a half years from now, we anticipate FDA approval for the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: prescription use of MDMA for PTSD.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Because the FDA does not regulate the practice of medicine, there is what's called off-label

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: prescription.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What that means, the label is what it's approved for.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So the label will say, this is approved for PTSD.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202
