metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: the doctor, they can give it to you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It might not be covered by insurance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: They have to be a little bit careful about malpractice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But I think the end of 2023 is when you will be able to do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Now there's actually another program, very limited, called expanded access, which is

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: compassionate use.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Which means that, and we have approval for 50 people for compassionate use right now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We think that'll grow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So that's going to open up in about two months.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And so those are people with PTSD.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And they can access MDMA while we're doing the phase three studies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: You're not, the sponsor has to pay for all the research.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: pay for it themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And we think that'll start in a couple months.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But it's very limited.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's limited to certain cities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: There's also a program called Right to Try, which is passed through Congress.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's similar to this idea of compassionate use, but it cuts the FDA out of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That's starting to happen, I think, in Canada now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: with life-threatening illness.

body.input: drugs somewhere.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: legalization.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: was medical marijuana.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So what we see is that medicalization, by demonstrating that under certain contexts,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: the risks are much less than the benefits, and then there are benefits.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: their minds, and then eventually that builds up to, why are we throwing people in jail

body.input: for this?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's just the culture, yeah.

body.input: are.

body.input: psilocybin will be a year or two after that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And 2035 is when I think that we will move to licensed legalization, which is when you

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: will have the option of just going somewhere.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And you know what you're getting into.

body.input: So 2035 is when I think that will happen and the clinics will be sites of these initiations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And so it would be a safe environment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: experience and all those kinds of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It is a frustratingly slow process.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And the FDA being part of that process is very frustrating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But of course, there's benefits.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But boy, I wish it could move a lot faster.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: it seems like they'll be with you forever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So while we say it's frustratingly slow, and it is, I mean, it's 50 years since the psychedelic

Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's tremendously sad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: At the same time, culture evolves slowly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Can we talk a little bit about PTSD and MDMA?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: There's this fascinating paper came out on a fascinating study that you're a part of.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That's a phase three study.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Can you describe what the findings are and why it's in fact so important and impactful?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: This study came out May 10th in Nature Medicine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: One of the highest impact factors in medicine journals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It was tremendous.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So to make a drug into a medicine, the first thing you need to do is what are called non-clinical

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: or pre-clinical studies, meaning safety established in animals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What does the drug do?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What are the side effects in animals?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Where do you see the risks?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: When you negotiate with FDA to do phase one studies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And phase one studies are where you move from animals to humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And those are more safety studies and trying to describe what the drug does so that you

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: can determine if there is potential medical value there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Certain drugs like cancer drugs are so toxic that you don't have phase one studies in healthy

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: volunteers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That's like phase one slash two where you bring in the patients, but you still are doing

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: sort of dose response safety studies, but you use patients.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But most phase one studies are healthy volunteers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Phase two are where you start bringing in the patients and you start experimenting

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: with various different things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The purpose of phase two is really just to design phase three.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Now, again, I'm sort of putting out of the picture in another area is mechanism of action.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: are the risks, who do you include, who do you exclude, what are the doses, what is your

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: treatment, what are your measures?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: In our case, it was how do you do a double blind study?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That was a big part of phase two.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That's a big challenge for psychedelic drugs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: it's a placebo or not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And the researcher is not aware.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: For that lack of awareness, when the effect is really strong, it's very difficult to do

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: on both the researcher and the patient side.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Sometimes they talk about triple blind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: You ideally want triple blind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: You want the patients, the researchers, and the evaluators of the outcomes, all of them,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: not to know what the drug, whether it was drug or placebo, and that's to reduce experiment

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: or bias.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Then you move to phase three.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Once you've figured out how to design the phase three studies, and phase three are the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: large scale multi-site placebo controlled double blind studies where you must prove

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: safety and efficacy in order to get permission to market the drug.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: For us, when we started MAPS in 86, as I said, it was one year after the criminalization

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: of MDMA in 85, we had five different protocols that were rejected by the FDA for studying

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: with MDMA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: These were all various phase one studies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: They came from Harvard, from UC San Francisco, from the University of Arizona, and Albuquerque,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: New Mexico, all over, and they were all rejected.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: 1992, six years after we started, we got the first permission for phase one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That took us through much of the 90s.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Again, things are slow because we have to raise the money through donations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Then in 1999 is when we started to work with PTSD.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That then took us till November 29th, 2016, which is when we had the end of phase two

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: meeting with FDA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It took 30 years from the start of MAPS to the end of phase two meeting with FDA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What we had discovered during phase two was several different key points.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The drugs that are available right now for PTSD, the SSRIs, Zoloft and Paxil, that have

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: been approved by FDA and regulators in Europe as well, the European Medicines Agency, for

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: PTSD, they work better in women than in men, and they failed in combat-related PTSD.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What we learned is that MDMA-assisted therapy works just as well in men or women, and it

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: works in combat-related PTSD.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It works in regardless of the cause of PTSD.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We also discovered that even though there are stories that people take MDMA at raves

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: and they dance all night and they overheat and they get hypothermia and they die from

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: overheating, which is true and can happen from pure MDMA, or that sometimes people have

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: heard about needing to cool down and so they drink water while they're dancing all night

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: and then they drink too much water and then they dilute their blood and they die from

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: hyponitremia.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So, there are risks of MDMA, but we discovered that in a therapeutic setting, we can control

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: all those risks, those things don't happen at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So, we discovered safety.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We could demonstrate safety.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We also figured out that our measure, the CAHPS, the Clinician-Administrated PTSD Scale,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: that it's the gold standard all over the world for measuring PTSD symptoms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's what the FDA and the EMA require.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We discovered that it was a good measure for us and that we could show changes in that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The other big thing that we learned is that, and we haven't mentioned this yet, but the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: work in the 50s and 60s with LSD and psilocybin and the modern research over the last 20 years

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: with psilocybin and classic psychedelics has demonstrated that there's a link between this

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: mystical experience, this unit of mystical experience and therapeutic outcomes for the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: treatment of addiction, for working with people with life-threatening illnesses, for OCD,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: for obsessive-compulsive disorder, that there's, with the classic psychedelics, both in the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: 50 years ago and then the research now has been that there's a link between the depth

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: of the mystical experience and therapeutic outcome.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What we discovered is that that's not the case for MDMA, that people do score fairly

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: high on the scales of mystical experience, not as high as they do with the classic psychedelics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: but they do score pretty high on average.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: A significant number of them have over the cutoff for what would be considered a full

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: mystical experience, so enough to say that we could look at a correlation and we didn't

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: find any.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The other thing that we discovered, and this was more humbling, I would say for me personally,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: is that my dissertation at the Kennedy School, a big part of it was on the, it's about the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: regulation of the medical use of psychedelics and marijuana.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Big part of my dissertation was how to do the double-blind study, and I thought I'd

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: solve the problem, and I persuaded my dissertation committee that I'd solve the problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The solution was therapy with low-dose MDMA versus therapy with full-dose MDMA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Everybody knows that they're going to get MDMA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Most of these people have never done it before.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: They'll be confused about is it full-dose or low-dose.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Then the challenge is to pick a dose that's high enough so that there is this confusion,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: but not so high that it's so therapeutic that we can't tell the difference between the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: groups.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We studied zero, meaning inactive placebo, 25 milligrams, 30 milligrams, 40 milligrams,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: 50 milligrams, 75 milligrams, 100 milligrams, 125, and 150.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What we discovered is that my dissertation was wrong and that there is no good solution

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: to the double-blind problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What we found is that, to our surprise actually, was that 75 milligrams was an effective dose.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We didn't think that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I mean, the normal dose is like, full dose is like 125 milligrams, something like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But 75 milligrams was an effective dose.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We discovered that the lower doses, so I was half right, you could say, the doses of 25,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: 30, 40, 50, they could produce enough confusion that you could say that they were successful

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: at blinding.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Not perfectly, but enough confusion so that people, therapists couldn't know for sure

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: so that there was this reduction of bias, you could say.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But what we discovered, again, to our surprise, was that the low doses made people uncomfortable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: They stimulated them, but they didn't reduce the fear.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: People still got better with the therapy, with low dose MDMA, but if we gave them therapy

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: with inactive placebo, they did even better than if we gave them therapy with low dose

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: MDMA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We call it an antitherapeutic effect.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I don't mean to imply that they got worse, but it made people uncomfortable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: People didn't like it, but we would still help them make some progress.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We had the blinding, but what it meant by reducing the effect of therapy with inactive

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: placebo is that it would make it easier for us to find a difference between the two groups.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The real question is, if you can do it with therapy, why bother add a drug?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We went to the FDA, and so this was what we discovered during phase two.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We went to the FDA at this end of phase two meeting, and we said, we can give you blinding,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: but it will make it easier for us to find a difference between the two groups.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We suggest that we do therapy with inactive placebo versus therapy with full dose MDMA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That will cause a problem because most people will be able to tell what they've got.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Tom Loffran, a doctor who used to be head of psychiatry products at FDA, is our main

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: advisor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The first thing he said is that the double blind fails in practice a lot, even with SSRIs,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: because there are certain side effects that you have with these drugs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The doctors who are doing these research, when you're reporting your side effects, they

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: can say, oh, that's probably you got the active drug instead of the placebo.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The double blind is, in theory, is terrific, but in practice, it doesn't always work quite

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What Tom said is that there are two main approaches that they think are important to reduce bias.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The first one is easy to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's called random assignment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Sometimes there are studies where you'll treat a bunch of people with something, and some

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: fraction of them will get better, and some won't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Then you say, okay, all those who didn't get better, who volunteers to get this new treatment?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Then you give them the new treatment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But the people that volunteer are more likely to want to get better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: They're not representative sample of everybody that has the disease.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: When you have random assignment, everybody is similarly motivated and meets the same

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: inclusion exclusion criteria.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That's what we told.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Of course, we need random assignment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The other part was when the bias double blind doesn't work as well, then the system of independent

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: raters is especially important of how you do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We have over a pool of raters, over 20 of them, and we do this monthly inter-rater reliability

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: tests to make sure that they evaluate this so that they're given a videotape of a PTSD

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: patient, and then they're supposed to rate them according to their symptoms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Then we make sure that we've got this calibrated rater pool.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's all done by Zoom, by telemedicine, and they're randomly assigned to the next person

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: that needs a rating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: You said 20 raters.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We've got like 20 raters.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What we want to do is make it so that each rater sees each patient only once, maybe twice,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: but not tracking them through the study so that guys to reduce the bias in the raters,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: that they don't know where this person is in the study.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: There's a fellow, Bob Temple, who's like the old wise man at the FDA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: He's been there since 1972.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: He was in charge of the Office of Science Policy, and they brought him into the final

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: meeting of this process where we were trying to design phase three.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Once FDA said, yes, you can go to phase three, that was November 29th, 2016, we then negotiated

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: for eight months on the design of phase three and all of the other information that the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: FDA is going to need.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: This process of design.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: To the extent that I have any artistic creativity, it's in protocol design.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I really love that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So you enjoy this process.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I love it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I love it because it's always trade-offs, and I acknowledge that we are all biased.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: There's something beautiful about the scientific process designed to get you to the truth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Especially when that scientific process is trying to get to the truth of the human organism,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: which is so complicated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So it's very difficult to dissect, to get the strong effects.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: When you're analyzing, when you have raters, they're watching a video.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Removing subjectivity from that is very, very challenging.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah, very much so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We came to this agreement with FDA though, that we would use this independent rater pool.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We learned in phase two again that the double-blind, there was no solution to the double-blind

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Both the FDA and the European Medicines Agency in the end agreed that the best design was

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: therapy with inactive placebo versus therapy with full dose MDMA, accepting the fact that

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: most people will be able to tell whether they got nothing or they got full dose MDMA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Most therapists will be able to tell the difference, but that makes a harder test for us to show

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: a difference between the two groups because we're giving them inactive placebo and not

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: the antitherapeutic effect of low dose MDMA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Once we started phase three, so then we were able to start in 2018 phase three.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The paper in Nature Medicine that just came out was the results of our first phase three

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: study.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We came to agreement with FDA that we would do two phase three studies, each would have

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: 100 persons in them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What the FDA said to us is that they thought that we could prove efficacy with smaller

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: numbers than they wanted to see for safety.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The reason they said that is that in phase two, we had a large effect size.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: From a statistical point of view, the bigger of an effect that you're looking for, the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: fewer number of people you need to get statistical significance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: When you're trying to find small differences, you need large numbers of people to work out

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: the noise.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We came to agreement on two 100 person phase three studies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The idea is that it's very possible that the first study would show the efficacy because

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: the effect is so strong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah, and the second, but also safety as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: One of the things we also realized when you work with a highly stigmatized drug in the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: midst of still the drug war and prohibition, that we need highly sympathetic subjects.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We need to make the best case we can, which means we need to work with the hardest cases

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: so that this is really needed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We end up enrolling people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The first study was chronic severe PTSD.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Unlike many studies of PTSD, we enroll people that have previously attempted suicide.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We have multiple people that have tried to kill themselves that we felt like if we were

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: to exclude them, what are we doing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Those are the people that need it the most.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So we came to this agreement with FDA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We're going to work with chronic severe PTSD patients, including those that had attempted

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: suicide.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We would do these two 100 person studies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We also negotiated what's called an interim analysis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What that means is that when the study is underway, and often big, big studies, they

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: have this kind of interim analysis where what you do is... And for us, we negotiated when

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: we had 60% or 60 people had reached the primary outcome measure and all 100 had been enrolled,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: then we would take a look at the data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And if the statistical analysis that we did was showing based on a certain effect size

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: that we chose based on what we saw in phase two, the interim analysis is for what's called

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: sample size re-estimation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So what it means is if the results aren't as good as you thought they would, you can

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: add more people and then you'll get statistical significance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It means that your effect isn't as strong as you thought.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It'll be harder to get insurance to cover it, but FDA will still approve it because

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: FDA also believes that these are group averages.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: There may be some people that will later figure out respond better than others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So they'll approve it if it's statistically significant, even if it has a low effect size.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The SSRIs have low effect size.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So we did the interim analysis in March of 2020, and what we discovered to our delight

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: was that we did not need to add any subjects.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That's all we were told.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We weren't told what is the results.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We were just told all we were going to get is a number, zero, or you need to add X numbers

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: of people to the study to get statistical significance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That's right around the time that COVID hit and lockdowns happened.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We ended up negotiating with FDA that we would end the study with 90 people instead of 100.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It took a while for us to end up doing that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So the paper that we just published is on the results of 90 people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I think it was 46 in the MDMA group, 44 in the placebo group.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What we discovered was that the study worked better than we had even hoped.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So the first thing is that you look at statistical significance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: You have to get 0.05, which basically means a nickel out of a dollar, a one in 20 chance

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: that the difference between the two groups is due to some random factor rather than to

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: your intervention.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: In this case, the placebo group gets therapy with inactive placebo, and then the group

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: gets MDMA with active placebo.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So you have to get 0.05.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: There's another measure that the FDA uses sometimes called robust, which means one in

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: a thousand.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Instead of one in 20, one in a thousand.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: If you get a robust results, 0.001, and you meet some other criteria, they might agree

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: to approve the drug on the basis of just one phase three study instead of two.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Because when you think about it, a one in 20 chance for your first phase three study,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: a one in 20 chance for your second phase three study, you multiply that together, it's one

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202
Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That's pretty good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So robust, 0.001 is even better than two independent phase three studies, each at 0.05.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What we ended up getting was one in 10,000, 0.0001.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Outrageous.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That's a measure of both the difference between the two groups and the variability.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What it meant is that we had minimal variability, that most people who got the MDMA got quite

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: a large amount of benefit from it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Most people who got the placebo were more or less in the same range as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That's really exciting, by the way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I suppose it's exciting from a perspective of approval by the FDA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Maybe perhaps that's the way you're seeing it, but it's also exciting because it has

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: a chance to help people that are truly suffering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: If we can get one in 10,000 in the first phase three study, chances are we can get one in

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: 20 in the second.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So it's really going to be about safety for us in the second phase three study.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Now you can have a large p-value, a large significance, but you could have an effect

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: that's not very significant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's not clinically significant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: You can have statistical significance without clinical significance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: As I said, the more people you get in the study, you can find smaller and smaller differences

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: between two groups.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Now we showed that we had a very large effect size.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So effect size is based on- That scale you mentioned?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Well, the scale of the effect size is based on standard deviations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So an effect size of one means that your results are one standard deviation away from the norm.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That's considered very large.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The SSRIs, because they were like 0.3, 0.4 effect size, that's considered small effect

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: size.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The difference is starting to be around 0.6 and 0.8 and above are large effect sizes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We had what's called placebo subtracted effect size.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: There's two different ways to look at it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Placebo subtracted means you kind of look at the difference between your two groups.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And what that is for us, since one group had therapy and one had therapy plus MDMA, the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: placebo subtracted effect size is basically the effect of just the MDMA because you've

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: kind of washed out the therapy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That was 0.91.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So we had a large effect size, which was-

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Wow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So 0.91 over just the therapy, so over the placebo.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Wow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Now, when we do the within group, meaning the group that just got the MDMA plus therapy,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: look at their baseline and their outcomes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That's another way to look at it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And that's what's going to actually happen in practice because people are going to get

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: MDMA plus therapy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That's 2.1 effect size.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Two standard deviations away from the norm.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's enormous effect size.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The other part is that we had no effect by sight, which is very important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So we had 15 sites, two in Israel, two in Canada, 11 throughout the United States.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The FDA looks at, is there a side effect?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Because what that might mean is maybe you've got all your patients or most of your patients

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: going to this one site, which is these highly experienced therapists and they're like hippies

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: from way back and they're super experienced with psychedelics and they're getting great

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: results, but nobody else gets good results.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So we had no effect by sight, which means-

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That's incredible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That we've been able to train all these new therapists.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We had about 80 therapists working at all these 15 sites.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We also discovered that there's a group that's considered to be very difficult to treat,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: which is called the dissociative subtype.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So when people are traumatized, one of the ways to psychologically survive that is you

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: dissociate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's like you're not there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: When you do that though, it's hard to come back because when you come back, then you

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: get all these painful memories and fearful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And so the extreme of that is called dissociative identity disorder, kind of like schizophrenia,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: almost dissociative identity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So we let people in who are on the dissociative subtype and those are considered to be the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: hardest to treat because the theory is that you need to be ego intact.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: As I said, the mystical experience is not correlated with therapeutic outcomes and you

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: need to be talking about what traumatized you and working through that and expressing

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: it, letting it out, not keeping it in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So the dissociative subtype seems like it's harder for them to get back into the event

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: because they're so dissociated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What we showed is that those people did even better on average than everybody else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So that MDMA is integrative.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It helps people who are so separate that they make even more rapid progress.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So it's almost like the MDMA made it more difficult for them to dissociate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Or you could say it made it easier for them to remember.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yes, exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: To reverse the dissociation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And we find that MDMA enhances memory for the trauma so that you can have these unconscious

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: memories, or memories that you cannot remember or that you've suppressed so much, but they

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: distort your view.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Your filter of the world is distorted by these fearful memories that the world can't be trusted,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: people can't be trusted, it's always about to happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So we find that MDMA increases memory for the trauma, but by reducing the fear, then

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: the memories can come to the surface.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Then you can process them, let out the emotions, cry, scream, shake, whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And then through this MDMA effect on the amygdala and the hippocampus, it helps you store these

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: memories into long-term storage so that they're not always about to happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: They're in the past.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: They're part of your story, but they're not the whole story.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So we discovered that the dissociative subtype works better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Now none of this would be enough unless safety.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So from a safety perspective, what we discovered is that there was one woman in the study that

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: attempted to kill herself twice during the study.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: There was another woman that was so worried that she might kill herself, that the therapy

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: brought these things to the surface, that she's been pushing away, that she checked

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: herself into a hospital in order to avoid self-harm.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: At the end of the study, what we learned is both of them were in the placebo group.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We didn't have anybody in the MDMA group attempt to kill themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So the MDMA is really helpful for giving people a sense of hope and that they can somehow

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: process this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Now it's not to say that nobody will ever commit suicide.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That's our big concern in the second phase three study.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: As I said, it's more going to be about safety than about efficacy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We think we'll get the efficacy, but we're very concerned about safety.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Because we had problems in the first phase three study of somebody trying to kill herself

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: twice in the placebo group, it's the background for having PTSD.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So there'd have to be a disproportionate number of people in the MDMA group try to kill themselves

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202
