metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I'm hopeful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And that's our goal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But in this landscape of pharma companies, they make a lot of money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Some people are worried about the impact of those, you know, of big pharma on the landscape

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: of human trauma.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So there's, of course, some companies could do good, but that's not inherent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Like many of these companies are not optimizing for good, they're optimizing for profit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Does this rise of for-profit pharma companies worry you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: How do you navigate it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Do we still have for-profit companies that basically do what MAPS does, which is like

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: fight the good fight for the benefit of humanity?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Like how do we proceed in this in landscape work where drugs can make a lot of money?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Well, I am concerned.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Overall, I think the rise of the for-profit companies we have to realize is a sign of

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: success that we have overcome the regulatory prohibitions, we've overcome a lot of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: public attitudes that are against it, we've demonstrated some success.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So the rise of the for-profit companies are a sign of the progress that we've made.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: On the other hand, turning things over to profit-maximizing companies, the big concern

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: is that they're going to try to minimize the amount of therapy and make it so the cost

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: is less, so insurance companies are more likely to cover it and then that they just sell the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: most drugs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The other thing we've seen as an example of this is S-ketamine by Johnson & Johnson for

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: depression, and it's done by a profit-maximizing company.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: They don't know anything about psychedelic psychotherapy or psychotherapy at all, and

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: so they've gotten approval for S-ketamine on the basis of it's just a pharmacological

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: treatment and it's not delivered with therapy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The results fade pretty quickly, so you need to get more ketamine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And so it's designed in a way to maximize the profits for the pharmaceutical company,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: but it doesn't maximize patient outcomes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What we're seeing though in these various clinics that are being set up is that a lot

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: of people are realizing that it works better with therapy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And so the clinics are run by people that are therapists so that when they provide therapy,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: they're making more money and then you need less ketamine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Also ketamine itself, S-ketamine is an isomer of ketamine that's been patented for depression

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: and they sell it for hundreds of dollars, but ketamine itself is one of the world's

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: essential medicines.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's off patent, it's been around for a long time, it was the main battlefield anesthetic

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: in Vietnam.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And it's only a few bucks because it's generic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So a lot of the ketamine clinics are saying, great, thank you Johnson & Johnson, you've

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: helped demonstrate that ketamine is good for depression, but we're not going to buy it

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: from you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We're going to buy it for a few bucks and we're going to add therapy to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Now there's a bunch of ketamine mills you could say that are just prescribing the ketamine

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: and people are making a lot of money there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So I am worried about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I think the best thing that we can do is create an alternative narrative, a different kind

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: of example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We can lead by example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We can't make for-profit companies into benefit corporations unless they want to do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We can't make them to really maximize patient outcomes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But if we create an example of something that's different, the hope is that people will gravitate

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: towards that and some of the other companies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Even now we have Exxon and other of these companies, oil companies saying, oh, we're

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: big into alternative energy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And that starts with companies that show an example that then communicates to the public

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: that this is something exciting and then they demand the same of Exxon and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The public demands it and you could say the same thing for the public demanding the big

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: pharma to optimize for benefit versus optimize for profit and maybe giving power to the therapists,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: more power to the therapists, more power to the doctors that ultimately want, I think,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: incentives are interesting, but I think doctors ultimately care more because they're in direct

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: contact with humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: They want to make people better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's not sure they want to make money, but they ultimately want to make people feel better

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: because they get to look at people and it's so joyful to make people feel better at the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: end of the day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So giving more power to them is also perhaps one of the ways that you then incentivize

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: the pharma companies that are trying to do good because the doctors will choose those

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: companies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The other part of this is drug policy reform so that if we make it so that you can buy

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: MDMA for 10 or 20 bucks on your own and we've trained people on here's our therapeutic method,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: here is our ways for peer support, then people have an alternative from buying it from the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: pharma companies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So most of the for-profit companies have come to this conclusion that drug policy reform

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: is bad for their business model.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I think they're making a fundamental mistake and I think the reason is that the more that

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: we destigmatize this, the more that we sensitize people to this is an approach.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Even when people can get it on their own and do it with their friends or do it with themselves,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: there's going to be even more people that say, oh my God, I've got real serious issues.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I would rather go to trained professionals covered by insurance and I think it'll increase

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: the business.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But most of the for-profit companies don't see it that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And so as a nonprofit that owns a benefit corp, we're not trying to maximize sales or

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: profits.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But I do believe that drug policy reform creates this alternative access point for people and

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: that will help keep the for-profits in check to some extent as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I love it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Let's put on your wise visionary hat and ask, when you look to young folks, is there advice

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: you can give to young people today whether in high school or college about career, about

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: You've lived quite a nonlinear and fascinating life yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Is there advice you can give either on career or more generally on life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Well, I would say what people often hear is that we're not actually here for that long

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: period of time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And the world is on fire.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And whether humanity survives is not clear.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And how many species are we going to kill before we figure out not to do that anymore?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So I would advise you to really try to develop a combination of what do you need in terms

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: of income for your own survival, but what does the world need in terms of help to make

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: the world better?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And Howard Thurman, who we talked about, who ran the Good Friday experiment, the minister

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: there, he's got a famous quote attributed to him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: He says, and this is exactly it to young people, he said, there's nothing particular that you

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: should do, but find what makes you come alive because what the world needs is people that

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: have come alive and are passionate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So I would say that beware of this trap that you need vast resources, that you need all

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: this stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I keep thinking of the super wealthy people in first class on the Titanic, as the Titanic

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: is sinking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Their money's not going to help them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The earth is like Titanic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We're sinking, we're destroying the planet, destroying the environment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So you need a certain amount of money to be comfortable, to not be at that edge of survival.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Because once you're at that edge of survival, it's hard to think about anything else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But I'd say to young people, to the extent that you're able to do this, and again, student

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: debt and all this kind of stuff is a big problem there too, but really just try to find this

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: combination of what the world needs and what you need.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The other thing to say to young people is life is a lot shorter than you think, and

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: a 20-year plan is not really that long.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So if it takes you 20 years to get in a position to do what you want to do, go for it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Have long-term plans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The other part that was so important for me to keep doing what I've been doing, basically

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: now it's 49 years that I've been devoting my life on psychedelics since I was 18.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: When I started, I didn't think it would ever work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I just thought this is the only idea I have in this crazy world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: This is what I want to work on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Luckily, I had support from my family that took care of my survival needs, so I could

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But I realized that if my happiness was dependent upon accomplishments, that I might never be

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: happy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: That I was able to reframe happiness in terms of effort.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So if I'm trying hard to get stuff to be better, whether it's better or not, I can be happy

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: at the end of each day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I tried.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And so I think you try to separate out the goals that you have and your happiness to

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: whether you're trying hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The other thing I would say is that everybody has this humanity within them, so be very

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: careful about dividing the world into us and them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So one of the things that I've done that has taken a long time because I feel like drugs

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: are illegal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I always felt like the police were the predator and I'm the prey.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: But now we're working with the police and the police have tremendous trauma from the

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: work that they do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: We have one police officer who is now going, he's a full-time police officer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: He's also a psychotherapist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And he's going through our training program to learn how to give MDMA therapy to other

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: police officers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And I met his police chief a couple of times.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: He got permission from his police chief to go to the second part of our training program,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: which is where we give MDMA to therapists who volunteer as a patient.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So we have just a couple of weeks ago dosed the police with MDMA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And so I think this idea of those people that are on the quote other side, try to see through

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: that to their humanity, to what their pains and suffering, what their struggles are to

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: the extent that you can.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And build long-term relationships.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: You never know what's going to come around 20 years from now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: So you help some people try to keep these relationships going 20 years from now, something

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: could come.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And also be persistent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: I think that's been the key to success.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Once the FDA or DEA figured out we're not going anywhere, they're going to have to deal

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: with us, then we started getting some progress.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: It's a mix of patience and stubbornness that gets things done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Is there something you've figured out through your journey with psychedelics about some

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: of the big why questions about life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: What the heck's the value of love?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Why does it suck so much that we die?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: And for some of us, maybe it's the Russian in me, but it's quite terrifying the notion

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Or the biggest why question of them all, which is what's the meaning of it all?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Well, yeah, what I've discovered is that we don't need the answers to those questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: The fact that we can feel happy, that we can love, that we can have moments of happiness,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: that's enough.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rick Doblin: Psychedelics | Lex Fridman Podcast #202

body.input: Figuring out these big questions, you can get lost in that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joe Rogan: Fear, Love, Chaos, and the Joe Rogan Experience | Lex Fridman Podcast #127

metadata.title: Podcast: Joe Rogan: Fear, Love, Chaos, and the Joe Rogan Experience | Lex Fridman Podcast #127

metadata.title: Podcast: Joe Rogan: Fear, Love, Chaos, and the Joe Rogan Experience | Lex Fridman Podcast #127

body.input: is limited can aid you greatly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joe Rogan: Fear, Love, Chaos, and the Joe Rogan Experience | Lex Fridman Podcast #127

body.input: I think knowing that this is a temporary time, that we have finite life spans, I think there's

metadata.title: Podcast: Joe Rogan: Fear, Love, Chaos, and the Joe Rogan Experience | Lex Fridman Podcast #127

body.input: great power in that because it motivates you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joe Rogan: Fear, Love, Chaos, and the Joe Rogan Experience | Lex Fridman Podcast #127

body.input: It gets you going.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joe Rogan: Fear, Love, Chaos, and the Joe Rogan Experience | Lex Fridman Podcast #127

metadata.title: Podcast: Joe Rogan: Fear, Love, Chaos, and the Joe Rogan Experience | Lex Fridman Podcast #127

body.input: particularly if everybody else was dying around you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joe Rogan: Fear, Love, Chaos, and the Joe Rogan Experience | Lex Fridman Podcast #127

body.input: And I think one of the things that makes life so interesting and fascinating is that it

metadata.title: Podcast: Joe Rogan: Fear, Love, Chaos, and the Joe Rogan Experience | Lex Fridman Podcast #127

body.input: doesn't last.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joe Rogan: Fear, Love, Chaos, and the Joe Rogan Experience | Lex Fridman Podcast #127

body.input: You know, that you really get a brief amount of time here.

body.input: And really by the time you're just starting to kind of figure yourself out who you are

metadata.title: Podcast: Joe Rogan: Fear, Love, Chaos, and the Joe Rogan Experience | Lex Fridman Podcast #127

body.input: and how not to screw things up so bad, like time's up.

body.input: The ride's over.

body.input: folks are out of work and through no fault of their own and can't make ends meet and

metadata.title: Podcast: Joe Rogan: Fear, Love, Chaos, and the Joe Rogan Experience | Lex Fridman Podcast #127

body.input: these people feel so helpless and angry, it's a particularly divisive time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joe Rogan: Fear, Love, Chaos, and the Joe Rogan Experience | Lex Fridman Podcast #127

body.input: It's a particularly turmoil filled time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joe Rogan: Fear, Love, Chaos, and the Joe Rogan Experience | Lex Fridman Podcast #127

body.input: And it just doesn't seem like the world of a year ago even, it feels very chaotic and

metadata.title: Podcast: Joe Rogan: Fear, Love, Chaos, and the Joe Rogan Experience | Lex Fridman Podcast #127

body.input: dangerous.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joe Rogan: Fear, Love, Chaos, and the Joe Rogan Experience | Lex Fridman Podcast #127

body.input: And it's a small thing in terms of the possibilities of things that could happen to the world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Joe Rogan: Fear, Love, Chaos, and the Joe Rogan Experience | Lex Fridman Podcast #127

body.input: like a pandemic, the one we've experienced, it really just doubles the amount of deaths

metadata.title: Podcast: Joe Rogan: Fear, Love, Chaos, and the Joe Rogan Experience | Lex Fridman Podcast #127

body.input: impact, a real horrific pandemic or one that really wipes out millions and millions of people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joe Rogan: Fear, Love, Chaos, and the Joe Rogan Experience | Lex Fridman Podcast #127

metadata.title: Podcast: Joe Rogan: Fear, Love, Chaos, and the Joe Rogan Experience | Lex Fridman Podcast #127

metadata.title: Podcast: Joe Rogan: Fear, Love, Chaos, and the Joe Rogan Experience | Lex Fridman Podcast #127

metadata.title: Podcast: Joe Rogan: Fear, Love, Chaos, and the Joe Rogan Experience | Lex Fridman Podcast #127

metadata.title: Podcast: Joe Rogan: Fear, Love, Chaos, and the Joe Rogan Experience | Lex Fridman Podcast #127

metadata.title: Podcast: Joe Rogan: Fear, Love, Chaos, and the Joe Rogan Experience | Lex Fridman Podcast #127

metadata.title: Podcast: Joe Rogan: Fear, Love, Chaos, and the Joe Rogan Experience | Lex Fridman Podcast #127

metadata.title: Podcast: Joe Rogan: Fear, Love, Chaos, and the Joe Rogan Experience | Lex Fridman Podcast #127

metadata.title: Podcast: Joe Rogan: Fear, Love, Chaos, and the Joe Rogan Experience | Lex Fridman Podcast #127

metadata.title: Podcast: Joe Rogan: Fear, Love, Chaos, and the Joe Rogan Experience | Lex Fridman Podcast #127

metadata.title: Podcast: Joe Rogan: Fear, Love, Chaos, and the Joe Rogan Experience | Lex Fridman Podcast #127

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's some sort of metaphysical claim.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Meaning in life are those factors that make people rate their lives as more

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: meaningful, worth living, worth the suffering that they have to endure.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And when you study that, what you see is it's a sense of connectedness.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Connectedness to yourself, to other people, to the world, and a

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: particular kind of connectedness.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: You want to be connected to things that have a value and an existence

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: independent of your egocentric sort of preferences and concerns.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: This is why, for example, having a child is considered very meaningful because

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: you're connecting to something that's going to have a life and a value

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: independent of you.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Now the question that comes up for me, well, there's two questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: One is why is that at risk right now?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And then secondly, and I think you have to answer the second question first,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: which is, well, yeah, but why is meaning so important?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Why is this sense of connectedness so important to human beings?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Why, when it is lacking, do they typically fall into depression,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: potentially mental illness, addiction, self-destructive behavior?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And so the first answer I give you is, well, it's that sense of connectedness.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And people often express it metaphorically.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: They want to be connected to something larger than themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: They want to matter.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: They don't mean it literally.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I mean, if I chained you to a mountain, you wouldn't thereby say, oh, now

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: my life is so fulfilling, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So what they're trying to convey, they're using this metaphor to try and say,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: they want to be connected.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: They want to be connected to something real.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: They want to make a difference and matter to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And one way of asking them, well, you know, what's meaningful is tell me what

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: you would like to continue to exist, even if you weren't around anymore.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And how are you connected to it?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And how do you matter to it?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's one way of trying to get at it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What is the source of meaning for you is if you were no longer there, you would

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: like it to continue existing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's not the only part of the definition probably, because there's

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: probably many things that aren't a source of meaning for me that maybe I find

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: beautiful that I would like to continue existing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: If it contributes to your life being meaningful, you're connected to

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: it in some way and it matters to you.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And you matter to it in that you make some difference to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's when it goes from being just sort of true, good and beautiful to being a

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: source of meaning for you in your life.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Is the meaning crisis a new thing or has it always been with us?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Is it part of the human condition in general?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's an excellent question.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And part of the argument I made in awakening from the meaning crisis is

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: there's two aspects to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: One is that there are perennial problems, perennial threats to meaning.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And in that sense, human beings are always vulnerable to despair.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The book of Ecclesiastes is it's all vanity, it's all meaningless.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: But there's also historical forces that have made those perennial problems

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: more pertinent, more pressing, more difficult for people to deal with.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And so the meaning crisis is actually the intersection of perennial problems,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: finding existence absurd, experiencing existential anxiety, feeling alienated,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and then pressing historical factors, which have to do with the loss of the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: resources that human beings have typically crossed historically and

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: cross-culturally made use of in order to address these perennial problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Is there something potentially that's been done in the past that's

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: been potentially deeper than just a lack of meaning that speaks to the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: fact that we're vulnerable to despair?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: You know, Ernest Becker talked about the, in his book, The Nile of Death,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: about the fear of death and being an important motivator in our life.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: As William James said, death is the warm at the core of the human condition.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Is it possible that this kind of search for meaning is coupled or can be seen

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: from the perspective of trying to escape the reality, the thought of one's own mortality?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yeah, Becker and the terror management theory that have come out of it,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: there's been some good work around sort of providing empirical support for that claim.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Some of the work, not so good.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So which aspects do you find convincing?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Can you steel man that case and then can you argue against it?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So what aspects I find convincing is that human being, human finitude, being finite,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: being inherently limited is very problematic for us.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Given the extensive use of the word problematic, I like that you used that

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: word to describe one's own mortality as problematic because people sort of on

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Twitter use the word problematic when they disagree with somebody.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: But this to me seems to be the ultimate problematic aspect of the human condition

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: is that we die and it ends.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I think I'm not disagreeing with you, but I'm trying to get you to consider

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: that your mortality is not an event in the future.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It's a state you're in right now.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's what I'm trying to get you to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's what I'm trying to shift.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So your mortality is just a, we talk about something that causes mortality fatal.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: But what we actually mean is it's full of fate.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And I don't mean in the sense of things that are pre-written.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What I mean is the sense of the universe doesn't care about your personal narrative.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: You can just have met the person that is going to be your own death.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The person that is going to be the love of your life.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It's the culmination of your whole project for happiness.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And you step into the street and a truck hits you and you die.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's mortality.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Mortality isn't just some far-flung event.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It's that every moment we are subject to fate in that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So you can think of lots of little deaths you experience whenever all the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: projects and the plans you make come up against the fact that the universe

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: can just roll over them.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So death is the indifference of nature, of the universe to your existence.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And so in that sense, it is always here with us.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: But you're vulnerable in so many ways other than just the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: ending of your biological life.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Because it's interesting if you rate what people fear most, death is not number one.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: They often put public speaking as number one, because the death of status or

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: reputation can also be a profound loss for human beings and drive them into despair.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So as the terror management folks would say, as Ernest Becker would say, that a

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: self-report on a survey is not an accurate way to capture what is actually at the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: core of the motivation of a human being.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That we could be terrified of death.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And we've from childhood, since we realized the absurdity of the fact that

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: the right ends, we've learned to really try to forget about it, try to construct

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: illusions that allow us to escape momentarily or for prolonged periods of

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: time, the realization that we die.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So first I took it seriously, but now I want to say why there's some empirical

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: work that makes me want to reconsider it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So terror management theory is you do things like you give people a list of

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: words to read and in those lists are words associated with death, cough and funeral.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And then you see what happens to people and generally they start to become more

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: rigid in their thinking, they tend to identify with their worldview.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: They lose cognitive flexibility.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's if you present it to them in that third person perspective.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: But if you get them to go into first person perspective and imagine that

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: they're dying and that the people that they care about are there with them.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: They don't show those responses.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: In fact, they show us an increase in cognitive flexibility and increase in

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: openness.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: See, so I'm trying to say we might be putting the cart before the horse.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It might not be death per se, but the kind of meaning that is present or

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: absent in depth, that is the crucial thing for us.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: By the way, to push back, I don't think you took it seriously.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I don't think you truly steel manned the case because you're saying that death is

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: always present with us.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: But isn't there a case to be made that it is one of the major motivators?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Nietzsche, will to power, Freud wanting to have sex with your mother, all the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: different explanations of what is truly motivating us human beings.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Isn't there a strong case to be made that this death thing is a really damn good

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: if not anything, a tool to motivate the behavior of humans?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I'm not saying that the avoidance of death is not significant for human beings,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: but I'm proposing to you that human beings have a capacity for considering

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: certain deaths, meaningful and certain deaths, meaningless.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And people, and we have lots of evidence that people are, are willing to sacrifice

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: their biological existence for a death they consider meaningful.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Are you personally afraid of your death?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Do you think about it as a, as somebody who produces a lot of ideas, records

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: them, writes them down as a deep thinker, admire thinker, and as the years go on,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: become more and more admired, does, does it scare you that the ride ends?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: No.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I mean, you have to talk to me on all my levels. I'm a biological organism.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So if something's thrown at my head, I'll duck and things like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: But if you're asking me, do I long to live forever?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: No.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: In the Buddhist tradition, there are practices that are designed to make

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: you aware of simultaneously the horror of mortality and the horror of immortality.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The thought of living forever is actually horrific.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It's actually horrific to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Are those the only two options?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Like, um, when you're sitting with a loved one or watching a movie, you just

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: really love or a book you really love.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: You don't want it to end.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: You don't necessarily always flip it to the other aspect, the complete opposite

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: of the thought experiment, what happens if the book lasts forever?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: There's gotta be a middle ground, like the snooze button.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: You don't want to sleep forever, but maybe press the snooze button and

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: get an extra 15 minutes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: There's surely some kind of balance that that fear seems to be a source of an

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: intense appreciation of the moment in part, I mean, that's what the Stoics

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: talked about to sort of the, to meditate on wants mortality seems to be a nice

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: wake up call to that life is a full of moments that are beautiful and then you

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: don't get an infinite number of them.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And the Stoic response was not the project of trying to extend the duration

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: of your life, but to deepen those moments.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So they become as satisfying as possible so that when death comes, it does not

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: strike you as any kind of calamity.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Does that project ring true for your own personal feelings?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I think so.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Do you think about your mortality?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I used to, I don't so much anymore.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Part of it as I'm older and your temporal horizon flips somewhere in your

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: thirties or forties, you don't live from your birth, you live towards your death.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's such a beautiful phrase.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The temporal horizon flips.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's so true.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's so true.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: At what point is that?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That the point before which the world of opportunity and possibility

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: is infinite before you.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It's like Peter Pan.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: There's all these golden possibilities and you fly around between them.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes, very much.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And then when it flips, you start to look for a different model.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The Socratic, the Stoic model of Buddhism has also influenced me, which is more

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: about, wait, when I look at my desires, I seem to have two meta desires.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: In addition to satisfying a particular desire, I want whatever satisfies

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: my desire to be real and whatever is satisfying my desire to not cause

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: internal conflict, but bring something like peace of mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And so I'm more and more moved towards how can I live such that those two

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: meta desires are a constant frame within which I'm trying to satisfy my

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: specific desires.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What do you think happens after we die?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I think mind and life go away completely when we die.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And I think that's actually significantly important for the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: kind of beings that we are.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: We are the kinds of beings that can come to that awareness and then we have a

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: responsibility to decide how we're going to comport ourselves towards it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Can you linger on what that means?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The mind goes away.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Like when you're playing music and the last instrument is put down, the song is over.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Doesn't mean the song wasn't beautiful.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Doesn't mean the song wasn't complex.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Doesn't mean the song wasn't beautiful.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Doesn't mean the song like didn't add to the value of the universe in its existence,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: but it came to an end.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Is there some aspect in which some part of mind was there before the human and

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: remains after something like panpsychism or is it too much for us, limited

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: cognitive beings to understand?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Something like panpsychism.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I take it seriously.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I don't think it's a ridiculous proposal, but I think it has insoluble

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: problems that make me doubt it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Any idea that the mind is some kind of ultimately immaterial substance also has,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: for me, just devastating problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Those are the two kinds of framework that people usually propose in order to

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: support some kind of idea of immortality.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I find both very problematic.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The fact that we participate in distributed cognition, that most of our

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: problem solving is not done as individuals, but in groups, this is something I work on.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I've published on that.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I think that's important.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: But most of the people who do work on systems of distributed cognition think

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: that while there's such a thing as collective intelligence, there's no good

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: evidence that there's collective consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: In fact, it's often called zombie agency for that reason.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And so while I think it's very clear that no one person runs an airline,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and there's a collective intelligence that solves that problem, I do not think

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: that collective intelligence supports any kind of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And so therefore I don't think the fact that I participate, which I regularly

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and reliably do in distributed cognition, gives me any reason to believe that

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: that participation grounds some kind of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317
