body.input: There's so many things to mention there.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: First of all, distributed cognition, maybe that's a synonym for collective

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: intelligence, so that means a bunch of humans individually are able to think,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: have cognitive machines and are somehow able to interact with the process of

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: dialogue as you talk about to more different ideas together, like this

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: idea landscape together is so interesting to think about.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Well, you do have these fascinating distributed cognitive

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: systems, distributed cognition systems, but consciousness does not propagate

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: in the same way as intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: But isn't there a case, if we just look at intelligence, if we look at us

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: humans as a collection of smaller organisms, which we are, and so there's

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: a hierarchy of organisms, tiny ones work together to form tiny villages that

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: you can then start to see as individual organisms that are then also forming

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: bigger villages and interacting different ways and function becomes more and more

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: complex and eventually we get to us humans to where we start to think, well,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: we're an individual, but really we're not, there's billions of organisms inside us.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So isn't that building up consciousnesses like turtles all the way up to our

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: consciousness, why does it have to stop with us humans?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Are we the only, like, is this the phase transition when it becomes a zombie

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: like giant hierarchical village that first like, oh, there's like a singing

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: angels and it's consciousness is born.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And just us humans do bacteria have consciousness, not bacteria, but maybe

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: you could say bacteria does, but like the interesting complicated organisms

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: that are within us have consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I think it's proper to argue.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And I have that like a paramecium or bacteria has a kind of agency and even a

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: kind of intelligence, a kind of sense making ability, but I do not think that

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: we can attribute consciousness, at least what we mean by consciousness, this kind

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: of self awareness, this ability to introspect, et cetera, et cetera, to bacteria.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Now, the reason why distributed cognition doesn't have consciousness, I

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: think is a little bit more tricky.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And I think there's no reason in principle why there couldn't be a

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: consciousness for distributed cognition.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Collective intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: In fact, many philosophers would agree with me on that point.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I think it's more an issue of certain empirical facts, bandwidth, density of

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: connections, speed of information transfer, et cetera.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It's conceivable that if we got some horrible Frankensteinian neural link

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and we linked our brains and we linked our brains and we linked our brains

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and we linked our brains and we had the right density and dynamics and bandwidth

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and speed that a group consciousness could take shape.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I don't have any argument in principle against that.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I'm just saying those, those contingent facts do not yet exist.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And therefore it is implausible that consciousness exists at the level

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: of collective intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So you talk about consciousness quite a bit.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So let's step back and try to sneak up to a definition.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What is consciousness?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: For me, there are two aspects to answering that question.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: One is what's the nature of consciousness?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: How does something like consciousness exist in an otherwise apparently

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: non-conscious universe?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And then there's a function question, which is equally important, which is

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: what does consciousness do?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The first one is obviously, you know, problematic for most people.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Like, yeah, consciousness seems to be so different from the rest of the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: non-conscious universe, but I put it to you that the function question is also

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: very hard because you are clearly capable of very sophisticated, intelligent

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: behavior without consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: You are turning the noises coming out of my face hole into ideas in your mind,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and you have no conscious awareness of how that process is occurring.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So why do we have consciousness at all?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Now, here's the thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: There's an extra question you need to ask.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Should we attempt to answer those questions separately or should we attempt

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: to answer them in an integrated fashion?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I make the case that you actually have to answer them in an integrated fashion.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What consciousness does and what it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: We should be able to give it a unified answer to both of those.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Can you try to elucidate the difference between what consciousness is and what

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: it does, both of which are mysteries, as you say, state versus action?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Can you try to explain the difference?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's interesting that that's useful.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's important to understand.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So that's putting me in a bit of a difficult position because I actually

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: argue that trying to answer them separately is ultimately incoherent.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: But what I can point to are many published articles in which only one of

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: these problems is addressed and the other is left unaddressed.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So people will try and explain what qualia are, how they potentially

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: emerge without saying, what do they do?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What problems do they help to solve?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: How do they make the organism more adaptive?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And then you'll have other people who'll say, no, no, this is what

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: the function of consciousness is.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: But I don't know, I can't tell you, I can't solve the hard problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I don't know how qualia exist.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So what I'm saying is many people treat these problems separately, although

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I think that's ultimately an incoherent way to approach the problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So the hard problem is focusing on the, what it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So the qualia that the, it feels like something to experience a thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's what consciousness is and does is more about the functional

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: usefulness of the thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: To the whole beautiful mix of cognition and just function in everyday life.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: You've also said that you can do very intelligent things without consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Clearly.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Is that obvious to you?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I don't know what I'm doing to access my memory.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It just kind of, it's like, I'm just trying to figure out

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: what's going on in my brain.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And it just comes up and it comes up really intelligently.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: But the mechanisms that create consciousness could be deeply

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: interlinked with whatever is doing the memory access that's doing the.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Oh, I think so.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The cognition.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So I guess what I'm trying to say in this, we'll probably sneak up to this

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: few times, which is whether we can build machines that are conscious or machines

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: that are intelligent, human level intelligence or beyond without

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: building the consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I mean, ultimately that's one of the ways to understand what

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: consciousness is, is to, is to build the thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: We can either sort of from the Chomsky way, try to construct models.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Like he thinks about language in this way, try to construct models and

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: theories of how the thing works, or we can just build the damn thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And that's a methodological principle in cognitive science.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: In fact, one of the things that sort of distinguishes cognitive science from

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: other disciplines dealing with the nature of cognition in the mind is that

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: cognitive science takes the design stance.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It asks, well, could we build a machine that would not only simulate it, but

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: serve as a bona fide explanation of the phenomena?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Do you find any efforts in cognitive science compelling in this direction

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: in terms of how far we are?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: There's, there's, uh, on the computational side of things, something

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: called cognitive modeling, there's all these kinds of packages that you can

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: construct simplified models of how the brain does things and see if

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: complex behaviors emerge.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Uh, do you find any efforts in cognitive or what efforts in cognitive science do

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: you find most inspiring and productive?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I think the project of trying to create AGI artificial general intelligence is

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: where I place my hope of artificial intelligence being of scientific

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: significance.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: This is independent of technological socioeconomic significance, which is

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: already well, well established.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: But being able to say, because of the work in AI, we now have a good theory

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: of cognition, intelligence, perhaps consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I think that's where I place my bets is in the current endeavors around

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: artificial general intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And so tackling that problem head on, which is now become central, at least

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: to a group of cognitive scientists is I think what needs to be done.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And, uh, when you think about AGI, do you think about systems that have

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: consciousness?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Let's go back to what I think is at the core of your general intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So right now, compared to even our best machines, you are a general problem

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: solver.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: You can solve a wide variety of problems on a wide variety of domains.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And some of our best machines have a little bit of transfer.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: They can learn this game and play a game of chess.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: They can learn this game and play a few other well-designed rule-bounded games,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: but they couldn't learn how to swim, right.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Or et cetera, things like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And so what's interesting is what seems to come up.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And this is some of my published work in all these different domains of

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: cognition across all of these different problem types is a central problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And since we do have good sort of psychometric evidence, we can

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: do some general ability that's a significant component of our intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I made an argument as to what I think that general ability is.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And so it's happening right now.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The amount of information in this room that you could actually pay attention

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: to is combinatorially explosive.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The amount of information you have in your memory, long-term memory and all

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: the ways you could combine it, combinatorially explosive.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The number of possibilities you can consider also combinatorially explosive.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The sequences of behavior you can generate also combinatorially explosive.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And yet somehow you're zeroing in the right memories are coming up.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The right possibilities are opening up the right sequences of behavior.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: You're paying attention to the right thing, not infallibly.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So, but so much so that you reliably find obvious what you should interact

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: with in order to solve the problem at hand. That's an ability that is still

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: not well understood within AGI.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So filtering out the gigantic waterfall of data.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It's almost like a Zen Cohen.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What makes you intelligent is your ability to ignore so much information

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and do it in such a way that is somewhere between obvious and

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: arbitrary guessing and algorithmic search.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And to a fault sometimes, of course, that you based on the models you construct,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: you forget, you ignore things you should probably not ignore.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And that hopefully we can circle back to it, Lex, is related to the meaning

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: issue because the very processes that make us adaptively intelligent make

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: us perennially susceptible to self deceptive, self destructive behavior

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: because of the way we miss frame the environment in a fundamental ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So to you, meaning is also connected to ideas of wisdom and truth

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and how we interpret and understand and interact intellectually with the environment.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So what is wisdom? Why do we long for it? How do we, and where do we find it? What is it?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Intelligence is what you use to solve your problems, as I was just describing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Rationality is how you use your intelligence to overcome the problems

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: of self deception that emerge when you're trying to solve your problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So it's that matter problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And then the issue is, do you have just one kind of

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: knowing? I think you have multiple ways of knowing and therefore you have multiple rationalities.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And so wisdom is to coordinate those rationalities so that they are

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: optimally constraining and affording each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So in that way, wisdom is rationally self transcending rationality.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Right. So life is a kind of process where you jump from rationality to rationality.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And pick up a village of rationalities along the way that then turns into wisdom.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes. If properly coordinated.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: You mentioned framing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So what is framing? Is it a set of assumptions you bring to the table in how you see the world,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: how you reason about the world? Yeah. How you understand the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So it depends what you mean by assumptions. If by assumption you mean a proposition,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: representational or rule, I think that's much more downstream from relevance realization.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I think relevance realization refers to, again, constraints on how you are paying attention.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And so for me, talking about framing is talking about how you understand the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And framing is talking about this process you're doing right now of salience landscaping.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What's salient to you? And how is what's salient constantly shifting in a sort of a dynamic tapestry?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And how are you shaping yourself to the way that salience landscaping is aspectualizing the world,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: shaping it into aspects for interaction? For me, that is a much more primordial process than any

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: sort of beliefs we have. And here's why. If we mean by beliefs, a representational proposition,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: then we're in this very problematic position because then we're trying to say that propositions

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: are ultimately responsible for how we do relevance realization. And that's problematic

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: because representations presuppose relevance realization. So I represent this as a cup.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The number of properties it actually has and that I even have epistemic access to is combinatorially

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: explosive. I select from those a subset and how they are relevant to each other in so far as they

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: are relevant for me. This doesn't have to be a cup. I could be using it as a hat. I can use it to

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: the letter V, all kinds of different things. I could say this was the 10th billion object made

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: in North America. Representations presuppose relevance realization. They are therefore dependent

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: on it, which means relevance realization isn't bound to our representational structures.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It can be influenced by them, but they are ultimately dependent on relevance realization.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Let's define stuff. Relevance realization. What are the inputs and the outputs of this thing?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What are we talking about? What we're talking about is how you are doing something very analogous

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: to evolution. So if you think about the adaptivity isn't in the organism

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: or in the environment, but in a dynamical relation, and then what does evolution do?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It creates variation and then it puts selective pressure. What that does is that changes the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: niche constructions that are available to a species. It changes the morphology.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: You also have a loop. It's your sensorimotor loop. What's constantly happening is there are

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: processes within you that are opening up variation and also processes that are putting selection on

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: it. You're constantly evolving that sensorimotor loop. You might call your cognitive fittedness,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: which is how you're framing the world is constantly evolving and changing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I can give you two clear examples of that. One, your autonomic nervous system, parasympathetic

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and sympathetic. The sympathetic system is biased to trying to interpret as much of reality as

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: threat or opportunity. The parasympathetic is biased to trying to interpret as much of the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: environment as safe and relaxing, and they are constantly doing opponent processing. There's

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: no little man in you calculating your level of arousal. There's this dynamic coupling,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: opponent processing between them that is constantly evolving your arousal.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Similarly, your attention. You have the default mode network, task network. The default mode

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: network is putting pressure on you right now to mind wander, to go off, to drift. Then the task

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: focus network is selecting out of those possibilities the ones that will survive and go into. So,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: you're constantly evolving your attention. Okay. There's a natural selection of ideas that

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: a bunch of systems within you are generating. Then you use the natural selection. What is the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: selector, the object that you're interacting with, the glass? Relevance realization. Once again,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: you just describe how it happens. You can describe what the hell it is. What are we talking about?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Relevance realization is how you interact with things in the world to make sense of why they

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: matter, what they mean to you, to your life. Yes. Notice the language you just used. You're

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: starting to use the meaning in life language. Good or bad?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's good. That's good. What does that evolution of your sensory motor loop do?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It gives you, and here I'll use the term from Marla Ponti, it gives you an

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: optimal grip on the world. Let's use your visual attention again.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Here's an object. How close should I be to it? Is there a right-

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's what you want to do with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Exactly. Exactly. You have to evolve your sensory motor loop in order to get the optimal grip

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: that actually creates the affordance of you getting to a goal that you're trying to get to.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: You're describing physical goals of manipulating objects. This applies.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The task, the process of relevance realization is not just about getting a glass of water and

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: taking a drink. It's about falling in love. Of course.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What else is there?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Between those two options.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I can show you how you're optimally gripping in an abstract cognitive domain.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: A mammal goes by and most people will say, there's a dog. Now, why don't they say,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: they might, but typically, probabilistically, they'll say there's a dog. They could say,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: there's a German shepherd. There's a mammal. There's a living organism. There's a police dog.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Why there? Why do they stop Eleanor Rush called these basic level?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What you find is that's an optimal grip because it's getting you the best overall balance

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: between similarity within your category and difference between the other categories.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It's allowing you to properly fit to that object insofar as you're setting yourself up to,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: well, I'm getting so as many of the similarities and differences I can on balance because they're

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: in a trade-off relationship that I need in order to probably interact with this mammal.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's optimal grip. Not right. It's at the level of your categorization.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: You evolve these models of the world around you and on top of them, you do stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Like you build representations, like you said.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What's the salience landscape? Salience meaning attention landscape.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So salience is what grabs your attention or what results from you directing your attention.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So I clap my hands, that's salient. It grabs your attention. Your attention is drawn to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's bottom up. But I can also say your left big toe and now it's salient to you because you

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: directed your attention towards it. That's top down. And again, opponent processing going on there.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So whatever stands out to you, what grabs your attention, what arouses you, what triggers at

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: least momentarily some affect towards it, that's how things are salient. What salience I would

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: argue is, is how a lot of unconscious relevance realization makes information relevant to

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: working memory. That's when it now becomes online for direct sensory motor interaction with the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: world. So you think the salience landscape, the ocean of salience extends into the subconscious

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: mind? I think relevance does, but I think when relevance is recursively processed,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: relevance realization such that it passes through sort of this higher filter of working memory and

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: has these properties of being globally accessible and globally broadcast, then it becomes the thing

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: we call salience. Look, that's really good evidence. There's really good evidence from my

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: colleague at U of T, University of Toronto, Lynn Hasher, that that's what working memory is. It's

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: a higher order relevance filter. That's why things like chunking will get way more information

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: through working memory because it's basically making, it's basically monitoring how much

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: how much relevance realization has gone into this information. Usually you have to do an additional

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: kind of recursive processing. And that tells you, by the way, when do you need consciousness? When

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: do you need that working memory and that salience landscaping? It's when you're facing situations

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: that are highly novel, highly complex and very ill defined that require you to engage working memory.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Okay, got it. So relevance realization is in part the thing that constructs that basic level thing

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: of a dog. When you see it, when you see a dog, you call it a dog, not a German shepherd, not a mammal,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: not a biological meat bag. It's a dog. Wisdom. Yes. So what is wisdom?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: If we return, I think as part of that, we got to relevance realization. And then wisdom

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: is as accumulation of rationalities. He described the rationality as a kind of starting from

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: intelligence, much of puzzle solving and then rationalities like the meta problem of puzzle

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: solving. And then what wisdom is the meta meta problem of puzzle solving? Yes. In the sense that

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: the meta problem you have when you're solving your puzzles is that you can often fall into

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: self-deception. You can mis-friend. Self-deception, right.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Right. So whereas knowledge overcomes ignorance, wisdom is about overcoming foolishness. If what

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: we mean by foolishness is self-deceptive, self-destructive behavior, which I think is

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: a good definition of foolishness. And so what you're doing is you're doing this recursive

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: relevance realization. You're using your intelligence to improve the use of your

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: intelligence. And then you're using your rationality to improve the use of your rationality.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's that recursive relevance realization I was talking about a few minutes ago. Think

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: about a wise person. They come into highly, often messy, ill-defined, complex situations,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: usually where there's some significant novelty. And what can they do? They can zero in on what

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: really matters, what's relevant, and then they can shape themselves, salient landscaping,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: to intervene most appropriately to that situation as they have framed it. That's what we mean by

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: a wise person. And that's how it follows out of the model I've been presenting to you.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So when we say self-deception, I mean, part of that implies that it's intentional. Part

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: of the mechanism of cognition, you're modifying what you should know for some purpose. Is that

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: how you see the word self-deception?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: No, because I belong to a group of people that think the model of self-deception as lying to

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: oneself ultimately makes no sense. Because in order to lie to you, I have to know something you

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: don't, and I have to depend on your commitment to the truth in order to modify your behavior.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I don't think that's what we do to ourselves. I think, and I'm gonna use it in a technical term,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and thank you for making space for that earlier on, I think we can bullshit ourselves, which is

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: a very different thing than lying.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So what is bullshit? And how do we bullshit ourselves, technically speaking?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yeah, Frankfurt, and this is inspired by Frankfurt and other people's work based on Frankfurt's

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: work.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: On bullshit.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yeah, classic essay.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It's a pretty good title.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I think it's one of the best things he wrote. He wrote a lot of good things.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The title or the essay?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The essay. The title's good too. It's always an icebreaker as to what

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: icebreaker in certain academic settings. So let's contrast the bullshit artist from the liar.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The liar depends on your commitment to the truth. The bullshit artist is actually trying to make you

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: indifferent to the question of truth and modify your behavior by making things salient to you

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: so that they are catchy to you. So a prototypical example of bullshit is a television commercial.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: You watch these people at a bar getting some particular kind of alcohol and they're gorgeous

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and they're laughing and they're smiling and they're cleared-eyed.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: You know that's not true. And they know you know it's not true.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: But here's the point. You don't care because there's gorgeous people smiling and they're happy

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and that's salient to you and that catches your attention. And so you know, go into a bar,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: you know that won't happen when you drink this alcohol. You know it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: But you buy the product because it was made salient to you. Now you can't lie to yourself, Lex.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Salience can catch attention, but attention can drive salience. So this is what I can do.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I can make something salient by paying attention to it. And then that will tend to draw me back to

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: it again, which, and you see what happens, which means it tends to catch my attention more so that

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: when I go into the store, that bottle of liquor catches my attention and I buy it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And that's, why is that bullshit?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Why is that bullshit? Because what you're doing is being caught up in the salience of things

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: independent from whether or not that salience is tracking reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Is it independent or is it loosely connected? Because it's not so obvious to me when I see

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: happy people at a bar that I don't in part believe that, well, my experience has been maybe different.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yeah. Logically, I can understand, but maybe there is a bar out there where it's all happy people

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: dancing. In fact, most of the bars I go to these days in Texas, there's pretty lots of happy people.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I think you can, I mean, there's probably variation, although I think it's very,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: the truth seeking in there. Let's say the intent is at least to try and shut off your truth seeking.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It might not completely succeed, but that's the intent. At times it can completely succeed

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: because I can give you pretty much gibberish and you ever let it will motivate your behavior.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: There's a episode from the classic Simpsons, not the modern Simpsons, the classic Simpsons,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: where there's aliens and they're running for office in the United States. Now I'm a Canadian,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: so this doesn't quite work for me, but right. And this speech goes like this,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: my fellow Americans, when I was young, I dreamt of being a baseball, but we must move forward,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: not backward, upward, not forward, twirling, twirling towards freedom. And people go,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and there's a rush. There's nothing there. And yet it's great satire because a lot of political

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: speech is exactly like that. There's nothing there, right? I'm not saying all political speech,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I said a lot. No, but there is a fundamental difference between, and this is so hilarious,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I remember that episode. There is a fundamental difference between that absurd non-secular

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: speech and political speech because one of the things is political speech is grounded

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: in some sense of truth. And so if that requires you talking about alternative facts

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and weird self-destructive oxymoronic phrases, isn't that approaching pure bullshit?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: No, I think pure bullshit, like the vacuum, is very difficult to get to, but I get the point.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So what exactly is truth? Is it possible to know?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I think Spinoza is right about truth, that truth is only known by its own standard,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: which sounds circular. There's a way in which he didn't mean that circularly, and I think this is

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317
