body.input: also converges with Plato. These are two huge influences on me. I think we only know the truth

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: retrospectively when we go through some process of self-transcendence, when we move from a frame

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: to a more encompassing frame so that we can see the limitations and the distortions of

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: the earlier frame. You have this when you have a moment of insight. Insight is you doing,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: you are re-realizing what is relevant. You go, oh, oh, I thought she was aggressive

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and angry. She's actually really afraid. I was mis-framing this. And you change what you find

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: relevant. You have those aha moments. So do you think it's possible to get a

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: sense of objective reality? Is it possible to get to the ground level of what

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: something that you can call objective truth? Or are we always on shaky ground?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I think those moments of transcendence can never get us to an absolute view from nowhere.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: This is Drew Hyland's notion of finite transcendence. We are capable of self-transcendence,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and therefore, we are creatures who can actually raise the question of truth or goodness or beauty,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: because I think they all share this feature. But that doesn't mean we can transcend to a godhood,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: to some absolute view from nowhere that takes in all information and organizes it in a comprehensive

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: whole. But that doesn't mean that truth is thereby rendered valueless.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I think a better term is real. And real and illusory are comparative terms. You only know

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: that something's an illusion by taking something else to be real. And so, we are always in a

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: comparative task. But that doesn't mean that we can somehow jump outside of our framing in some

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: final manner and say, this is how it is from a God's eye point of view.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So what do you think, if I may ask, of somebody like Ayn Rand and her philosophy of objectivism?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So where the core principle is that reality exists independently of consciousness and that

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: human beings have direct contact with reality through sense perception. So they have that,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: you do have that ability to know reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: There's two things. Knowing that there's an independent reality is not knowing that

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: independent reality. Those are not the same thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yeah, but I think objectivism would probably say that our human reason is able to have contact

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: with that.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Then I would respond and say, I believe in fact, ultimately in a conformity theory of knowing that

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: the deepest kind of knowing is when there's a contact, a conformity between the mind,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: with the embodied mind and reality. And here's where I guess I'd push back on Rand. I would say,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: you have to acknowledge partial knowledge as real knowledge, because if you don't,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: you're going to fall prey to Mino's paradox. Mino's paradox is, this is in Plato, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: To know P. Well, if I don't know P, I'm going to go looking for it. But if I don't know P,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: how could I possibly recognize it when I found it? I have no way of recognizing it. I have no way of

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: recognizing it. I have no way of knowing that I found it. So I must know P, but if I know P,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: then I don't need to learn about it. I don't need to go searching.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So learning doesn't exist. Knowledge is impossible. The way you break out of that paradox is saying,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: no, no, no, it is possible to partially know something. I can know it enough that it will

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: guide me to recognizing it, but that's not the same as having a complete grasp of it,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: because I still have to search and find what I don't yet possess in my knowledge.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So, yeah, partial knowledge has to be real knowledge.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Right. Partial knowledge is still knowledge. Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What do you think about somebody like Donald Hoffman, who thinks the reality is an illusion,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: so complete illusion, that we're given this actually really nice definition or idea that

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: you talked about, that there's a tension between the illusory and what is real. He says that

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: basically we take in that and we ran with the real to the point where the real is not at all

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: connected to some kind of physical reality. Well, I hope to talk to him at some point.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: We were supposed to talk at one point, and so I have to talk in his absence.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I think that, first of all, I think saying that everything is an illusion is like saying

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: everything is tall. It doesn't make any sense. It's a comparative term. Something you have to say

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: against this standard of realness, this is an illusion. And he uses arguments from evolution,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: which are problematic to me because it's like, well, you seem to be saying that everything is

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: true. You seem to be saying that evolution is true, that it really exists. And then some of our

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: cognition and a perception has access to reality. Math and presumably some science has access to

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: reality. And then what he seems to be saying is, well, a lot of your everyday experience is illusory,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: that we do have some contact with reality whereby we can make the arguments as to why most of your

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: experience, most of your everyday experience is an illusion. But to me, that's not a novel thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's Descartes. That's the idea that most of our sense experience is untrustworthy,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: but the math is what connects us to reality. That's how he interpreted the Copernican

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Revolution. Oh, look, we're all seeing the sun rise and move over and set, and it's all an illusion,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: but the math, the math gets us to the reality. Well, I think he makes a deeper point that most

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: of cognition is just evolved and operates in the illusory world. How does he know that things like

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: cognition and evolution exist? I think there's an important distinction between evolution

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and cognition, right? No, no, I'm just saying that's not the point I'm making. I'm making a

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: point that he's claiming that there are two things that really exist. Why are they privileged?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: He basically says that, look, the process of evolution makes sense. Yes. Right? Like,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: it makes sense that you get complex organisms from simple organisms through the natural selection

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: process. Here's how you get to transfer information from generation to generation. It makes sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And then he says that there's no requirement for the cognition to evolve in a way that it would

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: actually perceive and have direct contact with the physical reality. Except that cognition evolved

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: in such a way that it could perceive the truth of evolution, and you can't treat evolution like an

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: isolated thing. Evolution depends on Darwinian theory, genetics. It depends on understanding

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: plate tectonics, the way the environment changes. It depends on how chromosomes are structured.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Actually, that's an interesting question to him, where I don't know if he actually would

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: push back on this, is how do you know evolution is real?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes. I think he would be open to the idea that it is part of the illusion that we constructed,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: that there's some, in some sense, it is connected to reality, but we don't have a clear picture of

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: it. I mean, that's an intellectually honest statement then. If most of our cognition

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: as thinking beings is operating at every level in an illusory world, then it makes sense that this,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: one of the main theories of science that's evolution is also a complete part of this illusory

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: who are usually all sort of bitten with cynicism and postmodernism and they'll just say spontaneously,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: well, because it's not real. Because it's not real. Right? So I think what you're pointing to is

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: actually, you're pointing not to an objective or a subjective thing. So romanticism says it's

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: subjective. There's some sort of, I guess, like positivism or Lockean empiricism says it's

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: objective. But you're saying, no, no, no, there's reality realization and can I get relevance

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: realization to be optimally gripping in the best right relationship with it? And there's good

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: reason you can because think about it, your relevance realization isn't just representing

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: properties of the world, it's instantiating it. There's something very similar to biological

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: evolution, which is at the guts of life, if I'm right, running your cognition. It's not just that

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: you have ideas, you actually instantiate, that's what I mean by conformity, the same principles.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: They're within and without, they don't belong to you subjectively. They're not just out there,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: they're both at the same time and they help to explain how you are actually bound to the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: evolutionary world. Yeah. So it comes from both inside and from the outside. But there's still

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: the question of the meaning of life. First of all, the big benefit of that question is that it

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: shakes you out of your hamster in a wheel that is daily life, the mundane process of daily life,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: where you have a schedule, you wake up, you have kids, you have to take them to school,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: then you go to work and repeat over and over and over and over, and then you get

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: increased salary and then you upgrade the home and that whole process.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Asking about the meaning of life is so full of romantic bullshit that if you just allow yourself

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: to take it seriously for a second, it forces you to pause and think like, what's going on here?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And then it ultimately, I think, does return to the question of meaning in those mundane things.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What gives my life joy? What gives it lasting deliciousness? Where do I notice the magic and

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: how can I have that magic return again and again? Beauty. And that ultimately what it returns to.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: But it's the same thing you do when you look up to the sky. You spend most of your day hurrying

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: around looking at things on the surface. But when you look up to the sky and you see the stars,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: it fills you with the feeling of awe that forces you to pause and think in full context of like,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: what the hell is going on here? That. But also I think there is a, when you think too much about

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: the meaning of a glass and relevance realization of a glass, you don't necessarily get at the core

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: of what makes music beautiful. So sometimes you have to start at the biggest picture first.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And I think meaning of life forces you to really go to the big bang and go to the universe and the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: whole thing, the origin of life. And I think sometimes you have to start there to discover

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: the meaning in the day to day, I think. But perhaps you would disagree.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Insofar as the question makes you ask about the whole of your life and how much meaning is in the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: whole of your life. And insofar as it asks how much that is connected to reality, it's a good

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: question. But it's a bad question in that it also makes you look for the answers in the wrong way.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Now you said, and I agree with what you said, how we really answer this question is we come

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: back to the meaning in life and we see how much that meaning in life is connected to reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: We pursue wisdom. And so for me, I don't need that question in order to provoke me into that stance.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So let's return to the meaning crisis.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What is the nature of the meaning crisis in modern times? What's its origin? What's its explanation?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Well, remember what I said, what I argued, that the very processes that make us adaptively

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: intelligent, subject us to perennial problems of self-deception, self-destruction, creating

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: bullshit for ourselves, for other people, all of that. And that can cause anxiety,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: existential anxiety, it can cause despair, it can cause a sense of absurdity.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: These are perennial problems. And across cultures and across historical periods,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: human beings have come up with ecologies of practices. There's no one practice,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: there's no panacea practice. They've come up with ecologies of practices for ameliorating

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: that self-deception and enhancing that fittedness, that connectedness that's at the core of meaning

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: in life. That's prototypically what we call wisdom. And here's how I can show you one clear

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: instance of the meaning crisis is it's a wisdom famine. I do this regularly with my students.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: In the classroom, I'll say, where do you go for information? They hold up their phone.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Where do you go for knowledge? They're a little bit slower and probably because they're in my

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: class, they'll say, well, science, the university. And I'll say, where do you go for wisdom?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: There's a silence. Wisdom isn't optional. That's why it is perennial, cross-cultural,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: cross-historical because of the perennial problems. But we do not have homes for ecologies of practices

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: that fit into our scientific technological worldview so that they are considered legal.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So that they are considered legitimate. The fastest growing demographic group are the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: nones, N-O-N-E-S. They have no religious allegiance, but they are not primarily atheistic.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: They most frequently describe themselves with this very... This has become almost everybody

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: now describe, I'm spiritual, but not religious, which means they are trying to find a way of

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: reducing the bullshit and enhancing the connectedness. But they don't want to turn

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: to any of the legacy established religions by and large.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Well, isn't both religion and the nones, isn't wisdom a process, not a destination?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So trying to find, if you're a deeply faithful religious person, you're also trying to find,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: right? So just because you have a place where you're looking or a set of traditions around

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: which you're constructing the search, it's nevertheless a search. So I guess, is there

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: a case to be made that this is just the usual human condition? How do you answer? If you ask

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: five centuries ago, where do you look for wisdom? I mean, I suppose people would be more inclined

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: to answer while the Bible or a religious text. Right. And they had a worldview that was considered

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: not just religious, but also rational. So we now have these two things, orthogonal or often

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: oppositional spirituality and rationality. But if you go before a particular historical period,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: you look back in the Neoplatonic tradition, like before the scientific revolution, those two are

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: not in opposition. They are deeply interwoven so that you can have a sense of legitimacy

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and deep realness and grounding in your practices. We don't have that anymore. And I'm not advocating

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: for religion. Neither am I an enemy of religion. I'll strengthen your case, by the way. So one of

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: my RAs did research and you get people who have committed themselves to cultivating wisdom,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and you can look at people within religious traditions and people who are doing it in a purely

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: secular framework. By many of the measures we use to try to study wisdom scientifically,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: the people in the religious paths do better than the secular. But here's the important point.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: There's no significant difference between the religious paths. So it's not like if you're

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: following the path of Judaism, you're more likely to end up wiser than if you follow Buddhism.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: By the way, I don't know if that's my case. I was making the case that you don't need to have a

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: religious affiliation to search for wisdom. I thought along to the point you just made,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: that it doesn't matter which religious affiliation or none.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: But that's what I'm saying. Okay, so this is the tricky thing we're in. It does matter if you're

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: in one, but it doesn't matter the propositional creeds of that. There's something else at work.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: If you'll allow me to say this, there's a functionality to religion that we lost when

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: we rejected all the propositional dogma. But there's a functionality there that we don't know how to

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: recreate. Yeah, what is that? Can you try to speak to that? What is that functionality?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What is that? Why is that so useful? A bunch of stories, a bunch of myths, a bunch of narratives,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: a bunch of narratives that are drenched in deep lessons about morality and all those kinds of

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: things. What's the functional thing there that can't be replaced without a religious text,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: by a non-religious text? This is for me the golden question, so thank you.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Do you have an answer? Yeah, I think I have a significant answer. I don't think it's complete,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: but I think it's important. This is to step before the Cartesian revolution and think about

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: many different kinds of knowing. This is now something that is prominent within what's called

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: 4E cognitive science, the kind of cognitive science I practice. There's a lot of converging evidence

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: for these different ways of knowing. There's propositional knowing. This is what we are most

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: familiar with. In fact, it almost has a tyrannical status. This is knowing that something is the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: case, like that cats are mammals and it's stored in semantic memory, and we have tests of coherence

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and correspondence and conviction. There's procedural knowing. This is knowing how to do something.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Skills are not theories. They're not beliefs. They're not true or false. They engage the world

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: or they don't, and they are stored in a different kind of memory, procedural memory.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Semantic memory can be damaged without any damage to procedural memory. That's why you have the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: prototypical story of somebody suffering Alzheimer's and they're losing all kinds of facts,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: but they can still sit down and play the piano flawlessly. Same kind of argument. There's

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: perspectival knowing. This is knowing what it's like to be you here now in this situation,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: in this state of mind, the whole field of your salience landscaping, what it's like to be you

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: here now. You have a specific kind of memory around that, episodic memory, and you have a

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: different criterion of realness. You can get this by, well, my friend Dan Schiappi and I,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: we studied the scientists moving the rovers around, or you can take a look at people who are doing VR.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: People talk about they want to really be in the game. That makes it real. They don't mean

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: verisimilitude. You can get that sense of being in the game with something like Tetris, which

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: doesn't look like the real world, and you can fail to have it in a video game that has a lot

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: of verisimilitude. It's something else. It's about, again, this kind of connectedness that

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: we're talking about. If I may interrupt, is that connected to the hard problem of caution?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Is that the subject, the qualia, or is that a different, that kind of knowing, is that

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: different from the qualia of consciousness? I think it has to do with, well, I make a

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: distinction between the adjectival and the adverbial qualia, so I think it has to do with

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: the adverbial qualia much more than with the adjectival. The adjectival qualia are

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: the greenness of green and the blueness of blue. The adverbial qualia are the here-ness,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: the now-ness, the togetherness. I think the perspectival knowing has a lot to do with the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: adverbial qualia. Adjectival qualia and adverbial qualia. I'm learning so many new things today.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's another way of knowing. Right. And then there's a deeper one,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and this is a philosophical point. We can go through the argument, but you don't have to know

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: that you know in order to know, because if you start doing that, you get an infinite regress.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: There has to be kinds of knowing that doesn't mean you know that you know that.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yeah, of course. Okay, great. Okay, good.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Well, there was a lot of ink spilled over that over a 40-year period.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: By philosophers, this is what they do. They spill ink.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yeah. But I want to talk about-

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: They get paid for ink spillage.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So I want to talk about what I call participatory knowing. This is the idea that you and the world

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: are co-participating in things and such that real affordances exist between you.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So both me and this environment are shaped by gravity, so the affordance of walking becomes

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: available to me. Both me and a lot of this environment are shaped by my biology,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and so affordances for that are here. Look at this cup. Shared physics, shared biological factors,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: look at my hand, I'm bipedal. Also, culture is shaping me and shaping this. I had to learn

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: how to use that and treat it as a cup. So this is an agent arena relationship. There's identities

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: being created in your agency, identities being created in the world as an arena,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: so you and the world fit together. You know when that's missing, when you're really lonely

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: or you're homesick or you're suffering culture shock. So this is participatory knowing,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and it comes with a sense of belonging.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: At every level. So the ability to walk is a kind of knowing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes, yes, yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That there's a dance between the physics that enables this process,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and just participating in the process is the act of knowing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Right, and there's a really weird form of memory you have for this kind of knowing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It's called yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What? Can you elaborate?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Well, so we talked about how all the different other kinds of knowing had specific kinds of

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: memory, semantic memory for propositional, procedural, episodic for perspectival.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What's the kind of memory that is the coordinated storehouse of all of your agent arena

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: relationships? All the roles you can take, all the identities you can assume,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: all the identities you can assign.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What's the self? Do you mean like consciousness?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: No, I mean your sense of self.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Sense of self in this world that's not consciousness, that's like an agency or something.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Right, it's an agent arena relationship.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And so in an agent arena relationship is the sense of the agent.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And that the agent belongs in that arena.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Whatever the agent is, whatever the arena is, because it's probably a bunch of different

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: framings of how you experience that.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yeah, and you do. Within your identity as a self, you have all kinds of roles that are somehow

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: contributing to that identity, but are not equivalent to that identity.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yeah. I wonder if my two hands have different

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: experience of me picking up something with my right hand and then my left hand.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's a really cool question, Lex.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: They certainly feel like their own things.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: But that could be just anthropomorphization based on cultural narratives and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It could, but I think it's a legitimate empirical question because it also could be sort of

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Ian McGillchrist stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It could be you're using different hemispheres and they sort of have different agent arena

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: relationships to the environment.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: This is a really important question in the cognitive science of the self.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Does that hemispheric difference mean you're multiple or you actually have a singular self?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Oh, so it's important to understand how many selves are there.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes, I think so.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: But that's just like a quirk of evolution.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Surely it can be five or 10, but it's not a single self.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Surely it can't be fundamental to cognition, having multiple selves or a singular self.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It depends, again, because we're getting far from the answer to the question you originally

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: asked me.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Do you want me to go back to that first or answer this one?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Which question?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I already forgot everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What's the functionality of religion?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Let us return.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Okay. And then we can return to the self.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Okay. So you said you have all these propositions and etc., etc., and they

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: differ from the religions and they don't seem to be considered legitimate by many people.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: But yet there's something functioning in the religions that is transforming people

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and making them wiser.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And I put it to you that the transformations are largely occurring at those non-propositional

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: levels, the procedural, the perspectival, and the participatory.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And those are the ones, by the way, that are more fundamentally connected to meaning making.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Because remember the propositions are representational and they're dependent on

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: the non-propositional, non-representational processes of connectedness and relevance

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: realization.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So religion goes down deep to the non-propositional and works there.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's the functionality we need to grasp.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Well, you talk about tools, essentially, that humans are able to incorporate into their

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: cognition. Psychotechnologies, like language is one, I suppose.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Isn't religion then a psychotechnology?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It would be an ecology of psychotechnologies, yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And the question is that Nietzsche ruined everything by saying God is dead.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Do we have to invent the new thing?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Go from the old phone, create the iPhone, invent the new psychotechnology that takes place of

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: religion.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And so when the madman in Nietzsche's text goes into the marketplace, who is he talking

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: to?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: He's not talking to the believers.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: He's talking to the atheist.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And he says, do you not realize what we have done?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Right?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: We have taken a sponge and wiped away the sky.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: We are now forever falling.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: We are unchained from the sun.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: We have to become worthy of this.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yeah, well, Nietzsche is full of romantic bullshit, as we know.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: No, no, no, no, but there's a point there.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The point is, right, there's one thing to rejecting the proposition.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: There's another project of replacing the functionality that we lost when we reject the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: religion.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So his worry that as nihilism takes hold, you don't ever replace the thing that religion,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: the role that religion played in our...

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Maybe it's hard to tell what he actually...

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Because he's so multi-vocal.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I'll speak for me, rather than for Nietzsche.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I think it is possible to using the best cognitive science and respectfully

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: exacting what we can from the best religion and philosophical traditions, because there's

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: things like Stoicism that are in the gray line between philosophy and religion.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Buddhism is the same.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Doing that best coxsai, that best exaptation, we can come up with that functionality without

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: having to buy into the particular propositional sets of the legacy religions.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's my proposal.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I call that the religion that's not a religion.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So things like Stoicism or modern Stoicism, those things, don't you think in some sense

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: they naturally emerge?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Don't you think there's a longing for meaning?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So Stoicism arises during the Hellenistic period when there was a significant meaning crisis

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: in the ancient world because of what had happened after the breakup of Alexander the Great's

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: empire.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So if you compare Aristotle to people who are living after Alexander...

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So Aristotle grows up in a place where everybody speaks the same, has a similar...

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Same name, has the same language, has the same religion.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: His ancestors have been there for years.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: He knows everybody.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: After Alexander the Great's empire is broken up, people are now thousands of miles away

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: from the government.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: They're surrounded by people because of the Diasporas, the Diasporas, I should say.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: They're surrounded by people that don't speak their language, don't share their religion.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's why you get all these mother religions emerging, universal mother religions like

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: ISIS, et cetera.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So there is what's called domicide.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: There's the killing of home.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: There's a loss of a sense of home and belonging and fittedness during the Hellenistic period.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And Stoicism arose specifically to address that.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And because it was designed to address a meaning crisis, it is no coincidence that it is coming

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: back into prominence right now.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Well, there could be a lot of other variations.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Oh, totally.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It feels like, I think when you speak of the meaning crisis, you're in part describing,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: not prescribing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: You're describing something that is happening.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: But I would venture to say that if we just leave things be, the meaning crisis dissipates

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: because we long to create institutions, to create collective ideas, to distribute a

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: cognition process that gives us meaning.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So if religion loses power, we'll find other institutions that are sources of meaning.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Is that your intuition as well?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I think we are already doing that.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317
