metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What's your take on atheism in general?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Is it closer to truth than a, maybe is an atheist closer to truth than a person who

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: believes in God?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So I'm a non-theist, which means I think the shared set of presuppositions between the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: theist and the atheist are actually what needs to be rejected.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Can you explain that further?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes, I can.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And I want to point out, by the way, that there are lots of non-theistic religious

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: traditions.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So I'm not coming up with a sort of airy-fairy category.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And what's the difference between non-theism, agnosticism, and atheism?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So non-theists think that the theist and the atheist share a bunch of presuppositions.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: For example, it's that sacredness is to be understood in terms of a personal being that

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: is in some sense the supreme being, and that the right relationship to that being is to

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: have a correct set of beliefs.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I reject all of those claims.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So both the theist and the atheist see God?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: In their modern version, yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: In which do you reject it in the sense that you don't know, or do you reject it in the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: sense that you believe that each one of those presuppositions is likely to be not true?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The latter.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I, both on reflection, argument, and personal experimentation and experience, I've come to

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: the conclusion that those shared propositions are probably not true.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Which one is the most troublesome to you?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The personal being, the kind of accumulation of everything into one being that ultimately

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: created stuff?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So for me, there's two, and they're interlocked together.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I'm not trying to dodge your question.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It's that the idea that the ground of being is some kind of being, I think, is a fundamental

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: mistake.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It's void of being?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: No, no, no.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The ground of being is some kind of being.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: No, no.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So it's turtles all the way down.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The ground of being is not itself any kind of being.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Being is not a being.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It is the ability for things to be, which is not the same thing as a being.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Are humans beings?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: We are beings.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: This glass is a being.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: This table is a being.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: But when I ask you, how are they all in being, you don't say by being a glass, or by being

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: a table, or by being a human.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: You want to say, no, no, there's something underneath it all.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And then you realize it can't be any thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: This is why many mystical traditions converge on the idea that the ground of being is no

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: thingness, which is normally pronounced as nothingness.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: But if you put the hyphen back in, you get the original intent, no thingness.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And that is bound up with, okay, what I need to do in order to be in relationship with...

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So it's a misconstruing of ultimate reality as a supreme being, which is a category mistake

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: to my mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And then my relationship to it, that sacredness is a function of belief.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And I have been presenting you an argument through most of our discussion that meaning

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: is at a deeper level than beliefs and propositions.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And so that is a misunderstanding of sacredness, because I take sacredness to be that which

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: is most meaningful and connected to what is most real.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And theists think of what?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Of sacredness as what?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: They think of sacredness as a property of a particular being, God, and that the way that

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: is meaningful to them is by asserting a set of propositions or beliefs.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Now, I wanna point out that this is what I would now call modern or common theism.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: You go back into the classical periods of Christianity, you get a view that's really

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: radically different from how most people understand theism today.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So let me...

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: This is an interesting question that I usually think about in the form of mathematics.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So in that case, if meaning is sacred in your non-theist view,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: is meaning created or is it discovered?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: There's a Latin word that doesn't separate them called inventio.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And I would say that.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And before you say, oh, well, give me a chance, because you participate in it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: You've experienced an insight, yes?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Did you make it happen?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The insight?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Did you make it happen or did you do...

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Oh, like, can you do that?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I'm gonna have...

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I needed insight.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: This is what I do to make an insight.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Oh, I see.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yeah, in some sense, it came from elsewhere.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Right, but you didn't just passively receive it either.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: You're engaged and involved in it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's why you get...

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Right?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So that's what I mean by you participate in it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: You participate in meaning.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So you do think that there's both?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: You do think it's both?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I mean, that's not a trivial thing to understand.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Because a lot of time, we think...

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: When you think about a search for meaning,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: you think it's like you're going through a big house and you open each door and look if it's there.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And so on, as if there is going to be a glowing orb that you discover.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: But at the same time, I'm somebody that,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: based on the chemistry of my brain,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: have been extremely fortunate to be able to discover beauty in everything,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: in the most mundane and boring of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I am, as David Foster Wallace said, unboreable.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I could just sit in a room, just playing with a tennis ball or something and be excited.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Basically like a dog, I think, endlessly.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So to me, meaning is created.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: podcasts in particular is relevant here, is there's a third person in this room listening now,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and they're also in the flow state. Yes, yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Like I'm close friends with a lot of podcasts. They don't know I exist. I just listen to them

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: because I've been in so many flow states with them. I was like, yes, yes, this is good,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: but they don't know I exist, but they are in conversation with me ultimately.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And think of what that's doing. You've got dialogues, and then you've got this meta-dialogue

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: like you're describing, and think about how things like podcasts and YouTube, they break down old

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: boundaries between the private and the public, between writing and oral speech. So we have the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: dynamics of living oral speech, but it has the permanency of writing. We're in the midst of

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: creating a vehicle and a medium for distributed cognition that breaks down a lot of the categories

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: by which we organized our cognition. Because of the tools of YouTube and so on,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: just the network, the graph of how quickly the distributed cognition can spread is really powerful.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Just a huge amount of people have listened to your lectures. I've listened to your lectures,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: but I've experienced them, at least in your style. There's something about your style.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It felt like a conversation. It felt like at any moment I could interrupt you and say something.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And I was just listening.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Thank you for saying that because I aspire to being genuinely as Socratic as I can

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: when I'm doing this.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yeah, there was that sense actually, as I'm saying it now. Why was that? It didn't feel like

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: sometimes lectures are kind of, you come down with the commandments and you just want to listen.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: But there was a sense, I think it was the excitement that you have. You have to understand.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And also the fact that you were kind of, I think, thinking off the top of your head sometimes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: You were interrupting yourself with thoughts. You were playing with thoughts. You're reasoning

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: through things often. You referenced a lot of books. So I think that's the way it was.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Surely you were extremely well prepared and you were referencing a lot of ideas,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: but then you were also struggling in the way to present those ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes. And so the jazz, the jazz and getting into the flow state and trying to share in a

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: participatory and perspectival fashion, the learning with the people rather than just

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: pronouncing at them. Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What's mindfulness?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So published on that as well. And I practice, I've been practicing many forms of mindfulness

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: in the College of Practices since 1991. So I both have practitioners knowledge and I also study it

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: scientifically. I think, I'm pretty sure I was the first person to academically talk about

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: mindfulness at the University of Toronto within a classroom setting, like lecturing on it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So this is a topic that a lot of people have recently become very interested in, think about

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: so from that, from the early days, how do you think about what it is?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I've critiqued the sort of standard definitions, being aware of the present moment without

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: judgment, because I think they're flawed. And if you want to get into the detail of why we can,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: but this is how I want to explain it to you. And it also points to the fact of why you need an

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: ecology of mindfulness practices. You shouldn't equate mindfulness with meditation. I think

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: that's a primary mistake. When you say ecology, what do you mean by the way? Like, so lots of many

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: different variants. No. So what I mean by ecology is exactly what you have in an ecology. You have a

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: dynamical system in which there are checks and balances on each other. And I'll get to that with

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: this about mindfulness. I'll make that connection if you allow me. So we're always framing, we've

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: been talking about that. And for those of you who are not on YouTube, there's podcasts, I wear

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: glasses and I'm now sort of putting my fingers and thumb around the frames of my glasses. So

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: this is my frame and my lenses, right? And that frame, the frame holds a lens and I'm seeing

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: through it in both senses, beyond and by means of it. So right now my glasses are transparent to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I want to use that as a strong analogy for my mental framing. Now, this is what you do in

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: meditation, I would argue. You step back from looking through your frame and you look at it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I'm taking my glasses off right now and I'm looking at them. Why might I do that? To see if

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: there's something in the lenses that is distorting, causing me to, right? Now, if I just did that,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: that could be helpful, but how do I know if I've actually corrected the change I made to my lenses?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What do I need to do? I need to put my glasses on and see if I can now see more clearly and deeply

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: than I could before. Meditation is this, stepping back and looking at. Contemplation is that looking

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: through and there are different kinds of practices. The fact that we treat them as synonyms is a deep

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: mistake. The word contemplation has temple in it, in Latin contemplatio means to look up to the sky.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It's a translation of the Greek word theoria, which we get our word theory from. It's to look

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: deeply into things. Meditation is more about having to do with reflecting upon, standing back and

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: looking at. Mindfulness includes both. It includes your ability to break away from an inappropriate

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: frame and the ability to make a new frame. That's what actually happens in insight. You have to

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: both break an inappropriate frame and make, see, realize a new frame. This is why mindfulness

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: enhances insight, both ways, by the way, meditative practices and also contemplative practices.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So mindfulness is frame awareness that can be appropriated in order to improve your capacities

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: for insight and self-regulation. Now I am inexperienced with meditation,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: sort of the practice, the rigorous practice and the science of meditation. But, you know, I've

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: talked to people who seriously as a science study psychedelics and they often talk about

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: the really important thing is the sort of the integration back, so the contemplation step.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So it's not just the actual things you see on psychedelics or the actual journey of

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: where your mind goes on psychedelics. It's also the integrating that into

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: the new perspective that you take on life. Right? Exactly. You really nicely describe.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So meditation is the, in that metaphor, is the psychedelic journey to a different mind state.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And contemplation is the return back to reality, how you integrate yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And contemplation is the return back to reality, how you integrate that into a new world view.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And mindfulness is the whole process. Right. So if you just did contemplation,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: you could suffer from inflation and projective fantasy. If you just do meditation, you can

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: suffer from withdrawal, spiritual bypassing, avoiding reality. They act, they need each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: You have to cycle between them. It's like what I talked about earlier, when I talked about

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: the opponent processing within the autonomic nervous system or the opponent processing at

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: work and attention. And that's what I mean by an ecology of practices. You need both.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Neither one is a panacea. You need them in this opponent processing,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: acting as checks and balance on each other. Is there sort of practical advice you can give

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: to people on how to meditate or how to be mindful in this full way?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes. I would tell them to do at least three things. And I lucked into this.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: When I started meditation, I went down the street and there was a place that taught

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Vipassana meditation, Metta contemplation and Tai Chi Chuan for flow induction.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And you should have a meditative practice. You should find a contemplative practice.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And you should find a moving mindfulness practice, especially one that is conducive to the flow state

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and practice them in an integrated fashion. Can you elaborate what those practices might

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: look like? So, right, generally speaking, meditative practice like Vipassana.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So what's the primary thing I look through rather than look at? It's my sensations.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So what I'm going to do is I'm going to focus on my sensations rather than focusing on the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: world through my sensations. So I'm going to follow, for example, the sensations in this area

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: of my abdomen where my breathing is. So I can feel as my abdomen is expanding, I can feel those

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: sensations and then I can feel the sensations as it's contracting. Now what'll happen is my mind

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: will leap back to try to look through and look at the world again. I'll start thinking about,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I need to do my laundry or what was that noise? And so what do I do? I don't get involved with

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: the content. I step back and label the process with an ing word, listening, imagining, planning,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and then I return my attention to the breath. And I have to return my attention in the correct way.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The part of your mind that jumps around in the Buddhist tradition, this is called your monkey

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: mind. It's like a monkey leaping for branches and chattering, right? If I was trying to train

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: that monkey mind to stay or as Jack Cornfield said, train a puppy dog, stay puppy dog. And if

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: it goes and I get really angry, and I bring it back and I'm yelling at it, I'm going to train it

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: to fight and fear me. But if I just indulge it, if I just feed its whims, oh, well, look, the puppy

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: dog went there. Oh, now it's there. The puppy dog never learns to stay. What do I need to do? I have

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: to neither fight it nor feed it. I have to have this centered attitude. I have to befriend it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And so you step back and look at your sensations. You step back and look at your distracting

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: processes. You return your attention to the breath and you do it with the right attitude. That's the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: core of a good meditative practice. Okay. Then what's a good contemplative practice?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: A good contemplative practice is to try and meta. It's actually apropos because we talked about

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: that participatory knowing the way you're situated in the world. So what, this is a long thing because

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: there's different interpretations of meta and I go for what's called an existential interpretation

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: over an emotional one. So what I'm doing in meta is I'm trying to awaken in two ways. I'm trying

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: to awaken to the fact that I am constantly assuming an identity and assigning an identity.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So I'm looking at that. I'm trying to awaken to that. And then I'm trying to awake from

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: the modal confusion that I can get into around that. And so I'm looking out onto the world and

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I'm trying to see you in a fundamentally different way than I have before.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: You know, like you go to the gym and you do bicep curls.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yeah, yes, yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Is it possible to reduce it to those things that, I mean, you don't need to speak to the specifics,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: but is there actual practice you can do or is it really personal?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: No, I teach people how to do the meta practice. I also teach them how to do a neoplatonic

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: contemplative practice, how to do a stoic. Another one you can do is the view from above.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: This is classic stoicism. I get you to imagine that you're in this room and then imagine that

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: you're floating above the room, then above Austin, then above Texas, then above the United States,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: then the earth. And you have to really imagine it. Don't just think it, but really imagine.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And then what you notice is as you're pulling out to a wider and wider contemplation of reality,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: your sense of self and what you find relevant and important also changes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: No, for all of these, there is a specific step-by-step methodology.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So for example, in the Griffiths lab, they gave people psilocybin and they taught them ahead of

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: time, the features of a mystical experience and only a certain proportion of the people that

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: took the psilocybin went from a psychedelic into a mystical experience. What was interesting is

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: the people that had the mystical experience had measurable and long-standing change to one of the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: big five factors of personality. They had increased openness. Openness is supposed to actually go down

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: over time and these traits aren't supposed to be that malleable and it was significantly

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: altered. But imagine if you just created more openness in a person

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and they're now open to a lot more and they want to explore a lot more, but you don't give them

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: the tools of discernment. That could be problematic for them in important ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That could be very problematic.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes, I got it. So you have to land the plane

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: in a productive way, somehow integrated back into your life and how you see the world and how you

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: frame your perception of that world.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And when people do that, that's when I call it a transformative experience. Now, the higher states

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: of consciousness are really interesting because they tend to move people from a mystical experience

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: into a transformative experience. Because what happens in these experiences is something really,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: really interesting. They get to a state that's ineffable, they can't put it into words,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: they can't describe it, but they're in this state temporarily and then they come back and they do

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: this. They say, that was really real and this in comparison is less real. So I remember that

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: platonic meta desire, I want to change my life myself so that I'm more in conformity with that

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: really real. And that is really odd, Lex, because normally when we go outside of our consensus

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: intelligibility, like a dream state, when we come back from it, we say, that doesn't fit into

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: everything, therefore it's unreal. They do the exact opposite. They come out of these states and

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: they say, that doesn't fit into this consensus intelligibility and that means this is less real.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: They do the exact opposite and that fascinates me. Why do they flip our normal procedure about

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: evaluating alternative states? And the thing is those higher states of consciousness, precisely

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: because they have that onto normativity, the realness that demands that you make a change in

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: your life, they serve to bridge between mystical experiences and genuine transformative experiences.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So you do think seeing those as more real as productive, because then you reach for them.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So Yatins done work on it. Again, all of this stuff is in,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: recent, so we have to take it with a grain of salt. But by a lot of objective measure,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: people who do this, who have these higher states of consciousness and undertake the transformative

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: process, their lives get better. Their relationships improve, their sense of self improves,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: their anxieties go down, depression. All of these other measures, the needles are moved on these

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: measures by people undergoing this transformative experience. Their lives are moving faster than

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: they ever were. Their lives, by many of the criteria that we judge our lives to be good,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: get better.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I have to ask you about this fascinating distributed cognition process that leads to

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: mass formation of ideologies that have had an impact on our world. So you spoke about the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: clash of the two great pseudo-religious ideologies of Marxism and Nazism, especially their clash on

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Kant. Can you explain the origin of each of these, Marxism and Nazism, in a kind of way that we have

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: been talking about the formation of ideas?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Hegel is to Protestantism what Thomas Aquinas is to Catholicism. He was like the philosopher who

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: took German Protestantism and also Kant and Fichte and Schelling, and he built a philosophical

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: system. He explicitly said this, by the way. He wanted to bridge between philosophy and religion.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: He explicitly said that. I'm not foisting that on him. He said it repeatedly in many different

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: places. So he was trying to create a philosophical system that gathered to it, I think, the core

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: mythos of Christianity. The core mythos of Christianity is this idea of a narrative structure

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: to reality in which progress is real, in which our actions now can change the future.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: We can co-participate with God in the creation of the future, and that future can be better.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It can reach something like a utopia or the promised land or whatever. He created a

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: philosophical system of brilliance, by the way. He's a genius. But basically what it did was it

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: took that religious vision and gave it the air of philosophical intelligibility and respect.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Then Marx takes that and says, you know that process by which the narrative is working itself

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: out that Hegel called dialectic. I don't think it's primarily happening in ideas. I think it's

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: happening primarily in between classes within socioeconomic factors, but it's the same story.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Here's this mechanism of history. It's teleological. It's going to move this way.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It can move towards a utopia. We can either participate in furthering it,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: like participating in the work of God, or we can thwart it and be against it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And so you have a pseudo-religious vision. It's all encompassing. Think about how Marxism is not

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: just a philosophical position. It's not just an economic position. It's an entire worldview,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: an entire account of history and a demanding account of what human excellence is. And it has

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: all these things about participating, belonging, fitting to.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: But in Marx's case, it's very pragmatic or directly applicable to society,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: to where it more naturally leads to political ideologies.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It does. But I think Marx, to a very significant degree, inherits one of Hegel's main flaws.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Hegel is talking about all this and he's trying to fit it into post-Kantian philosophy. So for him,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: it's ultimately propositional, conceptual. He, like everybody after Descartes, is very focused

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: on the propositional level and he's not paying deep attention to the non-propositional.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: This is why the two great critics of Hegel, Nietzsche and Kierkegaard, they're trying to put

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: their finger on the non-propositional, the non-conceptual, the will to power or faith.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And they're trying to bring out all these other kinds of knowing as being inadequate.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's why Kierkegaard met when he said Hegel made a system and then he sat down beside it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And so Marxism is very much... It is activist. It's about reorganizing society, but

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: the transformation in individuals is largely ideological, meaning it's largely about

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: these significant propositional changes and adopting a set of beliefs.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: When it came in contact with the Soviet Union or with what became the Soviet Union,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: why do you think it had such a powerful hold on such a large number of people?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Not Marxism, but implementation of Marxism in the name of communism.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Because it offered people something that typically only religions had offered. And

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: it offered people the hope of making a new man, a new kind of human being in a new world.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And when you've been living in Russia, in which things seem to be locked in a system that is

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: crushing most people, getting the promise in the air of scientific legitimacy that we can make new

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: human beings and a new world and in which happiness will ensue. That's an intoxicating proposal.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Like I said, you get all of the intoxication of a religious utopia, but you get all the seeming

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: legitimacy of claiming that it's a scientific understanding of history and economics.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It's very popular to criticize communism, Marxism these days. And I often put myself in the place

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: before any of the implementations came to be, I tried to think if I would be able to predict

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: what the implementations of Marxism and communism would result in in the 20th century. And I'm not

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: sure I'm smart enough to make that prediction. Because at the core of the ideas are respecting,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and with Marx it's very economics type of theory. So it's basically respecting the value of the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: worker and the regular man in society for making a contribution to that society. And to me that seems

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: like a powerful idea. And it's not clear to me how it goes wrong. In fact, it's still not clear to me

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: why the hell did this like, would Stalin happen or Mao happen? There's something very interesting

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and complex about human nature in hierarchies, about distributed cognition, the results in that.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And it's not trivial to understand. No, no. So I mean, I wonder if you could put a finger on it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Why did it go so wrong? So I think what Ohana talks about in the intellectual history of modernity

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: talks about the Promethean spirit, the idea, the really radical proposal. And think about how it's

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: not so radical to us. And in that sense, Marxism has succeeded. The radical proposal that you see

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: even in the French Revolution, and don't forget the terror comes in the French Revolution too,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: that we can make ourselves into God-like beings. Think of the hubris in that. And think of the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: overconfidence to think that we so understand human nature and all of its complexities and human

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: history, and how religion functioned and everything, that we can just come in with a plan

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and make it run. And that's the idea. And I think that's the idea. And I think that's the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: idea. That we can just come in with a plan and make it run. To my mind, that Promethean spirit

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: is part of why it's doomed to fail. And it's doomed to fail in a kind of terrorizing way,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: because the Promethean spirit really licenses you to do anything, because the ends justify the means.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Justify the means really free you to do some of basically, well, commit atrocities at any scale.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Ground zero with Paul Parton and the Khmer Rouge. Right? Exactly. And you can only believe

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: in an ends that can justify any means. If you believe in a utopia, and you can only believe

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: in the utopia if you really buy into the Promethean spirit. So is that what explains Nazism?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So Nazism is part of that too. The Promethean spirit that we can make ourselves into supermen,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: ubermensch. Right? And Nazism is fueled very much by appropriating and twisting

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Gnostic themes that are very prevalent. Gnosticism tends to come to the fore when people are

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: experiencing increased meaning crisis. And don't forget the Weimar Republic is like a

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: meaning crisis gone crazy on all levels. Everybody's suffering domicide. Everybody's

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: home and way of life and identity and culture and relationship to religion and science, all of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And so Nazism comes along and offers a kind of Gnosticism, again, twisted, perverted. I'm not

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: saying all not... I'm not saying that all Gnostics are Nazis, but there is this Gnostic mythology,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: mythos, and it comes to the fore. I remember, and this stuck with me in undergrad, I was taking

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: political science and the professor extended lecture on this and it still rings true for me.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: He says, if you understand Nazism as just a political movement, you have misunderstood it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It is much more a religious phenomena in many ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Is it religious in that the loss of religion, so is it a meaning crisis or is it out of a meaning

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: crisis every discovery of religion in a Promethean type of...

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I think it's the latter. I think there's this vacuum created.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: In that context, is Hitler the central religious figure?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And also, did Nazi Germany create Hitler or did Hitler create Nazi Germany? So in this distributed

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: cognition where everyone's having a dialogue, what's the role of the charismatic leader? Is it

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: an emergent phenomena or do you need one of those to kind of guide the populace?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I hope it's not a necessary requirement. I hope that the next Buddha can be the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Sangha rather than a specific individual. But I think in that situation, Hitler's charisma

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: allowed him to take on a mythological in the proper sense archetypal. He became deeply symbolic

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and he instituted all kinds of rituals, all kinds of rituals and all kinds of mythos.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317
