body.input: There's all this mythos about the master race and there's all these rituals.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The swastika is of course itself a religious symbol. There's all of this going on because

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: he was tapping into the fact that when you put people into deeper and deeper meaning scarcity,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: they will fall back on more and more mythological ways of thinking in order to try and come out

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: in order to try and come up with a generative source to give them new meaning making,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I should say meaning participating behavior. What is evil? Is this a word you avoid?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: No, I don't because I think part of what we're wrestling with here is resisting the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: enlightenment, I mean the historical period in Europe, the idea that evil and sin can just be

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: reduced to individual human immorality. I think there's something deeper in the idea of sin than

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: just immoral. I think sin is a much more comprehensive category. I think sin is a

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: failure to love wisely so that you ultimately engage in a kind of idolatry. You take something

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: as ultimate which is not. That can tend to constellate these collective agents, I call

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: them hyperagents within distributed cognition that have a capacity to wreck havoc on the world

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: that is not just due to a sum total of immoral decisions. This goes to Hannah Arendt's thing

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and the banality of Eichmann and she was really wrestling with it and I think she's close to

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: something but I think she's slightly off. Eichmann is just making a whole bunch of immoral

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: decisions but it doesn't seem to capture the gravity of what the Nazis did, the genocide and

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: the warfare and she's right because you're not going to get just the summation of a lot of

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: individual rather banal immoral choices adding up to what was going on. You're getting a comprehensive

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: parasitic process within massive distributed cognition that has the power to confront the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: world and confront aspects of the world that individuals can't and I think when we're talking

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: about evil, that's what we're trying to point to. This is a point of convergence between

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: me and Jonathan Pagel, we've been talking about this.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So the word sin is interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Are you comfortable using the word sin?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I'm comfortable.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Because it's so deeply rooted in the religious text.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It is, it is and I struggle around this because I was brought up as a fundamentalist Christian

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: and so that is still there within me and there's trauma associated with that.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Probably layers of self-deception mechanisms.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: No doubt, no doubt.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That you're slowly escaping.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Trying to and trying to come into a proper respectful relationship with Christianity via

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: a detour through Buddhism, Taoism and pagan neoplatonism.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Trying to find a way how to love wisely.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes, exactly and so I want to, I think the term sin is good because it's a very,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: because somebody may not be doing something that we would prototypically call immoral,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: but if they're failing to love wisely, they are disconnecting themselves in some important way

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: from the structures of reality. And I think it was Hugh, I may be wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Hugh says, you know, people don't do things because they think it's wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: They do a lesser good in place of a greater good.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And that's a different thing than being immoral.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: When immoral we're saying, you're doing something that's wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It's like, well, no, no, you know, I'm loving my wife.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's a great thing, isn't it?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yeah, but if you love your wife at the expense of your kids,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: like, wow, maybe something's going awry here.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Right?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Well, I love my country.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Great.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: But should you love your country at the expense of your commitment to the religion you belong to?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Like people should wrestle with these questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And I think sin is a failure to wrestle with these questions properly.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yeah, to be content with the choices you've made without considering,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: is there a greater good that could be done?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Your lecture series on the meaning crisis puts us in dialogue in the same way as with the podcast.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: With a bunch of fascinating thinkers throughout history.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Heidegger, Corbin, the man, Carl Jung, Tillich, Barfield.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Is there, can you describe, this might be challenging, but one powerful idea from each that jumps to mind?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Maybe Heidegger.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So for Heidegger, one real powerful idea that has had a huge influence on me,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: he's had a huge influence on me in many ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: He's a big influence on what's called 4-E cognitive science.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And this whole idea about the non-propositional, that was deeply afforded by Heidegger and Marle

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Ponti.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: But I guess maybe the one idea, if I had to pick one, is his critique of ontotheology,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: his critique of the attempt to understand being in terms of a supreme being, something like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And how that gets us fundamentally messed up and we get disconnected from being,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: because we are over-focused on particular beings.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: We're failing to love wisely.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: We're loving the individual things and we're not loving the ground from which they spring.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Can you explain that a little more?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What's the difference between the being and the supreme being and why that gets us into trouble?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So like, well, we talked about this before, the supreme being is a particular being,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: whereas being is no thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It's not any particular kind of thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And so if you're thinking of being as a being, you're thinking of it in a thingy way about

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: something that is fundamentally no thingness.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And so then you're disconnecting yourself from presumably ultimate reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: This takes me to Tillich.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Tillich's great idea is understanding faith as ultimate concern rather than a set of propositions

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: that you're asserting.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Right?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So what are you ultimately concerned about?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What do you want to be in right relationship to?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Ratio religio.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What, and is that ultimate?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Is that the ultimate reality that you conceive of?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Are those two things in sync?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: This has had a profound influence on me and I think it's a brilliant idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So some of the others, how do they integrate?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Maybe the psychologist, so the Carl Jung and Freud.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Which team are you on?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I'm on Jung.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Freud is the better writer, but Jung has, I think, a model of the psyche that is closer

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: to where cognitive science is heading.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: He's more prescient.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Which aspect of his model?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Directly.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So Freud has a hydraulic model.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The psyche is like a steam engine.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Things are under pressure and there's a fluid that's moving around.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It's like, like this is a record note at this.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Jung has an organic model.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The psyche is like a living being.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It's doing all this opponent processing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It's doing all of this self-transcending and growing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Right?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And I think that's a much better model of the psyche than the sort of steam engine model.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What do you think about their view of the subconscious mind?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What do you think their view and your own view of what they're doing?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What's their main view of what's going on there in the shadow?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: All bad stuff?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Some good stuff?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Any stuff at all?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Well, I mean, both Freud and Jung are only talking about the psychodynamic unconscious,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: which is only a small part of the unconscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Can you elaborate?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: They're talking about the aspects of the unconscious that have to do with your sort of ego development.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And how you are understanding and interpreting yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yeah, what else is there?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: There's the unconscious that allows you to turn the noise coming out of my face hole into ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: There's the unconscious that says, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Memory access, all that stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: All that stuff, which is huge and powerful.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And they didn't think about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: They were focused on the big romantic stuff that you have to deal with through psychotherapy, that kind of stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Which is relevant and important.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I'm not saying it doesn't exist, but it's certainly not all of the unconscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: A lot of work that's going on, my colleague and deep friend, Anderson Todd, is about can we take the Jungian stuff and the cognitive science stuff and can we integrate it together theoretically?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And so he's working on that, exactly that project.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: But nevertheless, your sense is there is a subconscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Or at least an unconscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I like the term unconscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It's not just unconscious, it's the unconscious that's going to be the unconscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And so he's really reminded people that the unconscious is unconscious, that we're not conscious of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And that's its fundamental property.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yeah, and then isn't the task of therapy then to make the unconscious conscious?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yeah, to a degree, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The consciousness where there was unconscious is part of Jung's mythos, but it's also not the thought that that can be completed.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Part of why you're extending the reach of the conscious mind is so it can enter into more proper dialogical relationship with the self-organizing system of the unconscious mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What did they have to say about the motivations of humans?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So for Freud jokingly, I said sex, so much of our mind is developed in our young age, our sexual interactions with the world or whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Hence the thing about the edible complex and all, I wanted to have sex with your mother.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What do you think about their description about what motivates humans?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And what do you think about the will to power from Nietzsche?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Which camp are you in there? What motivates humans? Sex or power?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I think Plato is right. And I think there's a connection for me. Plato is my first philosopher.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Jung is my first psychologist. And Jung is very much the Plato of the psyche.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: You never forget your first.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yep, you never do. You never do.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And I think we have, I reject the monological mind. I reject the monophasic mind model.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I think we are multi-centered. I think we have different centers of motivation that operate according to different principles to satisfy different problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And that part of the task of our humanity is to get those different centers into some internal culture by which they are optimally cooperating rather than in conflict with each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What advice would you give to young people today? They're in high school trying to figure out what they're going to do with their life. Maybe they're in college.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: What advice would you give how to have a career they can be proud of or how to have a life they can be proud of?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So the first thing is find an ecology of practices and a community that supports them without involving you in believing things that contravene our best understood science so that wisdom and virtue, especially how they show up in relationships, are primary to you.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: This will sound ridiculous, but if you take care of that, the other things you want are more likely to occur because what you most want is you what you want at when you're approaching your death is what were the relationships you cultivated to yourself, to other people, to the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And what did you do to improve the chance of them being deep and profound relationships?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's an interesting so ecology of practice. So like finding a place where a lot of people are doing different things that are interesting interplay with each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: But at the same time is not a cult.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes, yes, yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Where ideas can flourish.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So how the hell do you know? Because in a place where people are really excited about doing stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's very ripe for cult formation, especially if they're awash in a culture in which we have ever expanding waves of bullshit.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes, precisely.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So try to keep away from the bullshit is the advice.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes. I mean, I take this very seriously and I was with a bunch of people in Vermont at the respond retreat, people, Rafe Kelly was there, a bunch of people who have set up colleges of practices and created communities.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And I have good reason to find all of these people trustworthy. And so we gathered together to try and generate real deal logos flow in distributed cognition, exercise the collective intelligence and try and address that problem, both in terms of metacurriculum that we can offer emerging communities, in terms of practices of vetting, how we will self govern the federation we're forming.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So that we can resist gurufication.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Gurufication of people or ideas?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Both.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Both.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Some of us just get unlucky.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Some of us get unlucky and we all respond, we all had a tremendous sense of urgency around this, but we were trying to balance it about not being premature, but there is going to, I mean, there's, we're going to produce a metacurriculum that's coming in months.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: There's going to be a scientific paper about integrating the scientific work on wisdom with this practitioner based ideas about the cultivation of wisdom.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: There's going to be projects about how we can create a self correcting vetted vetting system.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So we can say to people, we think this ecology is legit.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It's in good fellowship with all these other legit ecologies.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: We don't know about that one.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: We're hesitant about that one.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It's not in good fellowship.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: We have concerns.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Here's why we have our concerns, et cetera.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And you may say, well, who are you to do that?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It's like nobody, but somebody's got to do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And that's what it comes down to.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And so we're going to give it our best effort.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It's worth a try.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: You talked about the meaning crisis in human civilization, but in your own personal life, what has been a dark place you've ever gone in your mind?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Has there been difficult times in your life where you really struggled?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So when I left, fundamentalist Christianity, for a while I was just sort of a hard bit naked.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: A hard-bitten atheist.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The problem with leaving the belief structure was that I didn't deal with all the non-propositional things that had gotten into me.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: All the procedures and habits and all the perspectives and all the identities and the trauma associated with that.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So, you know, I required therapy.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It required years of meditation and Tai Chi, and I'm still wrestling with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: But for the first four or five years, I would...

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I described it like this.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I called it the black burning.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I felt like there was a blackness that was on fire inside of me, precisely because the religion had left a taste for the transcendent in my mouth, but the food it had given me,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: food in square quotes, had soured in my stomach and made me nauseous.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And the juxtaposition of those seemed like an irresolvable problem for me.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That was a very, very dark time for me.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Did it feel lonely?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: When it was very bad, it felt extremely lonely and deeply alienating.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: The universe seemed absurd.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And there was also existential anxiety.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I talk about these things for a reason.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I don't just talk about them as things I'm pointing to.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I'm talking about them as seeing in myself and in people I care, having undergone them, and how they can bring you close to self-destructive...

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I started engaging in kinds of self-destructive behavior.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So the meaning crisis to you is not just the thing you look outside and see many people struggling, you yourself have struggled with.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: That's in fact the narrative is I struggled with it thinking it was a purely personal idiosyncratic thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I started learning the kogsai.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I started doing the tai chi and the meditation.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I started doing all this, right, Socratic philosophy.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And when I started to talk about these pieces, I saw my students' eyes light up.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And I realized, oh, wait, maybe this isn't just something I'm going through.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And talking to them and then doing the research and expanding it out, it's like, oh, many people in a shared fashion and also in an individual lonely fashion are going through meaning crisis.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Well, we talked a lot about wisdom and meaning, and you said that the goal is to love wisely.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: So let me ask about love. What's the role of love in the human condition?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It's central. I mean, it's even central to reason and rationality.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: This is Plato, but Spinoza, the most logical of the rationalists.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: You know, the ethics is written like Euclid's geometry, but he calls it the ethics for a reason because he wants to talk about the blessed life.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And what does he say?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: He says that ultimately reason needs love because love is what brings reason out of being entrapped in the gravity well of egocentrism.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And Murdoch, Iris Murdoch said, I think really beautifully, love is when you painfully realize that something other than yourself is real.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Escaping the gravity well of egocentrism, beautifully put, a beautiful way to end it. John, you're a beautiful human being.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Thank you for struggling in your own mind with the search for meaning and encouraging others to do the same and ultimately to learn how to love wisely.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Thank you so much for talking today.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: It's been a great pleasure, Lex. I really enjoyed it a lot. Thank you so much.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Thanks for listening to this conversation with John Verbeke. To support this podcast, please check out our sponsors in the description.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: And now let me leave you with some words from Herman Hesse and Siddhartha.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: I've always believed and I still believe that whatever good or bad fortune may come our way, we can always give it meaning and transform it into something of value.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Vervaeke: Meaning Crisis, Atheism, Religion & the Search for Wisdom | Lex Fridman Podcast #317

body.input: Thank you for listening and hope to see you next time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: I've been trying to get ahold of him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: Back to capitalism, I gotta ask you,

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: just competition in general in this world of weirdos,

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: is competition good for the world?

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: This kind of seems to be one of the fundamental

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: engines of capitalism, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: Do you see it as ultimately constructive

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: or destructive for the world?

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: What really matters is how good your legal framework is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: So competition within nature,

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: for food leads to bloody conflict all the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: The animal world is quite unpleasant to say the least.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: If you have something like the rule of law

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: and clearly defined property rights,

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: which are within reason justly allocated,

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: competition probably is gonna work very well,

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: but it's not an unalloyed good thing at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: It can be highly destructive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: Military competition, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: Which actually is itself sometimes good,

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: but it's not good per se.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: What aspects of life do you think

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: we should protect from competition?

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: So is there some, you said like the rule of law,

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: is there some things we should keep away from competition?

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: Well, the fight for territory most of all, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: So violence, anything that involves

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: like actual physical violence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: Right, and it's not that I think

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: the current borders are just.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: I mean, go talk to Hungarians, Romanians,

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: you know, Serbians, Bosnians, they'll talk your ear off.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: And some of them are probably right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: But at the end of the day,

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: we have some kind of international order.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: And I would rather we more or less stick with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: If Catalonians wanna leave, they keep up with it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: you know, let them go.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: But.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: What about space of like healthcare?

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: This is where you get into a tension of like

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: between capitalism and kind of more,

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: I don't wanna use socialism,

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: but those kinds of policies that are less free market.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: I think in this country,

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: healthcare should be much more competitive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: So you go to hospitals, doctors,

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: they don't treat you like a customer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: They treat you like an idiot or like a child

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: or someone with third party payment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: And it's a pretty humiliating experience often.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: Do you think a free market in general is possible?

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: Like a pure free market?

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: And is that a good goal to strive for?

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: I don't think the term pure free markets well defined

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: because you need a legal order.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: The legal order has to make decisions on like

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: what is intellectual property more important than ever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: There's no benchmark that like represents the

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: pure free market way of doing things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: What will penalties be?

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: How much do we put into law enforcement?

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: No simple answers, but just saying free market

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: doesn't pin down what you're gonna do

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: on those all important questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: So free market is an economics, I guess, idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: So there's no, it's not possible for free market

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: is generate the rules.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: They're like emergent, like self-governing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: It generates a lot of them, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: Through private norms, through trade associations,

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: international trade is mostly done privately and by norms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: So it's certainly possible, but at the end of the day

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: I think you need governments to draw very clear lines

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: to prevent it from turning into mafia run systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: You know, I've been hanging out with other group of weirdos

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: lately, Michael Malice, who's who espouses to be

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: an anarchist, anarchism, which is like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: I think intellectually just a fascinating set of ideas

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: where the, you know, taking free market to the full extreme

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: of basically saying there should be no government,

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: what is it, oversight, I guess.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: And then everything should be fully,

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: like all the agreements, all the collectives you form

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: should be voluntary, not based on the geographic land

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: you were born on and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: Do you think that's just a giant mess?

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: Like, do you think it's possible for an anarchist society

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: to work where it's, you know, in a fully distributed way

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: people agree with each other,

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: not just on financial transactions, but you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: on their personal security, on sort of military type

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: of stuff, on healthcare, on education,

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: all those kinds of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: And where does it break down?

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: Well, I wouldn't press a button to say get rid

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: of our current constitution, which I view is pretty good

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: and quite wise.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: But I think the deeper point is that all societies

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: are in some regards anarchistic

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: and we should take the anarchists seriously.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: So globally, there's a kind of anarchy across borders,

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: even within federalistic systems, they're typically complex.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: There's not a clear transitivity necessarily

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: of who has the final say over what,

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: just the state vis-a-vis its people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: There's not per se a final arbitrator in that regard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: So you want a good anarchy rather than a bad anarchy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: You wanna squish your anarchy into the right corners.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: And I don't think there's a theoretical answer

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: how to do it, but you start with the country,

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: like is it working well enough now?

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: This country, you'd say mostly,

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: you'd certainly wanna make a lot of improvements.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: And that's why I don't wanna press that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: get rid of the constitution button,

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: but to just dump on the anarchists is to miss the point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: Always try to learn from any opinion,

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: what in it is true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: I'm just like marveling at the poetry of saying

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: that we should squish our anarchy into the right corners.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: Love it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: Okay, I gotta ask, I've been talking with,

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: since we're doing a whirlwind introduction

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: to all of economics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: I've been talking to a few objectivists recently

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: and just Ayn Rand comes up as a person, as a philosopher

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: throughout many conversations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: A lot of people really despise her.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: A lot of people really love her.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: It's always weird to me when somebody arouses a philosophy

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: or a human being arouses that much emotion

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: in either direction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174

body.input: Do you understand first of all, that level of emotion?

metadata.title: Podcast: Tyler Cowen: Economic Growth & the Fight Against Conformity & Mediocrity | Lex Fridman Podcast #174
